title: ResRank: Unifying Retrieval and Listwise Reranking via End-to-End Joint Training with Residual Passage Compression
summary: Large language model (LLM) based listwise reranking has emerged as the dominant paradigm for achieving state-of-the-art ranking effectiveness in information retrieval. However, its reliance on feeding full passage texts into the LLM introduces two critical bottlenecks: the "lost in the middle" phenomenon degrades ranking quality as input length grows, and the inference latency scales super-linearly with sequence length, rendering it impractical for industrial deployment. In this paper, we present ResRank, a unified retrieval-reranking framework that fundamentally addresses both challenges. Inspired by multimodal LLMs that project visual inputs into compact token representations, ResRank employs an Encoder-LLM to compress each candidate passage into a single embedding, which is then fed alongside the query text into a Reranker-LLM for listwise ranking. To alleviate the misalignment between the compressed representation space and the ranking space, we introduce a residual connection structure that combines encoder embeddings with contextualized hidden states from the reranker. Furthermore, we replace the conventional autoregressive decoding with a one-step cosine-similarity-based scoring mechanism, eliminating the generation bottleneck entirely. ResRank is trained through a carefully designed dual-stage, multi-task, end-to-end joint optimization strategy that simultaneously trains the encoder and reranker, achieving learning objective alignment between retrieval and reranking while substantially reducing training complexity. Extensive experiments on TREC Deep Learning and eight BEIR benchmark datasets demonstrate that ResRank achieves competitive or superior ranking effectiveness compared to existing approaches while requiring zero generated tokens and processing only one token per passage, yielding a fundamentally better balance between effectiveness and efficiency.

AI.tldr: ResRank是一个统一检索-重排序框架，通过将段落压缩为单一嵌入向量、残差连接融合多层级表示、以及一步余弦相似度评分机制，有效解决了LLM重排序中的"中间迷失"问题和超线性推理延迟问题，同时保持竞争力的排序效果。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM列表式重排序面临两大关键瓶颈：输入长度增加时"中间迷失"现象导致排序质量下降，以及推理延迟随序列长度超线性增长，使其难以在工业场景中部署。
AI.method: ResRank采用Encoder-LLM将候选段落压缩为单一嵌入向量，引入残差连接结构融合编码器嵌入与重排序器的上下文隐藏状态，并用一步余弦相似度评分替代自回归解码。通过精心设计的双阶段、多任务、端到端联合优化策略同时训练编码器和重排序器。
AI.result: 在TREC深度学习和8个BEIR基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，ResRank达到了与现有方法相当或更优的排序效果，同时实现了零生成token和每段落仅处理一个token的效率。
AI.conclusion: ResRank通过统一检索-重排序框架，在保持竞争力的排序效果的同时，实现了零token生成和每段落仅处理一个token的极致效率，为效果与效率的平衡提供了根本性更好的解决方案。

title: Rethinking Semantic Collaborative Integration: Why Alignment Is Not Enough
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become an important semantic infrastructure for modern recommender systems. A prevailing paradigm integrates LLM-derived semantic embeddings with collaborative representations via representation alignment, implicitly assuming that the two views encode a shared latent entity and that stronger alignment yields better results. We formalize this assumption as the global low-complexity alignment hypothesis and argue that it is stronger than necessary and often structurally mismatched with real-world recommendation settings. We propose a complementary perspective in which semantic and collaborative representations are treated as partially shared yet fundamentally heterogeneous views, each containing both shared and view-specific factors. Under this shared-plus-private latent structure, enforcing global geometric alignment may distort local structure, suppress view-specific signals, and reduce informational diversity. To support this perspective, we develop complementarity-aware diagnostics that quantify overlap, unique-hit contribution, and theoretical fusion upper bounds. Empirical analyses on sparse recommendation benchmarks reveal low item-level agreement between semantic and collaborative views and substantial oracle fusion gains, indicating strong complementarity. Furthermore, controlled alignment probes show that low-capacity mappings capture only shared components and fail to recover full collaborative geometry, especially under distribution shift. These findings suggest that alignment should not be treated as the default integration principle. We advocate a shift from alignment-centric modeling to complementarity fusion-centric, complementarity-aware design, where shared factors are selectively integrated while private signals are preserved. This reframing provides a principled foundation for the next generation of LLM-enhanced recommender systems.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了将大语言模型（LLM）语义嵌入与协同表示进行全局几何对齐的主流范式，提出两者应被视为部分共享但本质异构的视图，各自包含共享和私有因素。强制全局对齐会扭曲局部结构、压制视图特有信号。基于稀疏推荐基准的实验表明语义与协同视图在项目级别一致性较低，且存在可观的oracle融合增益，表明二者具有强互补性。
AI.motivation: 当前主流范式假设LLM语义嵌入与协同表示编码共享潜在实体，强对齐带来更好效果，但这一假设过于强且与现实推荐场景结构不匹配。作者认为需要重新审视这一假设的合理性。
AI.method: 提出共享-私有潜在结构视角，使用互补性感知诊断方法（量化重叠度、独特贡献和理论融合上界）；在稀疏推荐基准上进行对齐控制实验探针。
AI.result: 实验发现：1）语义与协同视图在项目级别一致性低；2）存在可观的oracle融合增益，表明强互补性；3）低容量映射仅捕获共享成分，无法恢复完整协同几何结构，尤其在分布偏移下表现更差。
AI.conclusion: 对齐不应被视为默认整合原则。建议从"对齐中心"转向"互补性融合中心"的设计范式，选择性整合共享因素同时保留私有信号，为下一代LLM增强推荐系统提供原则性基础。

title: Objective Shaping with Hard Negatives: Windowed Partial AUC Optimization for RL-based LLM Recommenders
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) effectively optimizes Large Language Model (LLM)-based recommenders by contrasting positive and negative items. Empirically, training with beam-search negatives consistently outperforms random negatives, yet the mechanism is not well understood. We address this gap by analyzing the induced optimization objective and show that: (i) Under binary reward feedback, optimizing LLM recommenders with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is theoretically equivalent to maximizing the Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC), which is often misaligned with Top-$K$ recommendation; and (ii) Replacing random negatives with beam-search negatives reshapes the objective toward partial AUC, improving alignment with Top-$K$ metrics. Motivated by this perspective, we introduce Windowed Partial AUC (WPAUC), which constrains the false positive rate (FPR) to a window [$α,α+d$] to more directly align with Top-$K$ metrics. We further propose an efficient Threshold-Adjusted Windowed reweighting (TAWin) RL method for its optimization, enabling explicit control over the targeted Top-$K$ performance. Experiments on four real-world datasets validate the theory and deliver consistent state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论层面解释了为什么beam-search负样本在强化学习训练LLM推荐系统中优于随机负样本，并提出了一种新的优化目标Windowed Partial AUC (WPAUC)以及对应的TAWin训练方法，实现与Top-K推荐指标的直接对齐。
AI.motivation: 尽管经验上训练LLM推荐系统时使用beam-search负样本优于随机负样本，但其背后的机制尚未被充分理解，这种理论空白阻碍了方法的进一步优化和改进。
AI.method: 理论分析表明：(i) 在二元奖励反馈下，使用GRPO优化LLM推荐器在理论上等价于最大化AUC，但AUC与Top-K推荐指标存在错位；(ii) 用beam-search负样本替换随机负样本会将目标重塑为Partial AUC，提高了与Top-K指标的alignment。在此基础上，提出Windowed Partial AUC (WPAUC)将FPR约束在窗口[α, α+d]内，并设计了Threshold-Adjusted Windowed reweighting (TAWin)方法进行优化。
AI.result: 在四个真实世界数据集上的实验验证了理论分析的正确性，TAWin方法取得了持续的SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过建立GRPO与AUC之间的理论联系，揭示了beam-search负样本有效性的本质原因；WPAUC和TAWin方法能够显式控制目标Top-K性能，为LLM推荐系统的强化学习训练提供了更精确的优化目标。

title: ASPIRE: Make Spectral Graph Collaborative Filtering Great Again via Adaptive Filter Learning
summary: Graph filter design is central to spectral collaborative filtering, yet most existing methods rely on manually tuned hyperparameters rather than fully learnable filters. We show that this challenge stems from a bias in traditional recommendation objectives, which induces a spectral phenomenon termed low-frequency explosion, thereby fundamentally hindering the effective learning of graph filters. To overcome this limitation, we propose a novel adaptive spectral graph collaborative filtering framework (ASPIRE) based on a bi-level optimization objective. Guided by our theoretical analysis, we disentangle the filter learning objective, which in turn leads to excellent recommendation performance, spectral adaptivity, and training stability in practice. Extensive experiments show our learned filters match the performance of carefully engineered task-specific designs. Furthermore, ASPIRE is equally effective in LLM-powered collaborative filtering. Our findings demonstrate that graph filter learning is viable and generalizable, paving the way for more expressive graph neural networks in collaborative filtering.

AI.tldr: ASPIRE（Adaptive Spectral graph collaboratIve filteRing framEwork）是一个基于双层优化的自适应谱图协同过滤框架。它揭示并理论证明了传统推荐目标（BPR/CE）存在固有的低频偏置，导致可学习图滤波器在训练中发生"低频爆炸"（低频响应幅值单调增长不收敛），进而引发滤波器与评测指标的双重不稳定；ASPIRE 通过"用验证集作为 oracle 交互信号来学习滤波器"的解耦式双层优化目标，配合预过滤 ℓ2 归一化与可学习多项式滤波器 g_θ(Λ)=Σθ_lΛ^l，在 Baby/Electronics/Ciao/LastFM 四数据集、三种图结构场景（Homogeneous/Heterogeneous/Dual-Branch）中达到与精心手工设计的 Jacobi、Lin-C 滤波器相当的性能（75% 结果达到"可比"级别，33.3% 超过两者），相对 Avg-P 最高提升 13.9%，并显著改善训练稳定性；在 LLM 编码器驱动的 CF（Whitening Init / MLP Proj 两种适配器 × MiniLM-L6、Qwen2.5-7B、SFR-Emb 三种编码器）中同样稳定最优。
AI.motivation: 谱图协同过滤中，现有方法（如 LightGCN 的 Avg-P、JGCF 的 Jacobi 基、SSC 的 Lin-C 校正）依赖人工设计的滤波器与繁重的超参调优；而直觉上更优的"完全可学习滤波器"在实践中却表现出训练不稳定、性能反而更差。作者通过可视化训练过程中谱响应曲线的演化，发现一个一致的谱现象——低频爆炸（Low-Frequency Explosion）：低频分量的响应幅值在训练全程持续增长且永不收敛。作者进一步从损失函数角度追根溯源：问题根源在于传统推荐目标（BPR/交叉熵）本身存在频率偏置，导致梯度持续偏袒低频、系统性欠优化高频信息，从而破坏滤波器的"滤波器稳定性"（Filter Stability），并连带造成"指标稳定性"（Metric Stability）崩溃。因此需要一个能够绕开该目标偏置、且无需先验谱分析的滤波器学习机制。
AI.method:
【理论分析】在 Perfect Uniformity 假设（用 PCD 与 NER 两项均匀性指标实证验证）下，证明定理 1：BPR 损失在最优解附近对谱响应 g(λ_k) 的梯度满足符号由 λ_k·g(λ_k) 决定、量级正比于 λ_k·g(λ_k)·||Ẽ_k||²。因此 λ_k>0（低频）被不断放大、λ_k<0（高频）被压向 0，|λ_k| 大的分量获得更强更新，形成强低通偏置与过正则化；附录 B.2 给出交叉熵损失的同构结论（低频爆炸在 CE 下更缓但仍持续线性上升）。

【方法设计】(1) 预过滤归一化：对嵌入矩阵做行向 ℓ2 归一化，消除节点尺度差异，防止高范数嵌入压制滤波器学习（去掉后收敛变慢、精度下降且可能训练崩溃）。(2) 自适应滤波：g_θ(Λ)=Σ_{l=0}^{L}θ_lΛ^l（L=3），以 full-pass 初始化（θ_0=1, 其余为 0，即恒等变换），再经后滤波算子 ℱ（恒等或双分支平均池化融合）得到最终表示。(3) 双层优化目标：上层以"预测 oracle 交互"为准则最小化验证集损失 L_valid(θ, E*(θ))，下层以训练集 BPR 损失优化嵌入 E；两者交错执行，每 T=5 步下层更新做一次上层更新（借鉴 MAML 式交错方案）。上层梯度含显式项与隐式项（Neumann 或 DARTS 近似），实验表明隐式项贡献可忽略，故最终采用仅显式项的 Neumann 近似（N-Ex），在大幅降低时间/显存开销的同时保持性能（Baby 上 10m44s vs Avg-P 10m09s，而带隐式项则 15m20s）。

【实验设置】数据集：Amazon Baby/Electronics（多模态，MiniLM 文本+CNN 视觉，kNN=10 构建 item-item 图）、Ciao/LastFM（社交图）；8:1:1 划分；5 次运行平均。场景：Homogeneous（交互图）、Heterogeneous（侧信息增广图 A_+）、Dual-Branch（交互图+侧信息图分别滤波后平均池化）。基线滤波器：L-0、L-n、Avg-P、Jacobi、Lin-C、Naive-L。评测：R@10/20、N@10/20，并按 Level 0~3 分级对比手工滤波器；另分析谱适应性、滤波器/指标稳定性、初始化鲁棒性、消融（PN/BO/OS）、超参敏感性、时间与显存开销，并扩展到 LLM 编码器 CF。
AI.result: 1) 性能：ASPIRE 在 48 组对比中 75% 至少达到"与两种手工设计滤波器可比"的 Level 2，33.3% 超过两者；在 Homogeneous 与 Dual-Branch 场景的平均排名上整体优于 Jacobi 与 Lin-C，且性能跨场景稳定；相对常用 Avg-P 多数指标为正增益（最高 +13.9%，Baby/Homogeneous N@20 +12.4%，LastFM/Dual-Branch 最高 +10.1%）。Naive-L 因低频爆炸明显最差（如 Baby Homogeneous R@20 仅 .0690 vs ASPIRE .0871）。2) 谱适应性：不同图类型学到的滤波器形状明显不同——侧信息图上的滤波器呈明显低通，而交互图上同时保留低频与高频响应；侧信息增广后低频相对重要性上升的趋势与已知 oracle 谱一致。3) 稳定性：ASPIRE 的 NDCG 曲线稳步上升、滤波器演化平滑且幅值受控；Naive-L 在 BPR 下性能骤降、CE 下快速收敛到劣质平台；5 种初始化（full-pass、zero-crossing、low-pass、mid-pass、high-pass）最终收敛到几乎相同的谱形（或其关于 x 轴镜像的符号翻转等价形），prior-aligned 初始化收敛更快。4) LLM-CF：Whitening Init 下 Avg-P 出现模态遗忘式退化（性能最终跌回随机初始化水平），Naive-L 不稳定，ASPIRE 在三种编码器上均取得最佳且稳定；MLP Proj 下无强初始化时 Naive-L 明显退化。5) 消融：去掉 oracle 监督（用训练集替代验证集）性能大幅劣化且更不稳定，说明"oracle 交互监督"是关键；去掉预过滤归一化或双层目标亦同时损害精度与稳定性。6) 开销：仅显式项的近似几乎不增加显存（Baby 488MB 不变）与时间；上层的更新间隔 T 与辅助集规模不敏感（Baby 上 0.5% 验证集即足够，Ciao 需 ≥5%）。7) 局限：未覆盖含可学习线性变换的更复杂 GNN 结构，LLM 仅用作编码器，未在序列推荐等更广任务上验证低频爆炸是否普遍存在。
AI.conclusion: ASPIRE 表明：图滤波器学习是可行且可泛化的——只要解除传统推荐目标的低频偏置，无需先验谱分析、无需重调超参，即可学到既具谱适应性又训练稳定的多项式滤波器，性能与精心手工设计的任务专用滤波器相当甚至更优。这为理解"学习目标诱导的谱形状"提供了定量工具（可作为图谱分析工具），并为在 CF 中构建更具表达力、稳定的图神经网络（如引入层间线性变换）铺路。核心启示是：设计可学习滤波器时，监督信号本身的频率特性比滤波器表达力更关键，需以 oracle 交互预测作为上层的解耦目标。

title: Shard the Gradient, Scale the Model: Serverless Federated Aggregation via Gradient Partitioning
summary: Federated learning (FL) aggregation on serverless platforms faces a hard scalability ceiling: existing architectures (lambda-FL, LIFL) partition clients across aggregators, but every aggregator must hold the complete model gradient in memory. When gradients exceed the per-function memory limit (e.g., 10 GB on AWS Lambda), aggregation becomes infeasible regardless of tree depth or branching factor. We propose GradsSharding, which instead partitions the gradient tensor into M shards, each averaged independently by a serverless function that receives contributions from all clients. Because FedAvg averaging is element-wise, this produces bit-identical results to tree-based approaches, so model accuracy is invariant by construction. Per-function memory is bounded at O(|θ|/M), independent of client count, enabling aggregation of arbitrarily large models. We evaluate GradsSharding against lambda-FL and LIFL through HPC experiments and real AWS Lambda deployments across model sizes from 43 MB to 5 GB. Results show a cost crossover at approximately 500 MB gradient size, 2.7x cost reduction at VGG-16 scale, and that GradsSharding is the only architecture that remains deployable beyond the serverless memory ceiling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GradsSharding：把联邦学习聚合阶段的梯度张量（而非客户端）切分成 M 个分片，由 M 个并行 AWS Lambda 函数各自独立地对全部 N 个客户端的对应分片做 FedAvg 平均，再拼接还原全量梯度。由于 FedAvg 是逐元素运算，分片聚合与树形聚合结果逐位相同（bit-identical），精度/收敛性天然不变；单函数内存被约束在 O(|θ|/M)，与客户端数无关，从而可聚合任意大的模型。在真实 AWS Lambda 上与 λ-FL、LIFL 对比（模型梯度 43 MB–5 GB）：小模型（<500 MB）λ-FL 因 S3 操作更少而更便宜，VGG-16 规模上 GradsSharding 快 1.7×、便宜 2.7×，且是唯一能越过 ~3 GB（Lambda 10 GB 内存上限）后仍可部署的架构。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习的聚合步骤在无服务器（serverless）平台上存在硬性可扩展性天花板。已有方案（λ-FL、LIFL）均按"客户端"维度切分：每个聚合器只服务更少的客户端，但仍必须在内存中持有完整梯度张量（需两块全梯度缓冲区）。当梯度超过单个函数的内存上限（AWS Lambda 为 10 GB）时，无论树深度或分支因子如何都不可行。此外，FL 的聚合阶段是短促、突发的：参数服务器在每轮中需等待所有客户端完成本地训练，论文实测 PS 空闲比高达 79.8%–99.6%，常驻服务器在绝大部分训练时间里空转浪费。因此需要一个把单函数内存与模型大小、客户端数量解耦的聚合架构。
AI.method: 架构设计：GradsSharding 沿参数轴把每个客户端梯度 g_i∈R^{|θ|} 切成 M 个连续分片 g_i^(j)∈R^{|θ|/M}；客户端对每分片做一次并行 PUT 上传 S3（按轮次与分片索引组织）；M 个由 S3 事件通知触发的独立 Lambda 函数并发执行，每个用流式累加（两块 |θ|/M 大小缓冲区）读取全部 N 个客户端的同一分片、计算逐元素平均 1/N·Σ g_i^(j) 并写回 S3；最后各客户端读取 M 个平均分片并拼接重建全量梯度。内存分析给出 O(|θ|/M) 且与 N 无关；等价性证明：逐元素求和与分块可交换，故结果与整梯度平均逐位相同。成本模型：Lambda 计算按 GB·s 计费 + S3 PUT/GET 固定请求价（每轮 S3 操作数 3NM+M）。实验：RQ1 在 HPC（Oakland University Matilda 集群，V100）上测 PS 空闲比，并在 Lambda 上验证时间构成（S3 读占 91–99%）；RQ2 做分片消融 M∈{1,2,4,8,16}（HPC 顺序执行 + Lambda 并发执行，测内存、延迟、每千轮成本）；RQ3 将三种架构统一重实现、同一流式逻辑部署到 us-east-1 Lambda 上做跨架构对比（ResNet-18 42.7 MB、VGG-16 512 MB、GPT-2 Large 2,953 MB、合成 5,120 MB，N=20 客户端，每配置 3 轮×3 次重复、剔除冷启动取 8 次热测量），并用经验内存公式 3×input_size+450 MB 判定可行性。
AI.result: RQ1：四模型 PS 空闲比 79.8%–99.6%（ResNet-18 训练 2,154 ms / 聚合 544 ms；VGG-16 99.6%；GPT-2 M 98.9%；GPT-2 L 99.1%）；Lambda 上 S3 读占 91–99% 时间，FedAvg 计算恒为 1.3–2.9 s，单函数 S3 吞吐 45–68 MB/s；成本 $0.13–$50.53/1K 轮。RQ2：每聚合器内存随 M 线性下降确认 O(|θ|/M)（VGG-16：collect-then-average 需 10,788 MB at M=1，超限，流式界 1,024 MB→64 MB at M=16）；Lambda 上并发执行使延迟从 181.9 s (M=1) 降至 11.2 s (M=16)，16.2× 近线性加速，S3 读占 98.9–99.1%；成本呈 U 形，峰值在 M=4（$11.70/1K），M=1 最便宜 $9.03/1K，M=16 $10.74/1K；S3 成本随 M 线性上升（$0.12→$1.94）。RQ3：ResNet-18 下三者均可行，λ-FL 最便宜（$0.38/1K）但 GradsSharding 延迟最低（7.9 s vs 10.4/12.3 s）；VGG-16 下 GradsSharding 67.2 s、$3.82/1K，比 λ-FL（117.3 s、$10.28/1K）快 1.7×、便宜 2.7×，比 LIFL（126.6 s、$13.03/1K）更优；GPT-2 Large（2,953 MB）下全梯度架构需 9,309 MB/聚合器（占上限 91%）实际未部署，GradsSharding M=4 仅需 2,665 MB，362.5 s、$59.29/1K；合成 5 GB 下全梯度需 15,810 MB 超限，GradsSharding M=8 需 2,370 MB，299.4 s、$85.66/1K。硬可行性阈值约 (10,240−450)/3≈3,263 MB。
AI.conclusion: GradsSharding 是首个将单函数内存与模型规模及客户端数量同时解耦的无服务器 FL 聚合架构：沿参数维分片 + M 个并行 Lambda，内存 O(|θ|/M)，且因 FedAvg 逐元素性质与 λ-FL/LIFL 产生逐位相同的聚合结果，故精度与收敛性按构造不变（论文只比较系统拓扑而非学习算法）。三点核心发现：(1) PS 每轮空闲 80%–99.6%，验证 serverless 前提；(2) 并发分片带来随 M 近线性的延迟扩展（16.2× at M=16），S3 I/O 占聚合时间 >99%，算术优化无意义，应转向并行字节范围读取、批量对象或 6 MB 内直接调用载荷；(3) 成本交叉点约 500 MB——低于此值 λ-FL 因 S3 操作少而更廉价，高于此值 GradsSharding 的内存×时间节省压倒 I/O 开销，VGG-16 规模实现 2.7× 成本下降；超过 ~3 GB 梯度后 λ-FL/LIFL 在 Lambda 上完全不可行，仅 GradsSharding 可通过增大 M 继续扩展。局限包括基线为自行重实现、内存公式 3×+450 MB 需按运行时重标定、HPC 客户端串行训练、仅测 N=20、均匀分片对 MoE 等异构层不均衡。未来工作：运行时自适应 M、与梯度压缩组合、S3 访问模式优化、非均匀分片。

title: Math Takes Two: A test for emergent mathematical reasoning in communication
summary: Although language models demonstrate remarkable proficiency on mathematical benchmarks, it remains unclear whether this reflects true mathematical reasoning or statistical pattern matching over learning formal syntax. Most existing evaluations rely on symbolic problems grounded in established mathematical conventions, limiting insight into the models' ability to construct abstract concepts from first principles. In this work, we propose Math Takes Two, a new benchmark designed to assess the emergence of mathematical reasoning through communication. Motivated by the hypothesis that mathematical cognition in humans co-evolved with the need for precise communication, our benchmark tests whether two agents, without prior mathematical knowledge, can develop a shared symbolic protocol to solve a visually grounded task where the use of a numerical system facilitates extrapolation. Unlike many current datasets, our benchmark eschews predefined mathematical language, instead requiring agents to discover latent structure and representations from scratch. Math Takes Two thus provides a novel lens through which to develop and evaluate models with emergent numerical reasoning capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Math Takes Two基准测试，通过两个无预定义数学知识的智能体在视觉任务中自主发现并建立共享符号协议来评估数学推理能力，而非依赖已有数学语言的模式匹配。
AI.motivation: 现有数学基准测试可能仅反映统计模式匹配能力，而非真正的数学推理。这些评估依赖于预设的数学符号系统，无法检验模型从第一性原理构建抽象概念的能力。基于人类数学认知与精确交流协同演化的假设，本文认为真正的数学推理应能在无预设语言条件下通过交流涌现。
AI.method: 设计两个智能体在视觉 grounded 任务中进行交流，任务特性使使用数字系统有利于泛化。智能体需从零开始发现潜在结构并建立共享表示，而非使用预定义数学语言。
AI.result: 未在摘要中明确说明具体实验结果
AI.conclusion: Math Takes Two为开发和评估具有涌现数值推理能力的模型提供了新视角，可用于检验语言模型是否真正习得数学推理而非仅依赖形式语法的统计关联。

title: Feedback Over Form: Why Execution Feedback Matters More Than Pipeline Topology in 1-3B Code Generation
comment: 17 pages main text, 2 page references, 3 figures. Code: https://github.com/L3G/feedback-over-form
summary: Small language models (1-3B) are practical to run locally, but individually limited on harder code generation tasks. We ask whether composing them into pipelines can recover some of that lost capability. We study code generation pipelines built from 1-3B models with execution feedback, and use a NEAT-inspired evolutionary search to test whether more complex pipeline structure helps beyond a simple refinement loop. We evaluate on HumanEval (164 problems) and sanitized MBPP (427 problems), all with local inference on a single laptop. Self-refinement with execution feedback improves code generation by more than 4 standard deviations on both benchmarks. The gains are narrow in mechanism: refinement fixes many runtime errors (especially NameError and SyntaxError), but rarely fixes logic errors such as AssertionError. Within our tested general-purpose model pool, generator identity mattered less than refiner capability: a 1.5B generator paired with a 3B refiner matched a 3B model doing both roles. Early stopping is essential; without it, every iteration is net-negative. The code-specialized models outperform every general-purpose pipeline configuration, suggesting model specialization matters more than pipeline architecture. Preliminary text-only pipeline experiments without execution feedback did not show gains at this scale. In our constrained search space, evolutionary search mostly rediscovered the same simple generate-execute-refine loop we found manually, with no clearly significant gain from added topology. Single-evaluation fitness inflates results by 5-7 percent, selecting lucky genomes over good ones. On these benchmarks at 1-3B scale, execution feedback mattered more than added pipeline complexity in determining whether composition helped.

AI.tldr: 本文研究1-3B参数的小型语言模型能否通过流水线组合（尤其是加入执行反馈的自我改进机制）来弥补单模型在代码生成任务上的能力不足。通过NEAT启发的进化搜索，在HumanEval和MBPP基准上发现：执行反馈是关键增益来源（提升超过4个标准差），但复杂流水线拓扑结构并未带来显著收益；代码专用模型优于通用模型；提前停止至关重要；单次评估的适应度会高估结果5-7%。
AI.motivation: 小型语言模型（1-3B）虽便于本地运行，但在复杂代码生成任务上能力有限。研究动机在于探索通过模型组合能否恢复部分损失的能力，以及更复杂的流水线结构是否优于简单的生成-执行-改进循环。
AI.method: 使用NEAT启发的进化搜索构建代码生成流水线，模型池包含1-3B参数的一般用途和代码专用模型。实验在HumanEval（164题）和MBPP（427题）上进行，均为本地单笔记本推理。核心流水线为"生成-执行-改进"循环，辅以执行反馈。
AI.result: 自我改进（带执行反馈）使代码生成提升超过4个标准差。收益主要来自修复运行时错误（NameError、SyntaxError），而非逻辑错误（AssertionError）。1.5B生成器+3B改进器的组合与3B模型兼任两角色效果相当。代码专用模型优于所有通用模型配置。进化搜索在受限搜索空间中主要重新发现了简单的手动设计循环，未从额外拓扑中获益。单次评估适应度导致结果高估5-7%。
AI.conclusion: 在1-3B规模下，执行反馈对流水线组合的增益作用大于复杂流水线拓扑。模型专业化比流水线架构更重要。早停机制不可或缺。进化搜索在此约束空间内未能发现超越简单"生成-执行-改进"循环的更优结构。

title: When Cow Urine Cures Constipation on YouTube: Limits of LLMs in Detecting Culture-specific Health Misinformation
comment: To appear in the proceedings of the 2nd Workshop on Misinformation Detection in the Era of LLMs (MisD), The 20th International AAAI Conference on Web and Social Media (ICWSM) 2026
summary: Social media platforms have become primary channels for health information in the Global South. Using gomutra (cow urine) discourse on YouTube in India as a case study, we present a post-facto Large Language Model (LLM)-assisted discourse analysis of 30 multilingual transcripts showing that promotional content blends sacred traditional language with pseudo-scientific claims in ways that sophisticated debunking content itself mirrors, creating a rhetorical register that LLMs, trained predominantly on Western corpora, are systematically ill-equipped to analyse. Varying prompt tone across three LLMs (GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5 Pro, DeepSeek-V3.1), we find that culturally embedded health misinformation does not look like ordinary misinformation, and this cultural obfuscation extends to gendered rhetoric and prompt design, compounding analytical unreliability. Our findings argue that cultural competency in LLM-assisted discourse analysis cannot be retrofitted through prompt engineering alone.

AI.tldr: 本研究以印度YouTube平台上的"牛尿疗法"话语为案例，探讨了在大规模语言模型（LLM）辅助的跨文化话语分析中，文化嵌入型健康错误信息的识别挑战。研究发现，传统神圣语言与伪科学主张的融合使此类内容难以被主要基于西方语料库训练的LLM准确分析。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体已成为全球南部地区健康信息的主要传播渠道，但现有LLM在分析非西方文化背景下的话语时存在系统性偏差。研究旨在揭示这一文化认知缺口及其对健康信息辨别的深层影响。
AI.method: 采用事后（post-facto）LLM辅助话语分析方法，对30个多语言转录本进行编码分析；在三个LLM（GPT-4o、Gemini 2.5 Pro、DeepSeek-V3.1）上实施不同语气提示词实验，检验模型响应的文化敏感性差异。
AI.result: 促销内容将神圣传统语言与伪科学主张巧妙融合，形成一种LLM难以识别的修辞风格；即便辟谣内容也呈现相似的语言特征，进一步模糊了判断边界；文化嵌入型错误信息具有独特的修辞结构，与常规错误信息形态截然不同；提示词设计中的性别化语言进一步加剧了分析的不稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 文化能力无法仅通过提示工程（prompt engineering）事后补救；LLM的文化偏见具有系统性特征，需要从训练数据和架构层面进行根本性重构，而非依赖表层优化。

title: Focus Session: Hardware and Software Techniques for Accelerating Multimodal Foundation Models
comment: Accepted at the Design, Automation and Test in Europe Conference (DATE), April 20-22, 2026 in Verona, Italy
summary: This work presents a multi-layered methodology for efficiently accelerating multimodal foundation models (MFMs). It combines hardware and software co-design of transformer blocks with an optimization pipeline that reduces computational and memory requirements. During model development, it employs performance enhancements through fine-tuning for domain-specific adaptation. Our methodology further incorporates hardware and software techniques for optimizing MFMs. Specifically, it employs MFM compression using hierarchy-aware mixed-precision quantization and structural pruning for transformer blocks and MLP channels. It also optimizes operations through speculative decoding, model cascading that routes queries through a small-to-large cascade and uses lightweight self-tests to determine when to escalate to larger models, as well as co-optimization of sequence length, visual resolution & stride, and graph-level operator fusion. To efficiently execute the model, the processing dataflow is optimized based on the underlying hardware architecture together with memory-efficient attention to meet on-chip bandwidth and latency budgets. To support this, a specialized hardware accelerator for the transformer workloads is employed, which can be developed through expert design or an LLM-aided design approach. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed methodology on medical-MFMs and on code generation tasks, and conclude with extensions toward energy-efficient spiking-MFMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多层级方法论，通过软硬件协同设计加速多模态基础模型(MFMs)，包括混合精度量化、结构化剪枝、推测解码、模型级联等技术，并配合专用硬件加速器实现高效执行。
AI.motivation: 随着多模态基础模型(MFMs)在医疗和代码生成等领域的广泛应用，其庞大的计算和内存需求成为实际部署的主要瓶颈，需要从算法优化到硬件加速的全栈协同优化方案。
AI.method: 提出多层级协同优化方法：(1)模型压缩层：层次感知混合精度量化和Transformer块及MLP通道的结构化剪枝；(2)推理优化层：推测解码、模型级联路由、序列长度/视觉分辨率/步长协同优化、图级算子融合；(3)硬件适配层：基于底层硬件架构优化数据流、内存高效注意力机制、专用加速器设计(专家设计或LLM辅助设计)。
AI.result: 该方法在医疗MFM和代码生成任务上验证了有效性，并展示了向节能型脉冲MFM的扩展潜力。
AI.conclusion: 本研究建立了从算法到硬件的完整优化pipeline，为MFM的高效部署提供了系统性的解决方案，未来可扩展至神经形态计算领域的脉冲MFM以实现更高能效。

title: Turnstile Streaming Algorithms Might (Still) as Well Be Linear Sketches, for Polynomial-Length Streams
summary:
A fundamental question in streaming complexity is whether every space-efficient turnstile algorithm is implicitly a linear sketch. The landmark work of Li, Nguyen, and Woodruff [LNW14] established an equivalence between the two, but their reduction requires a stream length that is at least doubly exponential in the dimension $n$. In the opposite direction, results by Kallaugher and Price [KP20] demonstrate a separation for streams of linear length, showing that the equivalence does not hold in general. The most natural and practically relevant regime -- polynomial-length streams -- has therefore remained open.
  We show that polynomial-length turnstile algorithms admit linear-sketch simulations. More precisely, if a turnstile algorithm uses $S$ bits of space and succeeds on all streams of length $\mathrm{poly}(D, n)$, then on final vectors $x$ with $\|x\|_2 \le D$, its output can be recovered from $O(S)$ linear measurements of $x$, using $O(S \log S)$ bits overall. For smooth problems under appropriate input distributions, a mollified version of the reduction yields a bounded-entry sketch with $O(S / \log D)$ measurements and optimal $O(S)$ total space. Our results extend to strict turnstile streams and non-uniform Read-Once Branching Programs (ROBPs).
  Our proof departs from prior transition-graph based machinery, relying instead on a Fourier-analytic framework and tools from additive combinatorics to extract discrete linear measurements. Our analysis shows that any $S$-bit algorithm can only be sensitive to a low-dimensional lattice of heavy Fourier frequencies, which we then use to construct the rows of the sketching matrix. Consequently, we obtain new lower bounds for polynomial-length streams via existing real sketching and communication lower bounds.

AI.tldr: 本文解决了流式算法复杂度中的核心开放问题：多项式长度流上的空间高效turnstile算法是否都可以用线性草图模拟。之前的工作要么需要超指数长度的流[LNW14]，要么只证明了线性长度流的分离[KP20]。本文在多项式长度流的自然设定下给出了肯定答案，并利用傅里叶分析和加性组合工具提供了全新的证明框架。
AI.motivation: 流式算法和线性草图是处理大规模数据的两大核心范式。理解二者之间的关系是理论计算机科学的基本问题。之前的工作未能覆盖实际应用中最重要的情形——多项式长度流，因此该问题长期悬而未决。本文的动机是填补这一理论与实践之间的关键gap。
AI.method: 本文放弃了之前基于转移图(transition-graph)的证明技术，转而采用傅里叶分析框架和加性组合工具。核心洞察是：任何S比特算法只能对低维重傅里叶频率格(lattice of heavy Fourier frequencies)敏感，作者利用这一性质构建草图矩阵的行。技术上，通过"软化"(mollified)版本的约化，在适当输入分布下可得到有界条目(bounded-entry)草图。
AI.result: 对于长度为poly(D,n)的多项式流，若turnstile算法使用S比特空间且对所有流成功，则其输出可从x的O(S)个线性测量中恢复，总空间为O(S log S)。在平滑问题和适当输入分布下，软化版本给出O(S/log D)个测量和最优O(S)总空间的草图。结果还可扩展到严格turnstile流和非一致Read-Once Branching Programs (ROBPs)。
AI.conclusion: 本文不仅证明了多项式长度流设定下的等价性，还建立了新的下界（通过已有实草图和通信下界）并提供了完全不同于以往的分析工具。这项工作统一了该领域的两大核心概念，为后续研究奠定了新的技术基础。

title: Implementation and Privacy Guarantees for Scalable Keyword Search on SOLID-based Decentralized Data with Granular Visibility Constraints
summary: In decentralized personal data ecosystems grounded in architectures such as Solid, users retain sovereignty over their data via personal online data stores (pods), hosted on Solid-compliant server infrastructures. In such environments, data remains under the control of pod owners, which complicates search due to distribution across numerous pods and user-specific access constraints. ESPRESSO is a decentralized framework for scalable keyword-based search across distributed Solid pods under user-defined visibility policies. It addresses key challenges of decentralized search by constructing WebID-scoped indexes within pods and employing privacy-aware metadata to enable efficient source selection and ranking across servers. This paper further introduces a formal threat model for ESPRESSO, analysing the security and privacy risks associated with the generation, aggregation, and use of indexes and metadata. These risks include unintended metadata leakage and the potential for adversaries to infer sensitive information about data that resides within personal data stores. The analysis identifies key design principles that limit metadata exposure while mitigating unauthorized inference. The proposed threat model provides a foundation for evaluating privacy-preserving decentralized search and informs the design of systems with stronger privacy guarantees.

AI.tldr: ESPRESSO是一个针对Solid去中心化个人数据生态系统的可扩展关键词搜索框架，通过在pod内构建WebID作用域索引和隐私感知元数据实现跨服务器源选择与排名，同时提出了针对索引生成、聚合和使用的形式化威胁模型，分析了元数据泄露和敏感信息推断风险，并识别了限制元数据暴露的关键设计原则。
AI.motivation: Solid架构下用户数据分散存储于多个pod中，且受用户定义的访问策略控制，传统集中式搜索无法适用。如何在保障用户数据主权的前提下实现高效、可扩展的去中心化搜索，同时防止索引和元数据带来的隐私泄露风险，是核心挑战。
AI.method: 1) 在各pod内构建WebID作用域索引；2) 采用隐私感知元数据支持跨服务器源选择与排名；3) 提出形式化威胁模型，分析索引生成、聚合和使用全链路的安全与隐私风险；4) 识别关键设计原则以限制元数据暴露并缓解未授权推断攻击。
AI.result: 分析揭示了去中心化搜索中的关键隐私威胁，包括元数据意外泄露和对手推断pod内敏感信息的能力。基于威胁分析，提出了限制元数据暴露的设计原则，为构建具有更强隐私保障的去中心化搜索系统提供了理论依据。
AI.conclusion: 该威胁模型为评估隐私保护去中心化搜索提供了评估框架，指导了兼具功能性与隐私性的系统设计方向。

title: The Biggest Risk of Embodied AI is Governance Lag
summary: Embodied AI is widely discussed as a job-displacement problem. The deeper risk, however, is governance lag: the inability of public institutions to keep pace with how fast the technology spreads through the physical economy. As reusable robotic platforms are combined with increasingly general AI models, embodied AI may scale across manufacturing, logistics, care, and infrastructure faster than governance systems can observe, interpret, and respond. We argue that this lag appears in three connected forms: observational, institutional, and distributive. The central policy challenge, therefore, is not automation alone, but whether governance and compliance systems can adapt before disruption becomes entrenched.

AI.tldr: 本文认为具身AI带来的更深层风险不是就业替代，而是治理滞后：公共机构无法跟上技术向实体经济扩散的速度。随着可复用机器人平台与日益通用的AI模型结合，具身AI可能在制造、物流、医疗、基础设施等领域快速扩展，而治理系统无法及时观察、理解和响应。
AI.motivation: 传统观点将具身AI主要视为就业替代问题，但本文认为这一视角过于狭隘。作者指出更具根本性的风险在于治理能力的滞后——技术变革的速度远超公共机构的适应能力，可能在监管体系反应过来之前就已造成难以逆转的颠覆。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，提出三层次治理滞后：观测滞后（难以监测技术扩散）、制度滞后（监管框架更新缓慢）、分配滞后（技术利益的分配不均）。
AI.result: 识别出治理滞后以三种相互关联的形式存在，这要求政策制定者不仅关注自动化本身，更要确保治理和合规系统在颠覆固化之前具备适应能力。
AI.conclusion: 具身AI的核心政策挑战在于治理适应性，而非单纯的自动化问题。

title: DM$^3$-Nav: Decentralized Multi-Agent Multimodal Multi-Object Semantic Navigation
summary: We present DM$^3$-Nav, a fully decentralized multi-agent semantic navigation system supporting multimodal open-vocabulary goal specification and multi-object missions. In our setting, decentralization implies operation without a central coordinator, global map aggregation, or shared global state at runtime. Robots operate autonomously and coordinate through ad-hoc pairwise communication, exchanging local maps, goal status, and navigation intent without synchronization. An implicit task allocation mechanism combining intent broadcasting and distance-weighted frontier selection reduces redundant exploration while preserving decentralized operation. Evaluations on HM3DSem scenes using the HM3Dv0.2 and GOAT-Bench datasets demonstrate that DM$^3$-Nav matches or exceeds centralized and shared-map baselines while eliminating single points of failure inherent in centralized architectures. Finally, we validate our approach in a real-world office environment using two mobile robots, demonstrating successful deployment relying entirely on onboard sensing and computation. A video of our real-world experiments is available online: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1QiUSCn5rIvtuTUqtuXLPgmt6S8x9-MCZ/view?usp=drive_link

AI.tldr: DM³-Nav是一个完全去中心化的多智能体语义导航系统，支持多模态开放词汇目标规范和多目标任务，通过临时点对点通信协调，无需中央协调器或全局地图，在HM3DSem场景和真实办公环境中验证了性能可匹配甚至超越集中式基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的多智能体导航系统通常依赖中央协调器、全球地图聚合或共享全局状态，存在单点故障风险，且难以扩展到动态和真实环境。开放词汇目标规范和多目标任务导航在实际应用中需求日益增长，但现有方法大多假设集中式架构，限制了其鲁棒性和灵活性。
AI.method: 提出完全去中心化的多智能体语义导航框架DM³-Nav，采用无同步的临时成对通信机制，交换局部地图、目标状态和导航意图；设计意图广播与距离加权前沿选择相结合的隐式任务分配机制以减少冗余探索；支持多模态开放词汇目标规范和多目标任务。
AI.result: 在HM3DSem场景（HM3Dv0.2和GOAT-Bench数据集）上的评估表明，DM³-Nav的性能可匹配或超越集中式和共享地图基线方法；在真实办公环境中使用两台移动机器人进行验证，证明了完全依赖机载传感和计算的成功部署能力。
AI.conclusion: DM³-Nav成功实现了无需中央协调的分布式多智能体导航，在保持去中心化优势（消除单点故障）的同时达到与集中式方法相当的性能，为真实世界的多智能体机器人系统提供了一种鲁棒、可扩展的解决方案。

title: Can QPP Choose the Right Query Variant? Evaluating Query Variant Selection for RAG Pipelines
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have made query reformulation ubiquitous in modern retrieval and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, enabling the generation of multiple semantically equivalent query variants. However, executing the full pipeline for every reformulation is computationally expensive, motivating selective execution: can we identify the best query variant before incurring downstream retrieval and generation costs? We investigate Query Performance Prediction (QPP) as a mechanism for variant selection across ad-hoc retrieval and end-to-end RAG. Unlike traditional QPP, which estimates query difficulty across topics, we study intra-topic discrimination - selecting the optimal reformulation among competing variants of the same information need. Through large-scale experiments on TREC-RAG using both sparse and dense retrievers, we evaluate pre- and post-retrieval predictors under correlation- and decision-based metrics. Our results reveal a systematic divergence between retrieval and generation objectives: variants that maximize ranking metrics such as nDCG often fail to produce the best generated answers, exposing a "utility gap" between retrieval relevance and generation fidelity. Nevertheless, QPP can reliably identify variants that improve end-to-end quality over the original query. Notably, lightweight pre-retrieval predictors frequently match or outperform more expensive post-retrieval methods, offering a latency-efficient approach to robust RAG.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了大语言模型生成的查询改写变体选择问题，提出使用查询性能预测（QPP）机制在RAG管道中识别最优查询变体，避免为所有变体执行完整检索和生成流程的计算开销。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM查询改写会生成多个语义等价的查询变体，为每个变体执行完整RAG管道计算成本高昂。需要一种机制在产生下游检索和生成成本之前识别最优变体，以实现选择性执行。
AI.method: 在TREC-RAG数据集上，使用稀疏和密集检索器进行大规模实验；评估检索前和检索后预测器，采用基于相关性和基于决策的评估指标；研究主题内区分——在相同信息需求的不同改写变体中选择最优者。
AI.result: 揭示了检索与生成目标之间的系统性分歧：最大化nDCG等排序指标的变体往往无法产生最佳生成答案，暴露出检索相关性与生成保真度之间的"效用差距"。尽管如此，QPP可可靠识别超越原始查询的改进变体。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级检索前预测器经常匹敌或超越更昂贵的检索后方法，为稳健RAG提供延迟高效的选择方案；QPP可有效用于变体选择，但需针对生成目标而非仅检索指标进行优化。

title: FlashSpread: IO-Aware GPU Simulation of Non-Markovian Epidemic Dynamics via Kernel Fusion
summary: Non-Markovian (renewal) epidemic simulation on multi-million-node contact networks is essential for realistic forecasting under general age-dependent holding-time distributions (log-normal, Weibull, Erlang, and similar), but the age-dependent hazard forces dense per-step updates that render the sparse event-queue strategies of standard CPU methods ineffective. We present FlashSpread, a GPU framework that consolidates the per-step renewal pipeline (CSR traversal, numerically stable erfcx-based hazard evaluation, Bernoulli tau-leaping, state transition, and next-step infectivity write-back) into a single fused Triton kernel whose intermediates never leave streaming-multiprocessor registers, with block-scalar skips that preserve CUDA Graph capture and a degree-aware CSR dispatch (thread / warp / edge-merge) that keeps the peak throughput on scale-free graphs. On an NVIDIA A100 the fused CUDA-Graph engine reaches 8.09 Giga-NUPS at N = 10^6 on a uniform-degree graph, a 217x strict hardware speedup over optimised CPU tau-leaping at the same N; on a Barabasi-Albert graph of the same size the merge-based dispatch recovers 4.5x (0.45 to 2.0 Giga-NUPS) over the default kernel, and the framework scales to N = 10^8 on a single A100 (40 GB), with a mixed-precision storage path that extends the L2-reachable scale by roughly 3x and delivers a 1.15x throughput lift at the far bandwidth-bound end. Validation against an exact non-Markovian Gillespie reference shows a structural-bias floor of approximately 6% on peak infection and approximately 7% on final attack rate that does not detectably decrease as epsilon nears 0 across two decades of tolerance, comfortably within typical epidemiological parameter uncertainty. Code: https://github.com/Shakeri-Lab/FlashSpread.

AI.tldr: FlashSpread 是一个开源的 GPU 框架，用单个融合 Triton 内核把非马尔可夫（再生过程）网络 epidemic 的每步更新流水线（CSR 遍历 + erfcx 稳定对数正态风险率 + Bernoulli tau-leaping + 状态转移 + 下一步感染力回写）全部塞进一次启动，中间量全部留在 SM 寄存器中，并配合块级稀疏跳过、基于 D_max/D_avg 的三种 CSR 遍历自动调度、CUDA Graph 批捕获、活跃节点压缩与混合精度存储。在单张 A100 上 N=10^6 规则图达 8.09 Giga-NUPS（同算法 CPU tau-leaping 基线的 217×），Barabási–Albert 图通过 merge 调度恢复 4.5×（0.45→2.0 G-NUPS），可扩展到 N=10^8；与精确非马尔可夫 Gillespie 参考相比存在 ~6%（峰值感染）/~7%（最终罹患率）的结构性偏差下限，与 ε 无关，落在流行病学参数不确定度内。
AI.motivation: 生物真实的潜伏期/传染期往往呈单峰非指数分布（log-normal、Weibull、Erlang），指数（马尔可夫）假设会显著歪曲流行峰值与基本再生数，因此需要非马尔可夫（再生/更新过程）网络 epidemic 模拟。但年龄依赖风险率 h(τ)=f(τ)/S(τ) 随时间连续变化，每一步必须对全部 N 个节点做稠密更新，CPU 上稀疏事件队列策略（Gillespie、Phantom Process 的"幻影事件"、NEXT-Net 的 next-reaction）被 O(N) 稠密并行度需求彻底堵死；而现有 GPU epidemic 工作只覆盖马尔可夫情形。另一方面，同步 tau-leaping 虽能暴露稠密并行度，但在网络结构上会引入"同步更新"误差，缺少对其精度的系统刻画与可扩展的 GPU 框架。因此需要一个开源、端到端、面向非马尔可夫网络传播的 GPU 框架，同时把"算法近似误差"与"硬件加速"分离度量。
AI.method: 1) 双引擎架构：马尔可夫引擎（Inertial 模式 O(K·D_avg/P) 稀疏原子更新 + 每 200 事件一次全量重算的 Control 模式）与再生/更新引擎（稠密 O((N+E)/P)），二者共享 FlashNeighbor 核。2) 融合 Triton 内核（Algorithm 3）：入边 CSR gather 遍历累加压力到寄存器 → 数值稳定的对数正态风险率 h_LN=√(2/π)/(τσ·erfcx(z)) → 自适应步长 Δt=min(Δt_max, ε/(max λ+δ)) → Bernoulli 采样 p=1-e^{-λΔt} → 状态转移与年龄重置 → 下一步感染力回写，全部一次启动完成，中间量不出寄存器，HBM 流量由 ~64N 字节/步降到 ~20N 字节/步；Triton 内以分段恒等式(|z|≤3.5) + 四项渐近展开(|z|>3.5) + 反射公式实现 erfcx（最大相对误差 ~4e-2@z≈3.5，其余 ~6e-3）。3) 块级稀疏：通过 any_E/any_I 块归约产生真正的硬件分支（而非 lane 谓词），跳过惰性块的 erfcx，同时保持 CUDA Graph 可捕获。4) CUDA Graph 捕获 b=50 步重复，持久化 τ_prev 与 step_id 计数器式 RNG。5) 面向度的 CSR 调度：thread/warp/edge-partitioned merge（Merrill & Garland 风格，二分查找 row_ptr 归属节点 + atomicAdd 压力缓冲 + 轻量尾核），按 ρ=D_max/D_avg 以阈值 (4,50) 自动选择。6) 源点近似（对应 Boguñá 的 Rule 2）：感染力 ρ=β·s(τ_j)·1{X_j=I}，避免 O(E×M) 的逐边年龄。7) 活跃节点压缩（Fixed-Grid Early-Exit）：仅保留非 R 节点，网格固定为 ⌈N/B⌉，用 num_active + 掩码 gather 实现，刷新放在 replay 边界。8) 混合精度存储：int8 状态、fp16 年龄、bf16 感染力与边权，全部累加器与核内数学保持 fp32，加载即提升、存储才降精度。另记录负面结果：RCM 重排仅 1.035×（低于预注册 1.05× 阈值，且 593 s 预处理不可摊销）而被否决。验证对照精确非马尔可夫 Gillespie（SEIR）与 Doob–Gillespie（SIS/SIR）。
AI.result: 吞吐分解（N=10^6, ER d=8, A100）：精确 CPU Phantom Process ~70 trans/s → CPU tau-leaping 37.3 M-NUPS（算法松弛 ~5×10^5×）→ GPU 非融合 eager 0.67 → 非融合 CUDA Graph 1.87（2.8×）→ 融合 CUDA Graph 8.09 G-NUPS（4.3× 融合增益），合计对同算法 CPU 基线 217× 严格硬件加速。BA m=4（D_max=3,870，ρ≈484）默认线程核仅 0.45 G-NUPS，merge 调度达 2.00（4.5×），规则图自动选 thread 保峰值。扩展性：N=10^7 出现"L2 悬崖"（CSR ~640 MB > 40 MB L2），混合精度给 2.32×（1.33→3.10 M events/s）；N=10^8 处于 HBM 带宽受限端，混合精度仍给 1.15×，工作集压缩约 3× 从而把 L2 可达规模外推约 3×，单卡 40 GB 可容纳 N=10^8。Roofline：AI 由 0.66 降至 0.42（块级稀疏移除无效 erfcx FLOPs），555 GFLOPS，在自身 AI 下的带宽利用率为 64.8%，等效 ~1321 GB/s（A100 峰值 2039 GB/s）；叠加混合精度后 AI 升至 ~0.62、638 GFLOPS。年龄依赖脱落曲线：核内融合后开销仅 +1.8%（规则图）/+0.1%（BA），而独立 PyTorch 前置 pass 为 +45.5%。活跃节点压缩在 BA 上整程 1.53×（末期窗口 4.8×，活跃节点降至 ~3%N）、规则图 0.99×，且检查点舱室计数逐位一致。精度：与精确非马尔可夫 Gillespie 相比峰值感染误差 ~6%、最终罹患率 ~7%，在 ε∈[0.005,0.2] 两个数量级内不随 ε 减小而下降（bootstrap 斜率 +0.024 与 +0.031，95% CI 均含 0），作者判定为同步 Bernoulli 更新的结构性偏差下限；自一致性误差则按 O(ε) 正常衰减。混合精度对最终罹患率影响 0.00–0.08%，远低于该偏差下限。
AI.conclusion: FlashSpread 确立了"IO 感知内核融合 + 度感知调度"这一计算路径在非马尔可夫网络 epidemic 上的可行性：它把稠密 O(N+E) 更新转成单次启动、寄存器内完成、带块级稀疏的 GPU 流水线，并在同算法对照下把加速因子严格归因于硬件/实现（217×），同时以"精确参考 + ε 扫描 + 误差分解"的方式诚实刻画 tau-leaping 的结构性偏差下限（~6–7%，不随 ε 收敛），从而为集合预报与政策评估提供可复现、参数明确的基础。作者明确界定其适用边界：同步 tau-leaping 近似（不可与 NEXT-Net 的精确 CPU 模拟直接比较）；不覆盖剂量依赖传播、独立生灭边的时序网络、需精确复现异质易感性的逐边动力学（需 O(E) 逐边年龄）；active-node 压缩与混合精度目前仅接入 thread/merge 内核、属用户可选开关。后续方向包括：跨 N≳10^8 的多 GPU 域分解、以 __shfl_up_sync 实现 warp 内分段归约以缓解 BA 枢纽的 atomicAdd 竞争（估算 1.3–1.8×，尚未原型验证）、与块级遍历匹配的 cache-line 感知重排（Rabbit/Gorder）、以及关于 ε、网络谱隙与度分布的严格收敛性定理（把"无可检测下降"提升为可证界限）。

title: An Artifact-based Agent Framework for Adaptive and Reproducible Medical Image Processing
summary: Medical imaging research is increasingly shifting from controlled benchmark evaluation toward real-world clinical deployment. In such settings, applying analytical methods extends beyond model design to require dataset-aware workflow configuration and provenance tracking. Two requirements therefore become central: \textbf{adaptability}, the ability to configure workflows according to dataset-specific conditions and evolving analytical goals; and \textbf{reproducibility}, the guarantee that all transformations and decisions are explicitly recorded and re-executable. Here, we present an artifact-based agent framework that introduces a semantic layer to augment medical image processing. The framework formalizes intermediate and final outputs through an artifact contract, enabling structured interrogation of workflow state and goal-conditioned assembly of configurations from a modular rule library. Execution is delegated to a workflow executor to preserve deterministic computational graph construction and provenance tracking, while the agent operates locally to comply with most privacy constraints. We evaluate the framework on real-world clinical CT and MRI cohorts, demonstrating adaptive configuration synthesis, deterministic reproducibility across repeated executions, and artifact-grounded semantic querying. These results show that adaptive workflow configuration can be achieved without compromising reproducibility in heterogeneous clinical environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于工件的智能体框架，通过语义层增强医学图像处理，实现工作流的适应性配置与可重复性保障，在真实临床CT和MRI数据集上验证了该框架的有效性。
AI.motivation: 医学影像研究正从受控基准评估转向真实临床部署，需要解决两大核心挑战：1）适应性——根据数据集特定条件和分析目标配置工作流；2）可重复性——确保所有转换和决策可被明确记录并重新执行。传统方法难以同时满足这两个需求。
AI.method: 提出基于工件的智能体框架，引入语义层增强医学图像处理。核心机制包括：1）工件契约（artifact contract）形式化定义中间和最终输出；2）模块化规则库支持目标驱动的配置组装；3）工作流执行器委托计算以保持确定性计算图构建和溯源追踪；4）智能体本地运行以符合隐私约束。
AI.result: 在真实临床CT和MRI数据集上验证：实现了适应性配置合成、跨多次执行的确定性可重复性、以及基于工件约束的语义查询能力。
AI.conclusion: 在不损害可重复性的前提下，异构临床环境中可实现适应性工作流配置。该框架为医学影像分析从实验室到临床部署的转化提供了可行方案。

title: A systematic review of generative AI usage for IT project management
summary: This paper aims to synthesize current knowledge on generative AI in IT project management using the PRISMA methodology to provide researchers with a comprehensive perspective on techniques, applications, adoption trends, limitations, and integration across project management tools and process groups. The analysis reveals a clear dominance of OpenAI's GPT in the included studies but relying primarily on prompt engineering, suggesting that research in this area remains at an exploratory stage. Finally, it identifies and discusses three promising research directions for AI-enabled project management, including process group-specific AI agents, project role-based AI agents, and hybrid collaborative networks that enable human-guided orchestration.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇基于PRISMA系统综述方法的文献计量/综述研究，聚焦生成式AI（如ChatGPT/GPT）在IT项目管理中的技术、应用、采纳趋势、局限性，以及与项目管理工具和过程组的整合情况。主要发现是：现有研究高度集中于OpenAI的GPT模型，技术路线上主要依赖提示工程（prompt engineering），整体仍处于探索阶段。作者最后提出三个有前景的研究方向：面向过程组的AI智能体、面向项目角色的AI智能体，以及支持人类引导编排的混合协作网络。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI（如大语言模型）正快速渗透IT项目管理的规划、执行、监控与收尾等环节，但相关研究分散、缺乏系统梳理：不同技术路线与模型的选择、应用场景分布、实际采纳程度、已知局限，以及与既有项目管理工具（如Jira、MS Project、Trello等）和PMBOK过程组之间的整合关系均不清晰。此外，既有工作多停留在概念验证与提示词层面，缺少对整体研究图谱与知识缺口的结构化识别，因此需要一次遵循PRISMA规范化流程的系统综述，为研究者提供统一视角并指明后续研究议程。
AI.method: 采用PRISMA（Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses）方法学开展系统文献综述：设定检索策略与纳入/排除标准，在多个学术数据库中检索相关文献，进行筛选与去重后纳入研究样本；再对纳入文献进行编码与主题综合，涵盖所用生成式AI模型/技术、主要应用场景、项目管理工具与过程组覆盖情况、采纳与部署趋势、所报告的局限性（伦理、幻觉、可靠性、安全、集成难度等）以及人机协作方式，并进行描述性统计与分类归类，最终归纳出研究空白与未来方向。
AI.result: 综述分析显示：（1）模型层面呈现明显的主导集中，纳入研究绝大多数采用OpenAI的GPT系列模型，其他生成式AI模型涉及很少；（2）技术实现上主要依赖提示工程，尚未出现成熟的智能体化、检索增强、工作流编排或领域微调等系统性工程方案；（3）应用已初步覆盖项目管理多个环节与多种工具生态，但分布不均、场景较浅，多为辅助性任务（文档生成、需求梳理、状态摘要、风险提示、沟通辅助）而非端到端决策支持；（4）研究多以探索性、原型式和概念验证为主，缺少真实项目环境下的纵向评估、大规模对照实验与量化效益指标；（5）研究普遍报告了幻觉、输出不可靠、数据隐私与保密、偏差、审计与责任归属、以及与传统工具链和治理流程集成困难等局限；（6）人机关系上以"人主导、AI辅助"为主导形态，自动化程度较低。作者据此判定该领域整体仍处于早期探索阶段。
AI.conclusion: 生成式AI在IT项目管理中展现出明确但尚不成熟的潜力：GPT系列模型事实上已成为研究界的事实标准平台，提示工程是当前主要且最低门槛的技术手段，而与项目管理工具及过程组的整合仍处于零散、原型化的探索阶段。论文强调，本领域研究尚缺乏系统性、实证化的方法论支撑与统一评估框架，短期内不宜将生成式AI视为可替代项目经理判断的自治决策系统，而应定位为增强型、人类在环的辅助能力。作者提出三个优先研究方向：（1）过程组专属AI智能体——针对启动、规划、执行、监控、收尾等具体过程组构建专用智能体，以提升任务级准确性与上下文适配性；（2）项目角色导向的AI智能体——为项目经理、项目成员、敏捷教练等不同角色定制能力与交互方式，以支撑角色特定的决策与协作需求；（3）支持人类引导编排的混合协作网络——构建多智能体与人类专家协同的混合网络架构，由人负责目标设定、监督与仲裁，实现可控的编排与责任追溯。这些方向旨在将研究从"提示层面的工具应用"推进到"系统化、可治理的人机协同生态"，并为后续实证验证与落地治理框架奠定基础。

title: Shared Lexical Task Representations Explain Behavioral Variability In LLMs
summary: One of the most common complaints about large language models (LLMs) is their prompt sensitivity -- that is, the fact that their ability to perform a task or provide a correct answer to a question can depend unpredictably on the way the question is posed. We investigate this variation by comparing two very different but commonly-used styles of prompting: instruction-based prompts, which describe the task in natural language, and example-based prompts, which provide in-context few-shot demonstration pairs to illustrate the task. We find that, despite large variation in performance as a function of the prompt, the model engages some common underlying mechanisms across different prompts of a task. Specifically, we identify task-specific attention heads whose outputs literally describe the task -- which we dub lexical task heads -- and show that these heads are shared across prompting styles and trigger subsequent answer production. We further find that behavioral variation between prompts can be explained by the degree to which these heads are activated, and that failures are at least sometimes due to competing task representations that dilute the signal of the target task. Our results together present an increasingly clear picture of how LLMs' internal representations can explain behavior that otherwise seems idiosyncratic to users and developers.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）对提示风格的敏感性，发现指令式提示和示例式提示虽然表现差异大，但模型内部共享相同的任务表征机制。核心发现是存在"词汇任务头"——一类任务特异性注意力头，其输出直接描述任务内容，并触发后续答案生成。行为差异可归因于这些头的激活程度，而失败则源于竞争性任务表征稀释了目标任务的信号。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型普遍存在提示敏感性——任务表现高度依赖于问题表述方式，这给实际应用带来不确定性。虽然直觉上指令式和示例式提示风格差异巨大，但这种表面差异是否意味着模型内部机制也完全不同？这一问题尚未得到充分解答。
AI.method:
1) 对比两种提示风格（指令式与示例式）在同一任务上的表现
2) 识别模型中任务特异性注意力头
3) 分析这些注意力头的输出是否直接描述任务（即"词汇任务头"）
4) 检验这些机制是否跨提示风格共享
5) 量化激活程度与行为表现的关系
AI.result:
1) 尽管提示风格导致性能大幅波动，模型确实依赖共同的基础机制
2) 存在"词汇任务头"——其输出直接编码任务描述
3) 这些头跨指令式和示例式提示共享
4) 行为差异由词汇任务头的激活程度解释
5) 失败案例源于竞争性任务表征稀释了目标任务的信号
AI.conclusion: LLM的提示敏感性并非源于根本性机制差异，而是源于同一内部表征的激活强度不同。这为理解和改进LLM提供新视角：可通过调控任务头的激活或减少竞争表征来提升提示鲁棒性。

title: Performance Anomaly Detection in Athletics: A Benchmarking System with Visual Analytics
summary: Anti-doping programs rely on biological testing to detect performance-enhancing drugs, but such testing costs over $800 per sample and is limited by short detection windows for many prohibited substances. These constraints leave large portions of athletes without regular testing, motivating complementary screening approaches that analyze routine competition results to identify suspicious performance patterns. We present a system that processes 1.6 million athletics performances from over 19,000 competitions (2010-2025) using eight detection methods ranging from statistical rules to machine learning and trajectory analysis. We validate all methods against publicly confirmed anti-doping violations to measure their effectiveness in identifying sanctioned athletes. Trajectory-based methods, which compare performances to expected career progression, achieve the best balance between detecting violations and limiting false alarms, though all methods face challenges from incomplete data and rare confirmed violations. The system provides an interactive interface for expert-driven investigation, emphasizing transparency and human judgment to support, rather than replace, established anti-doping processes.

AI.tldr: 研究团队开发了一套整合八种检测方法的反兴奋剂筛查系统，分析了来自19,000场比赛的160万条运动成绩数据。基于轨迹的检测方法表现最优，可作为现有生物检测的补充工具，帮助识别可疑成绩模式。
AI.motivation: 传统生物检测成本高昂（每样本超800美元），且对许多禁用物质的检测窗口有限，导致大量运动员无法获得常规检测，因此需要补充性的筛查方法。
AI.method: 使用八种检测方法处理160万条体育成绩记录，涵盖统计规则、机器学习和轨迹分析等技术。所有方法均通过已公开确认的反兴奋剂违规案例进行验证。
AI.result: 基于轨迹的方法（将成绩与预期职业发展轨迹对比）取得了违规检测与误报控制之间的最佳平衡。
AI.conclusion: 系统提供交互式界面供专家调查，强调透明度和人类判断，以支持而非替代现有反兴奋剂流程。所有方法都面临数据不完整和确认违规样本稀缺的挑战。

title: Cuts and Gauges for Submodular Width
summary: Submodular width is a central structural measure governing the complexity of conjunctive query evaluation. In this paper we recast submodular width in geometric terms. We how that submodular width can be approximated, up to a factor $3/2$, by a new branchwidth parameter defined in terms of edge separations in the hypergraph and the costs induced on them by admissible submodular functions. This reformulation turns lower bounds on submodular width into the problem of constructing well-balanced edge separations whose induced cost remains small. We then express this connection through a variational characterisation in terms of a convex body. Using these tools, we relate submodular width to more familiar graph-theoretic notions, including line-graph treewidth and multicommodity flow, and obtain general conditions under which submodular width is tightly linked to generalised hypertree width. In particular, under various natural conditions we show that \[ subw(H) \in Ω\left(\frac{ghw(H)}{\log ghw(H)} \right). \]

AI.tldr: 本文将子模宽度重新定义为几何形式，通过边缘分离和允许的子模函数诱导的成本来近似（因子3/2），并将子模宽度的下界转化为构造成本较小的平衡边缘分离问题。
AI.motivation: 子模宽度是控制合取查询评估复杂性的核心结构度量，现有研究缺乏对其几何解释和与经典图论参数的明确联系。
AI.method: 引入基于超图边缘分离和子模函数诱导成本的新分支宽度参数；建立变分特征化（凸体形式）；建立与线图树宽和多商品流的联系。
AI.result: 证明了子模宽度可通过新分支宽度参数在因子3/2内近似；给出子模宽度与广义超树宽度的紧密联系条件；在自然条件下证明 subw(H) ∈ Ω(ghw(H)/log ghw(H))。
AI.conclusion: 子模宽度与广义超树宽度之间存在对数因子内的紧密关系，为查询评估的复杂性分析提供了新的几何视角。

title: MCI: A Maximal Clique Index for Efficient Arbitrary-Filtered Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
summary: Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search with arbitrary filtering predicates (AFANNS) is essential for modern data applications, yet existing methods often incur substantial storage and computational costs. In this work, we introduce the Maximal Clique Index (\mci), a novel graph-based index designed for robust and efficient AFANNS. The core idea of \mci is to approximate a dense Nearest Neighbor Graph (NNG) through a compact, clique-based representation. We propose two key techniques: (1) Maximal Clique Cover (\mcc), which exploits the geometric transitivity of high-dimensional spaces to encode dense neighborhoods as maximal cliques, achieving an index with high compression and connectivity; and (2) Local Neighborhood Graph Geometric Densification, a strategy that constructs an index approximating a large NNG from a sparse initial NNG, recovers global connectivity by progressively increasing distance thresholds to locally densify the structure. The index is built in a lock-free parallel manner for scalability and queried via a carefully-designed multi-seed strategy to handle fragmented predicate-induced subgraphs. Extensive experiments on 10 datasets show that \mci significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods by up to one order of magnitude in QPS at high recall while using substantially smaller space, and remains competitive even on range/keyword filtering tasks, demonstrating robust general-purpose performance.

AI.tldr: MCI（Maximal Clique Index）是面向任意过滤近似近邻搜索（AFANNS）的首个基于最大团的图索引。其核心思想是用最大团覆盖（MCC）紧凑表示一个稠密的 k-NNG：先构建稀疏的 k′-NNG（k′≤200），利用高维空间距离集中现象证明的局部传递性（定理3.4），通过逐步加倍距离阈值 α 的“局部邻域图几何致密化”挖掘出大小 ≥τ 的最大团，从而在不显式存储稠密邻接表的前提下获得远超 k′ 的有效出度（实测 300–2000+）；查询时用 beam search 结合 ε√n 多随机种子初始化应对谓词导致的诱导子图碎裂。实验表明其在高召回区间 QPS 最高可提升一个数量级，索引大小不超过 ACORN/HNSW 的 23%，端到端构建时间约为 ACORN 的 43%，且在 range/keyword 过滤任务上仍具竞争力。
AI.motivation: 任意过滤近似近邻搜索（AFANNS）要求在向量相似度检索的同时满足任意谓词（关键词、范围、时间戳等异构元数据），是 RAG、推荐、多媒体检索等现代应用的刚需。现有方案存在结构性缺陷：(1) 传统邻近图索引（HNSW、NSG）每点出度固定为 M，过滤后有效邻居期望降为 M·s，低选择率（s=0.01, M=32）时大量节点有效出度为 0，诱导子图碎裂导致遍历中断；(2) SOTA 的 ACORN 需把邻接表扩展到 M·γ（γ≈1/s）以保证过滤后仍剩 M 个有效邻居，并借助二跳连接近似，虽缓解内存爆炸但存储与查询性能仍不理想；(3) 预过滤复杂度 O(sn) 不可扩展，后过滤需取 O(k/s) 候选，在低选择率下退化；(4) 各类专用方法（SeRF、iRangeGraph、UNG、NHQ 等）依赖特定特征类型（标量序关系或离散集合语义）与静态谓词假设，无法同时利用异构特征、也无法处理 ad-hoc 谓词（构建时未知、分布不可预测）；(5) 学习类方法（如 SIEVE）假设查询服从历史分布，在冷启动/动态场景失效。因此需要一种既保持普适性（谓词无关、特征无关）又具备高连通性与高压缩率的图索引。
AI.method: 方法由三部分组成。（1）理论基石（定理 3.4，局部连通性）：在高维空间中距离集中现象下（建模为 N(μ,σ²) 且 μ/σ > √(2ln n)），若 v,w ∈ N_k(u) 且 d(v,w) ≤ α·d(u,x)（x 为 u 的最近邻），则以概率趋近 1 有 v ∈ N_k(w)；证明利用最近邻距离的下尾集中界与 Mill 不等式，得出"邻居的邻居极可能互为邻居"的传递性，说明 k′-NNG 的局部邻域天然富含团结构。（2）构建算法（Algorithm 1）：先用 NN-Descent 构建 k′-NNG（k′≤200，仅构建期使用，之后丢弃）；对每个未覆盖节点 u，取局部邻域 V′=N_k′(u)∪{u}，以阈值 t=α·d_min 在 V′ 上诱导子图，用线性时间贪心算法为每个未覆盖节点挖掘包含它的最大团，大小 ≥τ 则纳入索引并标记覆盖；α 从 1.2 起每轮加倍，直至全覆盖；α 达 α_max 仍无团时把整个 V′ 作为"伪团"作为桥接（处理孤立节点）；对被超过 n/100 个团覆盖的"超级中心"节点做剪枝以抑制查询开销。实现上采用无锁并行：每线程私有团集合 + 位图原子更新覆盖掩码，最末合并。复杂度：时间 O(T + r·n·(k′)²·D)，r = O(min(log₂α_max, log Δ))，实际首 1–2 轮即覆盖大部分节点；空间 O(nk′)。定义 τ-MCC（τ-最大团覆盖）：每点至少被一个大小 ≥τ 的最大团覆盖，MCI 即为一个 τ-MCC，节点邻域定义为包含该点的所有团的并集。（3）查询算法（Algorithm 2）：多种子 beam search——用蓄水池采样抽取 ε√n 个满足谓词的随机种子，取其中最近 l_s 个作为起点；随后贪心取 R\E 中距查询最近的点 p，展开其所在全部最大团，将未访问且满足谓词的成员插入优先队列 R（仅保留 top-l_s），直至无法扩展。种子数取 ε√n 兼顾各连通分量覆盖与低选择率下的散落分量；ε 应与选择率成反比。实现复用 Vamana 的有序向量 + 位图 visited 结构，谓词预计算为布尔向量。复杂度 O(ε√n + (sn)^0.55)。
AI.result: 在 10 个数据集（sift1M、deep1M、glove2.2m、gist1M、wit、spacev10M、movielens、audio、nuswide、tripclick）上与 ACORN、Faiss/Milvus-HNSW、IVFPQ 及 range/keyword 专用方法对比。（1）混合选择率下 Recall@10–QPS：MCI 全面占据高召回区间，wit 上 recall 95% 时 QPS 领先一个数量级；deep1M 上 recall>99.5% 时达 739.7 QPS，而最优基线 Milvus-HNSW 仅 197.8 QPS（3.7×）；所有数据集召回均 >98%，而 ACORN 在多个数据集无法达到 99%（低选择率 s≈0.001 时诱导子图过稀）。（2）索引大小：不超过 ACORN/HNSW 的 23%，在 8 个数据集中 6 个小于 IVFPQ，其余在 1.6× 以内；索引内整数数/n 最大 46.29。（3）构建时间：端到端仅为 ACORN 的 43%（平均），快于 ACORN，慢于 HNSW。（4）不同选择率（s=0.5…0.005）：Recall@10≥95% 且 s≤0.01 时 MCI 全面优于 ACORN；tripclick s=0.01 时 Milvus-HNSW 达 99.98% 召回但仅 614 QPS，MCI 以 3147 QPS 达 96%、1499 QPS 达 98.8%（5×/2.4×）。（5）range 过滤（sift1M/glove2.2m/nuswide）与 keyword 过滤（deep1M/glove2.2m/wit）上与专用方法 iRange、SuperPF、Unify、SeRF、UNG、NHQ 相当甚至略优；无过滤场景下仍具竞争力。（6）参数敏感性：性能主要由 k′ 决定，τ 几乎不敏感；最优 ε 与选择率成反比（tripclick s=0.005 时 ε 从 0.01→1，召回 97.06%→97.8%）；α 加倍时 α=2 已覆盖 60%+ 节点，α≥α_max 全覆盖；对 k′-NNG 质量（Recall@k′ 从 0.39 到 0.91）和 α 扩张比例（1.25–2.0）均不敏感。（7）平均出度远超 k′（k′=100 时 >300，k′=200 时可达 2000+），是低选择率高召回的直接原因。（8）并行扩展性：32/64 线程下 MCI 加速比 17.31/22.76，优于 ACORN 的 13.10/10.91（后者依赖 HNSW 锁）。
AI.conclusion: MCI 证明了在高维向量检索中，极度压缩的最大团表示可以替代显式的稠密邻接表来维持过滤后的连通性，从而同时解决 AFANNS 的"存储爆炸"与"低选择率下遍历断裂"两大痛点。其贡献在于：首个面向 AFANNS 的最大团索引、基于几何传递性定理的可扩展构建算法（近线性实际复杂度、无锁并行）、以及多种子鲁棒查询算法；实验显示其在高召回 QPS、索引大小、构建时间三方面同时优于或持平 ACORN/HNSW/IVFPQ，并在 range/keyword 专用任务上保持竞争力，体现出"通用型索引可替代专用型索引"的潜力。局限与未来工作：当前实现仅支持静态构建，附录给出启发式的插入（按 |C∩R| ≥ √|C| 加入既有团，否则局部挖掘新团）与删除（移除节点并在团小于 τ 时局部重挖）策略但留待后续实现；未评估 GPU/磁盘/分布式场景与极高维或极低选择率（s < 0.001）极端情形；固定 ε√n 种子采样在低 QPS 预算下带来可观的固定开销（低召回区间 ACORN 偶尔更快），参数 ε 需按选择率调优；对手写线性时间贪心最大团算法的引用属于已有工作（Ye et al., 2025），理论模型基于高斯距离分布的理想化假设，与真实数据的距离集中程度相关。

title: Lessons from External Review of DeepMind's Scheming Inability Safety Case
summary: Safety cases for frontier AI systems should provide a convincing argument, supported by evidence, that the risk of harm is within an acceptable bound. When developers author their own safety cases, confirmation bias and conflicted incentives can affect the quality of argument. External review can help to address this. In this paper, we apply the Assurance 2.0 framework to perform an external review of Google DeepMind's public scheming inability safety case. We surface substantive new concerns that materially affect the scope of the safety case and its applicability for decision-making. Based on this experience, we provide concrete recommendations for how external review should be conducted and what information AI developers should provide to support it.

AI.tldr: 本文应用 Assurance 2.0 框架对 Google DeepMind 关于"策划能力缺失"（scheming inability）的公开安全案例进行外部审查，发现了影响该安全案例范围和决策适用性的实质性新问题，并据此提出了关于外部审查如何开展及 AI 开发者应提供何种信息支持审查的具体建议。
AI.motivation: AI 开发者在自行编制安全案例时，确认偏误和利益冲突可能影响论证质量，因此需要外部审查来弥补这一不足。该研究旨在通过实际案例验证外部审查的可行性与价值。
AI.method: 采用 Assurance 2.0 框架作为方法论工具，对 Google DeepMind 公开的"策划能力缺失"安全案例进行独立的外部审查与评估。
AI.result: 识别出若干实质性新问题，这些问题对安全案例的覆盖范围及其在决策中的适用性产生重大影响。
AI.conclusion: 外部审查在 AI 安全案例评估中具有重要作用；研究提出了关于如何开展外部审查以及 AI 开发者应披露哪些信息以支持审查的具体建议。

title: Seeing the Whole Elephant: A Benchmark for Failure Attribution in LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Failure attribution, i.e., identifying the responsible agent and decisive step of a failure, is particularly challenging in LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) due to their natural-language reasoning, nondeterministic outputs, and intricate interaction dynamics. A reliable benchmark is therefore essential to guide and evaluate attribution techniques. Yet existing benchmarks rely on partially observable traces that capture only agent outputs, omitting the inputs and context that developers actually use when debugging. We argue that failure attribution should be studied under full execution observability, aligning with real-world developer-facing scenarios where complete traces, rather than only outputs, are accessible for diagnosis. To this end, we introduce TraceElephant, a benchmark designed for failure attribution with full execution traces and reproducible environments. We then systematically evaluate failure attribution techniques across various configurations. Specifically, full traces improve attribution accuracy by up to 76\% over a partial-observation counterpart, confirming that missing inputs obscure many failure causes. TraceElephant provides a foundation for follow-up failure attribution research, promoting evaluation practices that reflect real-world debugging and supporting the development of more transparent MASs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TraceElephant，一个基于完整执行轨迹的LLM多智能体系统故障归因基准。研究表明，相比仅使用部分观测（智能体输出），完整轨迹（包括输入和上下文）能将归因准确率提升高达76%，证实了缺失输入会掩盖许多故障根因。
AI.motivation: 现有故障归因基准仅依赖部分可观测轨迹（仅捕获智能体输出），缺少开发者调试时实际使用的输入和上下文信息。作者认为故障归因应在完整执行可观测性条件下研究，以贴合真实开发者调试场景。
AI.method: 构建TraceElephant基准，包含完整执行轨迹和可复现环境；对多种配置的故障归因技术进行系统评估；对比完整轨迹与部分观测条件下的归因效果。
AI.result: 完整轨迹相比部分观测可将归因准确率提升高达76%，证实缺失输入信息会掩盖大量故障原因。
AI.conclusion: TraceElephant为后续故障归因研究奠定基础，推动符合真实调试场景的评估实践，并支持更透明的多智能体系统开发。

title: Aligning Dense Retrievers with LLM Utility via DistillationAligning Dense Retrievers with LLM Utility via Distillation
summary: Dense vector retrieval is the practical backbone of Retrieval- Augmented Generation (RAG), but similarity search can suffer from precision limitations. Conversely, utility-based approaches leveraging LLM re-ranking often achieve superior performance but are computationally prohibitive and prone to noise inherent in perplexity estimation. We propose Utility-Aligned Embeddings (UAE), a framework designed to merge these advantages into a practical, high-performance retrieval method. We formulate retrieval as a distribution matching problem, training a bi-encoder to imitate a utility distribution derived from perplexity reduction using a Utility-Modulated InfoNCE objective. This approach injects graded utility signals directly into the embedding space without requiring test-time LLM inference. On the QASPER benchmark, UAE improves retrieval Recall@1 by 30.59%, MAP by 30.16% and Token F1 by 17.3% over the strong semantic baseline BGE-Base. Crucially, UAE is over 180x faster than the efficient LLM re-ranking methods preserving competitive performance, demonstrating that aligning retrieval with generative utility yields reliable contexts at scale.

AI.tldr: UAE是一个将密集检索的高效性与LLM重排序的优越性能相结合的框架，通过分布匹配和Utility-Modulated InfoNCE目标函数将效用信号注入嵌入空间，在QASPER上实现显著提升且推理速度快180倍。
AI.motivation: 密集向量检索是RAG的实践基础，但相似度搜索存在精度限制；基于效用的LLM重排序方法性能优越但计算成本高且容易受困惑度估计中的噪声影响。
AI.method: 将检索建模为分布匹配问题，训练双编码器使用Utility-Modulated InfoNCE目标函数来模拟由困惑度降低衍生的效用分布，将分级效用信号直接注入嵌入空间，无需测试时LLM推理。
AI.result: 在QASPER基准上，UAE相比强语义基线BGE-Base，Recall@1提升30.59%，MAP提升30.16%，Token F1提升17.3%；且比高效LLM重排序方法快180倍以上，同时保持竞争性性能。
AI.conclusion: UAE通过180倍的速度提升证明了将检索与生成式效用对齐可以在规模上提供可靠上下文，是一种高效且实用的RAG检索方法。

title: GICC: A High-Performance Runtime for GPU-Initiated Communication and Coordination in Modern HPC Systems
summary:
Distributed GPU applications increasingly rely on kernel-level, cross-node coordination to reduce launch overheads and improve compute-communication overlap, but such support is lacking. On OFI-based interconnects such as HPE Slingshot, which powers six of the top ten systems in the November 2025 Top500, including the top three, GPU kernels cannot autonomously drive distributed coordination: existing runtimes rely on host-driven progress and lack a bounded mechanism for recycling pre-staged NIC work across repeated GPU-triggered operations. On InfiniBand, GPU-initiated communication is possible, but current implementations incur unnecessary synchronization and locking overheads.
  This paper presents GICC, a framework that enables GPU kernels to directly trigger NIC-level operations without host involvement on the fast path. In stencils, GPU threads initiate halo exchanges as soon as boundary regions are computed, enabling fine-grained overlap between interior computation and boundary transfer. GICC decouples coordination semantics from data movement and introduces asynchronous resource reclamation: the NIC signals completion to both GPU and host memory, letting a lightweight host thread recycle NIC resources concurrently with GPU execution without injecting latency into the coordination path. This sustains GPU-driven coordination under finite NIC state, absent from existing OFI-based runtimes.
  We implement GICC on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs over InfiniBand and Slingshot. On Slingshot, GICC reduces per-coordination latency by up to 229x and improves weak scaling efficiency by up to 25%. On InfiniBand, it achieves up to 1.95x lower put latency than NVSHMEM by eliminating unnecessary locking and synchronization. On an industrial stencil proxy on 64 AMD MI250X GCDs, GPU-aware MPI incurs over 52% higher communication time than GICC, which achieves 42% parallel efficiency versus MPI's 35.4%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GICC框架，使GPU内核能够直接触发NIC级别的操作，无需主机参与协调。在HPE Slingshot上实现后，协调延迟降低最多229倍，弱扩展效率提升25%；在InfiniBand上，put延迟比NVSHMEM低1.95倍；在64个AMD MI250X GCD上实现42%的并行效率。
AI.motivation: 当前分布式GPU应用依赖内核级跨节点协调以减少启动开销并提高计算通信重叠，但现有OFI基础互连（如HPE Slingshot）和InfiniBand缺乏原生支持：OFI运行时依赖主机驱动进度且无法在有限NIC状态下回收预存资源，InfiniBand则存在不必要的同步和锁开销。
AI.method: GICC将协调语义与数据移动解耦，引入异步资源回收机制：NIC同时向GPU和主机内存发送完成信号，轻量级主机线程可与GPU执行并发回收NIC资源，使GPU驱动协调在有限NIC状态下可持续运行。
AI.result: Slingshot：每协调延迟降低最多229倍，弱扩展效率提升最多25%。InfiniBand：相比NVSHMEM的put延迟降低最多1.95倍。64个AMD MI250X GCD上：GICC实现42%并行效率，GPU感知MPI为35.4%。
AI.conclusion: GICC首次在OFI基础互连上实现GPU内核直接触发NIC操作，消除了InfiniBand上的不必要同步开销，为分布式GPU应用提供了高效、bounded的协调机制。

title: MolClaw: An Autonomous Agent with Hierarchical Skills for Drug Molecule Evaluation, Screening, and Optimization
comment: 59 pages, 10 figures. Code and data will be released
summary: Computational drug discovery, particularly the complex workflows of drug molecule screening and optimization, requires orchestrating dozens of specialized tools in multi-step workflows, yet current AI agents struggle to maintain robust performance and consistently underperform in these high-complexity scenarios. Here we present MolClaw, an autonomous agent that leads drug molecule evaluation, screening, and optimization. It unifies over 30 specialized domain resources through a three-tier hierarchical skill architecture (70 skills in total) that facilitates agent long-term interaction at runtime: tool-level skills standardize atomic operations, workflow-level skills compose them into validated pipelines with quality check and reflection, and a discipline-level skill supplies scientific principles governing planning and verification across all scenarios in the field. Additionally, we introduce MolBench, a benchmark comprising molecular screening, optimization, and end-to-end discovery challenges spanning 8 to 50+ sequential tool calls. MolClaw achieves state-of-the-art performance across all metrics, and ablation studies confirm that gains concentrate on tasks that demand structured workflows while vanishing on those solvable with ad hoc scripting, establishing workflow orchestration competence as the primary capability bottleneck for AI-driven drug discovery.

AI.tldr: MolClaw是一个用于药物分子评估、筛选和优化的自主AI智能体，通过三层技能架构整合30+专业领域资源（70项技能），在MolBench基准测试中达到最优性能。研究证明工作流编排能力是当前AI药物发现的主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 当前AI智能体在复杂药物发现工作流（多步筛选、优化）中表现不佳，需要协调数十种专业工具，而现有方法难以维持稳健性能。
AI.method: 提出三层层级技能架构：(1)工具级技能标准化原子操作；(2)工作流级技能组合验证管道，含质量检查与反思机制；(3)学科级技能提供跨场景的科学规划与验证原则。通过MolBench基准测试评估，该基准包含8-50+步工具调用的分子筛选、优化及端到端发现任务。
AI.result: MolClaw在所有指标上达到最优性能。消融实验表明：性能提升集中于需要结构化工作流的任务，而在可通过临时脚本解决的任务上效果消失。
AI.conclusion: 工作流编排能力是AI驱动药物发现的主要能力瓶颈，而非单个工具或算法。

title: Documentless Assessments Using Nominal Group Interviews
summary: This paper describes a group interview technique designed to support documentless process assessments while promoting at the same time collaboration among assessment participants. The method was successfully used in one consulting assignment where it got previously discording participants, talking to each other and agreeing on the issues. The technique borrows from agile software development the concept of user stories to cast CMMIs specific practices in concrete terms and the Planning Poker technique, instead of document reviews and audit like interviews, for fact finding and corroboration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需文档支撑的团体访谈技术，通过借鉴敏捷开发中的用户故事和计划扑克方法，有效促进了过程评估参与者的协作与共识达成。
AI.motivation: 传统的过程评估方法过度依赖文档审查和审计式访谈，缺乏促进参与者协作的机制，难以有效收集和验证信息，尤其在参与者存在分歧的情况下更难达成共识。
AI.method: 该方法创新性地将敏捷开发中的"用户故事"概念用于将CMMI特定实践转化为具体表述，并采用"计划扑克"（Planning Poker）技术替代传统的文档审查和审计访谈来进行事实发现与验证。
AI.result: 该技术已在一次咨询项目中成功应用，有效促使原本存在分歧的参与者相互交流并就关键问题达成一致。
AI.conclusion: 该技术能够有效地将原本分散甚至对立的参与者引导至协作讨论并达成共识，具有实际应用价值。

title: Source-Modality Monitoring in Vision-Language Models
comment: All resources will be available at https://github.com/ethahtz/source-modality-monitoring
summary: We define and investigate source-modality monitoring -- the ability of multimodal models to track and communicate the input source from which pieces of information originate. We consider source-modality monitoring as an instance of the more general binding problem, and evaluate the extent to which models exploit syntactic vs. semantic signals in order to bind words like image in a user-provided prompt to specific components of their input and context (i.e., actual images). Across experiments spanning 11 vision-language models (VLMs) performing target-modality information retrieval tasks, we find that both syntactic and semantic signals play an important role, but that the latter tend to outweigh the former in cases when modalities are highly distinct distributionally. We discuss the implications of these findings for model robustness, and in the context of increasingly multimodal agentic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文定义了"源模态监测"概念，即多模态模型追踪和传达信息来源的能力，将其作为绑定问题的具体实例。通过在11个视觉-语言模型上的实验，发现语义信号在模态分布差异明显时更具主导作用，研究结果对模型鲁棒性和多模态智能体系统的设计具有重要参考价值。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型需要解决绑定问题（binding problem），即如何将文本中的词语（如"image"）与实际的输入模态（如传入的图像）正确关联，这直接关系到模型的信息追踪与通信能力。
AI.method: 在11个视觉-语言模型（VLMs）上开展实验，评估目标模态信息检索任务，系统性地检验模型如何利用句法信号和语义信号将"图像"等词语绑定到具体输入组件。
AI.result: 句法信号和语义信号均发挥重要作用，但当模态间的分布差异较大时，语义信号的权重超过句法信号。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果对模型鲁棒性和多模态智能体系统的设计具有重要意义，提示开发者在构建此类系统时需充分考虑语义线索的权重。

title: Conditional anomaly detection using soft harmonic functions: An application to clinical alerting
comment: ICML 2011 Workshop on Machine Learning for Global Challenges. arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2604.21462. substantial text overlap with arXiv:2604.21462
summary: Timely detection of concerning events is an important problem in clinical practice. In this paper, we consider the problem of conditional anomaly detection that aims to identify data instances with an unusual response, such as the omission of an important lab test. We develop a new non-parametric approach for conditional anomaly detection based on the soft harmonic solution, with which we estimate the confidence of the label to detect anomalous mislabeling. We further regularize the solution to avoid the detection of isolated examples and examples on the boundary of the distribution support. We demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed method in detecting unusual labels on a real-world electronic health record dataset and compare it to several baseline approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文针对临床实践中的条件异常检测问题，提出了一种基于软调和解的非参数方法，用于识别异常标记（如重要实验室检测的遗漏）。通过置信度估计和正则化策略，该方法在电子健康记录数据集上表现出良好的检测效果。
AI.motivation: 在临床实践中，及时检测异常事件（如重要实验室检测的遗漏）对于患者安全至关重要。传统的异常检测方法难以针对特定条件（即给定输入特征）下的异常标签进行检测，因此需要一种能够识别标签层面异常的新方法。
AI.method: 提出一种基于软调和解（soft harmonic solution）的非参数条件异常检测方法。通过估计标签的置信度来检测异常标记，并采用正则化技术避免将孤立样本和分布边界样本误判为异常。
AI.result: 该方法在真实电子健康记录数据集上有效检测出异常标签，性能优于多种基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提非参数方法能够有效识别临床数据中的异常标记，为医疗质量控制提供了一种有价值的工具。

title: Entrywise Low-Rank Approximation and Matrix $p \rightarrow q$ Norms via Global Correlation Rounding
summary:
Given a matrix $A$, the goal of the entrywise low-rank approximation problem is to find $\operatorname{argmin} \|A-B\|_p$ over all rank-$k$ matrices $B$, where $\| \cdot \|_p$ is the entrywise $\ell_p$ norm. When $p = 2$ this well-studied problem is solved by the singular value decomposition, but for $p \neq 2$ the problem becomes computationally challenging. For every even $p > 2$ and every fixed $k$, we give the first polynomial-time approximation scheme for this problem, improving on the $(3 + \varepsilon)$ approximation of Ban, Bhattiprolu, Bringmann, Kolev, Lee, and Woodruff, the bi-criteria approximation of Woodruff and Yasuda, and the additive approximation scheme of Anderson, Bakshi, and Hopkins. Prior algorithmic approaches based on sketching and column selection, which yielded a polynomial-time approximation scheme in the $p < 2$ setting, face concrete barriers when $p > 2$. Instead, we use the Sherali-Adams hierarchy of convex programs, and in so doing establish a blueprint for how to use convex hierarchies to design polynomial-time approximation schemes for continuous optimization problems.
  We use the same algorithmic strategy to give a new family of additive approximation algorithms for matrix $p \rightarrow q$ norms, which are intimately related to small-set expansion and quantum information. In particular, we give the first nontrivial additive approximation algorithms in the regime $p < 2 < q$.

AI.tldr: 提出首个针对偶数 p>2 和固定秩 k 的矩阵 entrywise 低秩逼近问题的多项式时间逼近方案 (PTAS)，并基于 Sherali-Adams 层次结构建立通用算法框架，同时给出矩阵 p→q 范数的首个非平凡加法逼近算法。
AI.motivation: 当 p≠2 时，entrywise 低秩逼近问题计算困难（p=2 时由 SVD 解决）。现有基于 sketch 和列选择的算法在 p>2 情形下面临根本性障碍，而该问题与量子信息、小集合扩张等领域密切相关，因此需要新的算法范式。
AI.method: 采用 Sherali-Adams 凸规划层次结构（而非传统的 sketch 和列选择方法），为连续优化问题设计 PTAS 建立了通用蓝图。
AI.result: 对于任意偶数 p>2 和固定 k，首个 PTAS；改进了 (3+ε) 逼近、双准则逼近和加法逼近的现有结果；给出矩阵 p→q 范数的新加法逼近算法族（尤其在 p<2<q 情形的首个非平凡算法）。
AI.conclusion: 证明了 Sherali-Adams 层次结构可有效解决高阶矩阵优化问题，为连续优化问题设计 PTAS 提供了新范式，突破了 sketch/列选择方法在 p>2 时的算法壁垒。

title: A Model-Driven Approach to Database Migration with a Unified Data Model
summary:
Database migration is a key task in software modernization, increasingly involving transformations across heterogeneous data models such as relational and NoSQL systems. Existing approaches are typically designed for specific source-target combinations, which limits their applicability in multi-model environments.
  This paper proposes a generic database migration approach based on the U-Schema unified data model, which acts as a pivot representation. By defining mappings between each data model and U-Schema, the approach reduces the number of required transformations and enables schema conversion across heterogeneous paradigms. Trace information is generated during schema transformation to capture correspondences between source and target elements, and is subsequently used to guide data migration in a decoupled manner.
  The approach has been implemented and evaluated through experiments covering schema-level validation, data-level semantic preservation, and performance analysis. The results show that the migration pipeline achieves high structural preservation under round-trip reconstruction, produces document schemas consistent with the intended design decisions, and preserves query behavior across a variety of access patterns, including joins, aggregations, and nested structures. Performance results demonstrate the feasibility of the approach for datasets of increasing size.
  The evaluation focuses on relational-to-document migration using both synthetic datasets and the Northwind benchmark. While this scenario provides a concrete instantiation, the approach is designed to support multiple data models within a unified framework.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于U-Schema作为枢纽表示的通用数据库迁移方法，通过为每个数据模型定义与U-Schema的映射实现异构数据库间的模式与数据转换。该方法利用追踪信息解耦式指导迁移，并在关系型到文档型迁移场景中验证了结构保持、语义保持和性能可行性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法针对特定的源-目标组合设计，在多模型环境中的适用性受到限制。
AI.method: 提出一种基于U-Schema统一数据模型的通用数据库迁移方法，作为枢纽表示。通过定义每个数据模型与U-Schema之间的映射来减少所需转换数量，实现异构范式间的模式转换。在模式转换过程中生成追踪信息以捕获源与目标元素间的对应关系，随后用于以解耦方式指导数据迁移。实验涵盖模式级验证、数据级语义保持和性能分析。
AI.result: 迁移管道在往返重构中实现高结构保持率，生成的文档模式与预期设计决策一致，保留各种访问模式（包括连接、聚合和嵌套结构）的查询行为，性能结果表明该方法对规模增长的数据集具有可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在统一框架内支持多种数据模型，实验结果表明其可行性，可用于日益增长的数据集规模。

title: Taste for Privacy: How Context, Identity, and Lived-Experience Shape Information Sharing Preferences
summary: Privacy preferences are not fixed individual traits, they depend on context and lived experiences. In this study, we analyze 2,912 survey responses from 782 college students collected over seven survey periods during 2023 and 2024. We ask about their usage of social media, the security settings of their accounts, and measure their comfort in sharing personally identifiable information (PII) across 17 different institutional contexts. Compared to past research, we observe a large shift towards private accounts, going from 1/3rd private in 2007 to 2/3rds in 2024, and find that participants' discomfort sharing PII with social media platforms strongly predicts their privacy settings. Beyond social media, we identify a stable ranking of institutional trust, though some institutions, like the police, show high variability reflecting divergent lived experiences. Traditionally marginalized groups and participants having faced adverse childhood experiences show more discomfort with institutions of power, especially in areas where they face greater vulnerability. We argue for context-adaptive privacy settings that recognize institutional relationships and demographic vulnerabilities, moving beyond one-size-fits-all consent frameworks toward contextually appropriate data governance.

AI.tldr: 本文用 2,912 份问卷（782 名大学生、2023–2024 年 7 个调查期）测量 17 类机构情境下分享个人可识别信息（PII）的舒适度，发现大学生社交媒体隐私设置已从 2007 年 1/3 私密转向 2024 年 2/3 私密；对社交媒体的不适感每升高一级，私密设置的胜算提升约 37%；机构信任存在稳定层级（朋友/医疗人员/亲属最可信，陌生人/陌生公司最不可信，社交媒体居中），但警察等机构变异性极大；女性、有色人种、LGBTQ+ 群体及童年不良经历者对权力机构的不适感系统性更强。据此主张采用情境自适应的隐私设置与数据治理，而非一刀切的同意框架。
AI.motivation: 现有隐私模型与平台设计普遍假定用户存在稳定不变的隐私偏好（如“通知—同意”框架、一刀切的隐私设置），忽略了隐私偏好实际随信息接收方、机构情境以及个人生活经历而变化。作者希望检验 2007 年经典研究（Lewis et al.）所刻画的大学生隐私格局是否仍然成立，并回答三个问题：(RQ1) 2007 年以来隐私偏好是否改变，社交媒体隐私设置与“向平台分享个人数据的不适感”有何关系，使用频率与平台数量是否混淆该关系；(RQ2) 隐私偏好是否随机构情境变化，是否存在稳定的机构信任层级；(RQ3) 人口学特征与生活经历（如童年不良经历）如何塑造对各类机构分享 PII 的舒适度。
AI.method: 以问卷调查为主。作者复刻并扩展了 Lewis 等人（2008）2007 年的东北部美国大学生社交媒体隐私测量框架：在 2023—2024 年间的 7 个调查波次中收集 2,912 份问卷、覆盖 782 名大学生，测量其社交媒体使用行为（频率、平台数量）、账户安全设置（私密/混合/公开），并以量表评估其在 17 类机构情境下分享可识别身份信息（PII）的舒适程度。分析上，用回归模型检验社交媒体不适感对隐私设置的预测效力（每升高一级，不适感使更私密设置的胜算提升约 37%），并考察使用频率与平台数量是否构成混淆变量；同时按机构情境聚合 comfort 评分以构建机构信任的稳定排序（并以方差识别高异质性机构，如警察），再通过分组统计与模型比较考察人口学变量（性别、种族、LGBTQ+ 身份）与童年不良经历（ACE）对不同机构情境下不适感的系统影响。作者依托情境完整性（contextual integrity）理论，将隐私视为“品味”而非特质。
AI.result: RQ1：隐私设置显著转向私密化——2024 年 84% 的受访者使用私密或混合设置（62% 私密、22% 混合），远高于 2007 年仅 33.2% 私密；社交媒体平台上的 PII 不适感强烈预测隐私设置，不适感每提升一级，采用更私密设置的优势比上升约 37%；使用频率与平台数量的影响作为混淆变量被检验与控制。RQ2：存在稳定的机构信任排序——朋友、医疗专业人员、亲属最受信任，陌生人与陌生公司最不受信任；社交媒体平台的信任度介于“不确定的商业实体”与“弱关系纽带”之间，说明用户虽广泛使用但在分享上持保留态度；多数机构层级稳定，但警察等机构变异性极高，反映出截然不同的生活经历。RQ3：人口学与生活经历产生系统性差异——女性对熟人、医疗专业人员与同事的不适感更高；有色人种对警察、雇主与金融机构更不适；LGBTQ+ 参与者对邻居、亲属、政府与警察的不适感显著更强；童年不良经历系统性降低对权威机构的信任，涵盖亲属、金融机构、警察、医疗专业人员、雇主、政府与邻居。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论认为，隐私偏好是随情境、身份与生活经历变化的可变属性，而非稳定特质：学生隐私设置已从2007年的1/3私密度大幅转向2024年的约2/3私密度；对社交媒体的不适感是隐私设置的关键预测因素；机构信任存在稳定层级但警察等权力机构内部分歧极大；边缘化群体与童年逆境经历者对权力机构的不适感系统性更高。据此论文主张平台与政策采用“情境自适应”的隐私控制与数据治理方式，取代一刀切的同意框架，把机构关系与人口结构性脆弱性纳入考量。

title: Analyzing Shapley Additive Explanations to Understand Anomaly Detection Algorithm Behaviors and Their Complementarity
comment: IDA Frontier Prize and Best Paper Award -Intelligent Data Analysis (IDA) 2026, Springer Nature
summary: Unsupervised anomaly detection is a challenging problem due to the diversity of data distributions and the lack of labels. Ensemble methods are often adopted to mitigate these challenges by combining multiple detectors, which can reduce individual biases and increase robustness. Yet building an ensemble that is genuinely complementary remains challenging, since many detectors rely on similar decision cues and end up producing redundant anomaly scores. As a result, the potential of ensemble learning is often limited by the difficulty of identifying models that truly capture different types of irregularities. To address this, we propose a methodology for characterizing anomaly detectors through their decision mechanisms. Using SHapley Additive exPlanations, we quantify how each model attributes importance to input features, and we use these attribution profiles to measure similarity between detectors. We show that detectors with similar explanations tend to produce correlated anomaly scores and identify largely overlapping anomalies. Conversely, explanation divergence reliably indicates complementary detection behavior. Our results demonstrate that explanation-driven metrics offer a different criterion than raw outputs for selecting models in an ensemble. However, we also demonstrate that diversity alone is insufficient; high individual model performance remains a prerequisite for effective ensembles. By explicitly targeting explanation diversity while maintaining model quality, we are able to construct ensembles that are more diverse, more complementary, and ultimately more effective for unsupervised anomaly detection.

AI.tldr: 提出利用SHAP解释来表征异常检测器的决策机制，通过解释档案衡量检测器间的相似性。研究表明解释相似的检测器产生相关异常分数和重叠检测结果，而解释差异表示互补检测行为。通过显式优化解释多样性同时保持模型质量，可构建更有效的不完备无监督异常检测集成。
AI.motivation: 无监督异常检测中，数据分布多样且缺乏标签。现有集成方法虽能减少偏差，但难以构建真正互补的集成——许多检测器依赖相似决策线索，产生冗余异常分数。现有模型选择标准（如原始输出相似性）无法有效识别真正捕获不同异常类型的模型。
AI.method: 1. 使用SHAP量化每个模型对输入特征的重视程度；2. 生成检测器的"归因档案"(attribution profiles)；3. 基于归因档案衡量检测器间的相似性；4. 分析解释相似性与异常分数相关性及异常重叠率的关系。
AI.result: 解释相似的检测器产生相关异常分数和高度重叠的异常检测结果；解释差异可靠地指示互补检测行为；基于解释多样性的指标为模型选择提供不同于原始输出的标准。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠多样性不够，高个体模型性能是有效集成的必要前提。明确针对解释多样性同时保持模型质量，可构建更多样、更互补、更有效的无监督异常检测集成。

title: $O(K)$-Approximation Coflow Scheduling in $K$-Core Optical Circuit Switching Networks
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2604.08242. text overlap with arXiv:2604.08242
summary:
Coflow has emerged as a fundamental application-layer abstraction in distributed systems, representing communication dependencies and enabling collaborative management of related flows to enhance job completion efficiency. To meet the increasing bandwidth demands of modern data center networks (DCNs), optical circuit switches are widely deployed due to their high capacity and energy efficiency. Simultaneously, DCN deployments are evolving towards heterogeneous parallel architectures, where multiple independent optical circuit switching (OCS) cores operate concurrently to facilitate bandwidth expansion and incremental upgrades. However, existing research on coflow scheduling in multi-core switching fabrics primarily focuses on electrical packet switching (EPS) networks, with a few known results on OCS networks without or with a poor performance guarantee.
  This paper studies the coflow scheduling problem in multi-core OCS networks under the not-all-stop (i.e., asynchronous) reconfiguration model, focusing on two major challenges of overcoming cross-core coupling for inter-core traffic allocation and satisfying the constraints of port exclusivity and reconfiguration overhead for intra-core circuit scheduling.
