summary: Health misinformation remains one of the most pressing challenges on social media, particularly when cultural traditions intersect with scientific-sounding claims. These dynamics are not only global but also deeply local, manifesting in culturally specific controversies that require careful analysis. Motivated by this, we examine 100 YouTube transcripts that promote or debunk cow urine (gomutra) as a health remedy, focusing on rhetorical strategies such as appeals to authority, efficacy appeals, and conspiracy framing. We employ large language models (LLMs) including GPT-4, GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and Mistral Medium 3 to annotate transcripts using a 14-category taxonomy of persuasive tactics. Our analysis reveals that promoters predominantly rely on efficacy appeals and social proof, while debunkers emphasize authority and rebuttal. Human evaluation of a subset of annotations yielded 90.1\% inter-annotator agreement, confirming the reliability of our taxonomy and validation process. This work advances computational methods for misinformation analysis and demonstrates how LLMs can support large-scale studies of cultural discourse online.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析100个 YouTube 视频转录文本，探索了牛尿疗法相关的健康 misinformation 中的说服策略，利用多种 LLMs 进行14类说服策略的注释，发现推广者和辟谣者使用不同的修辞手段，并验证了 LLMs 辅助文化话语大规模分析的可行性。
AI.motivation: 健康 misinformation 是社交媒体面临的紧迫挑战，尤其是当文化传统与伪科学主张交织时，这些动态既具有全球性也具有地方性深度，需要对文化特定争议进行仔细分析。该研究以此为动机，聚焦于牛尿疗法这一特定文化背景下的健康 misinformation 现象。
AI.method: 该研究检查了100个推广或反驳牛尿（gomutra）作为健康疗法的 YouTube 视频转录文本，采用包含14个类别的说服策略分类法，使用多种 LLMs（GPT-4、GPT-4o、GPT-4.1、GPT-5、Gemini 2.5 Pro 和 Mistral Medium 3）进行注释分析，聚焦于权威诉求、功效诉求和阴谋论框架等修辞策略，并通过人工评估验证注释的一致性。
AI.result: 研究发现推广者主要依赖功效诉求和社会证明策略，而辟谣者则强调权威引用和反驳策略。人工评估显示注释者间一致性达到90.1%，验证了分类法和验证过程的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究推进了用于 misinformation 分析的计算方法，展示了 LLMs 如何支持在线文化话语的大规模研究，为理解和应对社交媒体上的文化特定健康 misinformation 提供了新的技术路径和分析框架。

title: Hidden Failure Modes of Gradient Modification under Adam in Continual Learning, and Adaptive Decoupled Moment Routing as a Repair
summary:
Many continual-learning methods modify gradients upstream (e.g., projection, penalty rescaling, replay mixing) while treating Adam as a neutral backend. We show this composition has a hidden failure mode. In a high-overlap, non-adaptive 8-domain continual LM, all shared-routing projection baselines collapse close to vanilla forgetting (12.5--12.8 vs. 13.2). A 0.5% replay buffer is the strongest shared alternative but still reaches 11.6, while fixed-strength decoupling falls below vanilla at 14.1. Only adaptive decoupled routing remains stable at 9.4, improving over vanilla by 3.8 units. On a 16-domain stream, its gain over the strongest shared-routing projection baseline grows to 4.5--4.8 units. The failure is largely invisible on clean benchmarks.
  We explain this effect through Adam's second-moment pathway: in the tested regime, projection induces a 1/(1-alpha) inflation of the old-direction effective learning rate, matching measurements within 8% across eight alpha values. The same conflict appears with penalty methods, replay mixing, and at 7B scale under LoRA. Our fix routes the modified gradient only to the first moment while preserving magnitude-faithful second-moment statistics, with overlap-aware adaptive strength. This simple change is the only tested configuration that consistently avoids collapse across methods, optimizers, and scale.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了持续学习方法（如梯度投影、惩罚重缩放、回放混合）与Adam优化器组合时存在隐藏的失效模式。问题根源在于Adam的二阶矩路径：梯度投影导致旧方向有效学习率出现1/(1-α)膨胀。解决方案是将修改后的梯度仅路由至一阶矩，同时保持二阶矩统计的量级一致性，并引入重叠感知的自适应强度。
AI.motivation: 现有持续学习方法在修改梯度上游（如投影、惩罚重缩放、回放混合）时，将Adam视为中性后端。然而，这种组合在持续学习场景下存在隐藏的失效模式——在干净基准测试中不可见，但在高重叠的8域持续语言模型中导致性能崩溃。
AI.method: 实验设置：8域和16域持续语言模型任务。对比测试：共享路由投影基线（Ours、PACK、GradiViT）、0.5%回放缓冲、强度固定的解耦方法、自适应解耦路由。核心分析：建立Adam二阶矩路径与梯度投影冲突的数学模型，验证1/(1-α)膨胀效应。
AI.result: 共享路由投影基线在8域任务中接近vanilla遗忘水平（12.5-12.8 vs 13.2）；0.5%回放缓冲达11.6；强度固定解耦低于vanilla达14.1；仅自适应解耦路由保持稳定，达9.4（较vanilla提升3.8）。在16域任务中，自适应解耦相对最强共享路由投影基线的优势扩大至4.5-4.8单位。理论预测与实测误差在8个α值下均控制在8%以内。
AI.conclusion: 提出一种简单修复方案：将修改后的梯度仅路由至一阶矩，同时保持量级忠诚的二阶矩统计量，配合重叠感知自适应强度。该方案是唯一在各种方法、优化器和规模（7B LoRA）下均能一致避免崩溃的配置。

title: From graphemic dependence to lexical structure: a Markovian perspective on Dante's Commedia
comment: 25 pages, 8 figures, 1 supplementary material; submitted to Digital Scholarship in the Humanities
summary:
This study investigates the structural organisation of Dante's Divina Commedia through a symbolic representation based on vowel-consonant (V/C) encoding. Modelling the resulting sequence as a four-state Markov chain yields a parsimonious index of graphemic memory, capturing the balance between persistence and alternation patterns.
  Across the poem, this index exhibits a slight but consistent increase from the Inferno to the Paradiso, indicating a directional shift in local dependency structure. Trigram-level analysis shows that this trend is driven by a restricted set of recurrent configurations, interpreted as graphemic probes linking the Markov representation to identifiable lexical environments in the text.
  These probes display distinct behaviours: configurations involving two transitions more frequently emerge across word boundaries, reflecting interactions between adjacent tokens, whereas configurations with fewer transitions are largely confined to intra-lexical structures. Part of the signal is further shaped by orthographic phenomena, particularly apostrophised forms, highlighting the role of writing conventions alongside phonological and lexical organisation.
  A complementary classification analysis identifies cantica-specific terms, providing lexical anchors through which graphemic probes can be related to the structure of the poem. This organisation is reflected not only in the separation of the three cantiche, but also in a continuous trajectory across the text.
  Overall, the results show that simple probabilistic models applied to symbolic text representations can uncover structured interactions between local dependencies, lexical distribution, orthographic encoding, and large-scale organisation, providing an interpretable framework for linking local symbolic dynamics to higher-level textual organisation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过元音-辅音(V/C)编码将但丁《神曲》转化为符号序列，构建四态马尔可夫链模型来量化"字位记忆"指数，发现该指数从《地狱篇》到《天堂篇》呈轻微但一致的增长趋势。三元组分析揭示这一趋势由受限的 recurrent configurations 驱动，且不同转移模式的配置在词际/词内分布上存在差异，同时受到正字法现象(如撇号形式)的影响。分类分析成功识别了三界特定词汇，进一步验证了局部符号动力学与宏观文本结构之间的关联。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在通过简单概率模型从新颖的符号表征角度揭示《神曲》的结构组织，核心问题是：基于V/C编码的马尔可夫链能否捕捉到诗篇的层次化结构？研究假设局部字位依赖模式与词汇分布、正字法编码及宏观组织之间存在可量化的关联。
AI.method: 1. V/C编码：将文本中每个字母编码为元音(V)或辅音(C)两类，形成符号序列；2. 四态马尔可夫链建模：基于V/C序列的状态转移概率计算"图位记忆"指数，量化持久性与交替模式的平衡；3. 三元组(trigram)分析：提取高频 recurrent configurations，区分词际与词内分布特征；4. 正字法分析：考察省略形式(如撇号)的影响；5. 分类分析：使用有监督方法识别 cantica-specific 词汇。
AI.result: 1. 图位记忆指数沿《地狱》→《炼狱》→《天堂》方向轻微但一致增长；2. 三元组层面的趋势由受限的高频配置集合驱动；3. 含两次转移的配置多出现于词际边界，反映词间交互；转移较少的配置多限于词内结构；4. 正字法现象(如撇号形式)部分塑造了该信号；5. 分类分析成功区分三界词汇，揭示三界分离及跨文本的连续轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 简单概率模型应用于符号化文本表征可揭示局部依赖、词汇分布、正字法编码与宏观组织之间的结构化交互。该研究为建立局部符号动力学与高层文本组织之间的可解释框架提供了有效路径。方法论的贡献在于：将V/C编码与马尔可夫分析相结合，为文学作品的定量文体学研究提供了新颖且可解释的分析工具。

title: Distance-Misaligned Training in Graph Transformers and Adaptive Graph-Aware Control
comment: Accepted by Graph Signal Processing Workshop 2026 as an extended abstract
summary: Graph Transformers can mix information globally, but this flexibility also creates failure modes: some tasks require long-range communication while others are better served by local interaction. We study this through a synthetic node-classification benchmark on contextual stochastic block model graphs, where labels are generated by a controllable mixture of local and far-shell signals. We define distance-misaligned training as a mismatch between where label-relevant information lies and where the model allocates communication over graph distance. On this benchmark, we find three points. First, the preferred graph-distance bias changes systematically with task locality. Second, an oracle adaptive controller, given offline access to the task-side distance target, nearly matches the best fixed bias across regimes and strongly improves over a neutral baseline on mixed and local tasks. Third, a task-agnostic zero-gap controller is weaker, indicating that adaptation alone is not enough and that the control target matters. These results suggest that distance-resolved diagnosis is useful for understanding Graph Transformer failures and for designing graph-aware control.

AI.tldr: Graph Transformer在不同任务中对通信距离的需求不同，本研究通过合成基准测试发现：模型的最优距离偏置随任务局部性变化；自适应控制需要结合正确的目标距离才能有效；距离解析诊断是理解和改进Graph Transformer的重要工具。
AI.motivation: Graph Transformer虽然具有全局信息混合的灵活性，但也存在失败模式：不同任务对通信距离的需求不同（有的需要长程通信，有的更适合局部交互）。这种任务局部性与模型通信分配之间的不匹配可能导致性能下降，因此需要深入研究两者之间的关系。
AI.method: 使用上下文随机块模型（CSBM）图构建合成节点分类基准测试，通过可控的局部和远层信号混合来生成标签。定义了距离错位训练（distance-misaligned training）概念，用于描述标签相关信息位置与模型在图距离上分配通信之间的不匹配。实验对比了固定偏置、甲骨文自适应控制器和零间隙控制器三种方案。
AI.result: 1）偏置偏好随任务局部性系统性地变化；2）甲骨文自适应控制器几乎匹配所有机制下的最佳固定偏置，并在混合和局部任务上显著优于中性基线；3）任务无关的零间隙控制器表现较弱，说明仅有适应性是不够的，控制目标的选择同样关键。
AI.conclusion: 距离解析诊断有助于理解Graph Transformer的失败模式，并能为设计图感知控制机制提供指导。研究表明，仅有适应性是不够的，控制目标的选择至关重要。

title: Identifying and typifying demographic unfairness in phoneme-level embeddings of self-supervised speech recognition models
summary: Modern automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems have been observed to function better for certain speaker groups (SGs) than others, despite recent gains in overall performance. One potential impediment to progress towards fairer ASR is a more nuanced understanding of the types of modeling errors that speech encoder models make, and in particular the difference between the structure of embeddings for high-performance and low-performance SGs. This paper proposes a framework typifying two types of error that can occur in modeling phonemes in ASR systems: random error/high variance in phoneme embedding, vs systematic error/embedding bias. We find that training phoneme classification probes only on a single, typically disadvantaged SG, sometimes improves performance for that SG, which is evidence for the existence of SG-level bias in phoneme embeddings. On the other hand, we find that speakers and SGs with higher levels of phoneme variance are the same as those with worse phoneme prediction accuracy. We conclude that both types of error are present in phoneme embeddings and both are candidate causes for SG-level unfairness in ASR, though random error is likely a greater hindrance to fairness than systematic error. Furthermore, we find that finetuning encoder models using a fairness-enhancing algorithm (domain enhancing and adversarial training) changes neither the benefits of in-domain phoneme classification probe training, nor measured levels of random embedding error.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出分析框架，将ASR系统中说话人群组间的性能差异归因于两类建模误差——随机误差/高方差与系统性误差/嵌入偏差，并通过实验表明两者均对公平性产生影响，其中随机误差可能是更大阻碍。
AI.motivation: 现代ASR系统对不同说话人群组（SG）表现差异显著，理解语音编码器模型的建模误差类型及其在高性能和低性能说话人群组中嵌入结构的差异，是推进ASR公平性的关键障碍。
AI.method: 提出一个分析框架，将ASR系统中音素建模误差分为两类：随机误差/高方差和系统性误差/嵌入偏差；使用音素分类探针进行实验；在单一说话人群组上训练探针并评估跨组性能；应用领域增强和对抗训练的公平性增强算法微调编码器模型。
AI.result: 在单一弱势说话人群组上训练音素分类探针有时可改善该组性能，证明音素嵌入中存在人群组级偏差；音素方差较高的说话者和人群组对应更差的音素预测准确率；两类误差均存在于音素嵌入中，随机误差可能是公平性的更大阻碍；公平性增强算法的微调未显著改变上述问题。
AI.conclusion: 两种误差均存在于音素嵌入中，随机误差对公平性的阻碍可能大于系统性误差；基于领域增强和对抗训练的公平性算法微调未能改变音素分类探针训练的优势，也未改变随机嵌入误差水平。

title: From Local to Cluster: A Unified Framework for Causal Discovery with Latent Variables
summary: Latent variables pose a fundamental challenge to causal discovery and inference. Conventional local methods focus on direct neighbors but fail to provide macro level insights. Cluster level methods enable macro causal reasoning but either assume clusters are known a priori or require causal sufficiency. Moreover, directly applying single variable causal discovery methods to cluster level problems violates causal sufficiency and leads to incorrect results. To overcome these limitations, this paper proposes L2C (Local to Cluster Causal Abstraction), a unified framework that bridges local structure learning and cluster level causal discovery. Unlike prior work that requires a complete manual assignment of micro variables to clusters, L2C discovers the partition automatically from local causal patterns. Our solution leverages a cluster reduction theorem to reduce any cluster to at most three nodes without loss of causal information, applies local causal discovery to identify direct causes, effects, and V structures in the presence of latent variables, and performs macro level causal inference via cluster level calculus on the learned cluster graph. L2C does not assume causal sufficiency, as latent variables are handled through local discovery. Theoretical analysis shows that L2C ensures soundness, atomic completeness, and computational efficiency. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real world data demonstrate that L2C accurately recovers ground truth clusters and achieves superior macro causal effect identification compared to existing baselines.

AI.tldr: L2C框架通过自动发现微观变量聚类，将局部因果发现方法与聚类级因果推理统一起来，无需先验聚类假设或因果充分性假设。核心创新包括将任意聚类缩减至最多三个节点的定理，以及在存在隐变量情况下进行局部因果发现的策略。
AI.motivation: 隐变量是因果发现与推断中的根本挑战。传统局部方法聚焦直接邻域但缺乏宏观洞察；聚类级方法虽支持宏观因果推理，但需要先验聚类或因果充分性假设。将单变量因果发现方法直接应用于聚类问题会违反因果充分性假设，导致错误结果。
AI.method: L2C提出三个关键技术：(1) 聚类缩减定理——将任意聚类缩减至最多三个节点而不丢失因果信息；(2) 在隐变量存在情况下应用局部因果发现识别直接因、直接果和V结构；(3) 在习得的聚类图上进行聚类级微积分实现宏观因果推断。无需手动指定微观变量到聚类的映射。
AI.result: 理论分析证明L2C满足健全性、原子完备性和计算效率。合成数据和真实数据的广泛实验表明，L2C能准确恢复真实聚类，并在宏观因果效应识别上优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: L2C成功弥合了局部结构学习与聚类级因果发现之间的鸿沟，在不假设因果充分性的前提下自动从局部因果模式发现聚类划分，为宏观因果推理提供了有效工具。

title: BERAG: Bayesian Ensemble Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering
summary: A common approach to question answering with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is to concatenate documents into a single context and pass it to a language model to generate an answer. While simple, this strategy can obscure the contribution of individual documents, making attribution difficult and contributing to the ``lost-in-the-middle'' effect, where relevant information in long contexts is overlooked. Concatenation also scales poorly: computational cost grows quadratically with context length, a problem that becomes especially severe when the context includes visual data, as in visual question answering. Attempts to mitigate these issues by limiting context length can further restrict performance by preventing models from benefiting from the improved recall offered by deeper retrieval. We propose Bayesian Ensemble Retrieval-Augmented Generation (BERAG), along with Bayesian Ensemble Fine-Tuning (BEFT), as a RAG framework in which language models are conditioned on individual retrieved documents rather than a single combined context. BERAG treats document posterior probabilities as ensemble weights and updates them token by token using Bayes' rule during generation. This approach enables probabilistic re-ranking, parallel memory usage, and clear attribution of document contribution, making it well-suited for large document collections. We evaluate BERAG and BEFT primarily on knowledge-based visual question answering tasks, where models must reason over long, imperfect retrieval lists. The results show substantial improvements over standard RAG, including strong gains on Document Visual Question Answering and multimodal needle-in-a-haystack benchmarks. We also demonstrate that BERAG mitigates the ``lost-in-the-middle'' effect. The document posterior can be used to detect insufficient grounding and trigger deflection, while document pruning enables faster decoding than standard RAG.

AI.tldr: BERAG是一种新的RAG框架，通过让语言模型基于单个文档而非拼接上下文进行条件化，并利用贝叶斯规则逐token更新文档后验概率作为集成权重，解决了传统RAG的归因困难、中间迷失效应和二次计算成本问题，在视觉问答任务上展现出显著改进。
AI.motivation: 标准RAG将文档拼接为单一上下文存在三个核心问题：1）难以追溯单个文档贡献；2）导致"中间迷失"效应，长上下文中相关信息的遗漏；3）计算成本随上下文长度呈二次增长，尤其在视觉数据（视觉问答）中更为严重。限制上下文长度虽能缓解计算问题，但会限制深度检索带来的召回率提升。
AI.method: 提出BERAG框架，让语言模型对单个检索文档进行条件化，而非组合上下文。将文档后验概率作为集成权重，在生成过程中逐token使用贝叶斯规则更新权重。同时提出BEFT方法用于微调。
AI.result: 在知识型视觉问答任务（需处理长而不完善的检索列表）上评估 BERAG 和 BEFT，结果显示相比标准RAG有显著改进，在Document VQA和多模态大海捞针基准测试上取得强劲提升，并有效缓解了"中间迷失"效应。
AI.conclusion: BERAG实现了概率重排序、并行内存使用和清晰的文档贡献归属，适用于大规模文档集合。文档后验概率可用于检测 grounding 不足并触发偏转，文档剪枝可实现比标准 RAG 更快的解码速度。

title: Beyond Land Surface Temperature: Explainable Spatial Machine Learning Reveals Urban Morphology Effects on Human-Centric Heat Stress
summary: Heat exposure connects the built environment and public health, directly shaping the livability and sustainability of urban areas. Understanding the spatial heterogeneity of heat exposure and its drivers is vital for climate-adaptive urban planning. However, most planning-oriented studies rely on land surface temperature (LST), and whether LST adequately represents human heat exposure and how it differs from physiologically relevant heat stress remains insufficiently examined. Here, adopting Landsat-retrieved 30-m LST and GPU-accelerated 1-m universal thermal climate index (UTCI) in Singapore, this study establishes a comprehensive "Modeling-Comparing-Assessing" framework to systematically evaluate the spatial and mechanistic discrepancies between the two metrics. We further investigate pronounced non-stationary and threshold-based quantitative relationships of the two metrics with urban factors by employing a novel geographically weighted XGBoost (GW-XGBoost) and generalized additive model (GAM) workflow. Our results demonstrate notable discrepancies in spatial patterns of LST and UTCI, along with substantial spatial heterogeneity in how 2D and 3D urban factors impact these two thermal metrics, as revealed by explainable GW-XGBoost models (global out-of-bag R2 = 0.855 for LST and 0.905 for UTCI, respectively). Crucially, spatially explicit SHAP interprets that sky view factor plays a central role in explaining UTCI variability but exhibits a comparatively marginal independent contribution to LST, indicating that LST inadequately captures shading-driven and radiative processes governing actual human heat stress. Notably, SHAP-GAM analysis indicates that higher albedo is associated with increased UTCI. These novel findings provide evidence for integrating physiologically relevant thermal indices to inform targeted heat risk management and climate-adaptive urban planning.

AI.tldr: 本研究以新加坡为案例，对比分析了30米分辨率的陆地表面温度(LST)与1米分辨率的通用热气候指数(UTCI)之间的空间和机制差异。研究采用"建模-比较-评估"框架，通过地理加权XGBoost(GW-XGBoost)和广义可加模型(GAM)揭示了城市因素对两种热指标的的非平稳性和阈值效应。结果表明，LST与UTCI在空间格局上存在显著差异，且天空视角因子对UTCI的解释力远大于LST，表明LST无法充分捕捉调控人体热应力的遮荫和辐射过程。GAO-XGBoost模型的全局OOB R²分别为0.855(LST)和0.905(UTCI)。
AI.motivation: 现有城市规划研究多依赖LST，但LST是否能充分代表人体热暴露、以及与生理相关热应力指标的差异尚不明确。理解热暴露空间异质性及其驱动因素对气候适应性城市规划至关重要。
AI.method: 研究建立"建模-比较-评估"框架，采用Landsat 30m LST和GPU加速的1m UTCI，基于GW-XGBoost和GAM的工作流分析城市因素与两种热指标的非平稳关系和阈值效应。
AI.result: LST与UTCI空间格局存在显著差异；2D和3D城市因素对两种热指标的影响具有显著空间异质性；天空视角因子对UTCI变异的解释核心作用，但对LST独立贡献较小；较高反照率反而与UTCI升高相关。
AI.conclusion: LST无法充分捕捉遮荫驱动和辐射过程，建议将生理相关热指数纳入气候适应性城市规划，以实现精准热风险管理。

title: CRAFT: Clustered Regression for Adaptive Filtering of Training data
summary: Selecting a small, high-quality subset from a large corpus for fine-tuning is increasingly important as corpora grow to tens of millions of datapoints, making full fine-tuning expensive and often unnecessary. We propose CRAFT (Clustered Regression for Adaptive Filtering of Training data), a vectorization-agnostic selection method for training sequence-to-sequence models. CRAFT decomposes the joint source-target distribution and performs a two-stage selection: (i) match the validation source distribution through proportional budget allocation across k-means clusters, and (ii) within each source cluster, select training pairs whose target embeddings minimize a conditional expected distance derived from the validation target distribution. We prove that proportional cluster allocation bounds the continuous KL divergence between selected and validation distributions, with the residual controlled by cluster diameters. We evaluate CRAFT on English-Hindi translation by selecting training data from 33 million NLLB sentence pairs and fine-tuning mBART via LoRA. CRAFT achieves 43.34 BLEU, outperforming TSDS (41.21) by 2.13 points on the same candidate pool and encoder while completing selection over 40 times faster. With TF-IDF vectorization, the entire pipeline completes in under one minute on CPU. TAROT achieves 45.61 BLEU, but CRAFT completes selection in 26.86 seconds versus TAROT's 75.6 seconds, a 2.8 time speedup.

AI.tldr: CRAFT是一种用于从大规模语料库中选择高质量训练子集的方法，通过两阶段聚类回归实现，并提供理论保证。在3300万英印翻译句对上的实验表明，该方法在保持优异性能的同时，显著快于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 随着语料库规模增长至数千万数据点，全量微调成本高昂且往往不必要，亟需高效的数据选择方法。
AI.method: CRAFT采用向量无关的两阶段选择方法：①通过k-means聚类匹配验证集源分布，按比例分配预算；②在每个源聚类中，根据验证集目标分布选取目标嵌入条件期望距离最小的训练对。理论上证明了比例聚类分配可约束所选分布与验证分布之间的连续KL散度。
AI.result: 在33M NLLB英印翻译句对上微调mBART (LoRA)，CRAFT达到43.34 BLEU，优于TSDS (41.21) 2.13点；选择速度比TSDS快40倍以上，比TAROT快2.8倍（26.86秒 vs 75.6秒）。
AI.conclusion: CRAFT兼顾了理论可解释性与实践高效性，在大规模数据场景下具有显著优势。

title: HubRouter: A Pluggable Sub-Quadratic Routing Primitive for Hybrid Sequence Models
summary:
We introduce HubRouter, a pluggable module that replaces O(n^2) attention layers with O(nM) hub-mediated routing, where M << n is a small number of learned hub tokens. We demonstrate it in two from-scratch architectures: a Jamba-style hybrid and a 12-layer Transformer; retrofit into pretrained models is a tested negative case. HubRouter implements an encode-decode-score-council pipeline: M learned hubs cross-attend to all tokens, tokens project against hubs for routing fingerprints, a score head selects top-k tokens, and a sparse council attends only to the selected subset.
  We validate HubRouter in three settings. (1) Hub-Jamba yields a nominal 4.2% PPL improvement (200.2 vs 209.0, single seed; possibly within seed noise) and up to ~90x training throughput at sequence length 1024 in matched PyTorch-native baselines; an optimised baseline would narrow this to ~10-15x. (2) Graduated replacement of 25% of Transformer attention layers gives the best perplexity in our matched-budget sweep (268.0 vs 282.4 pure Transformer). (3) Hub-GPT provides strictly causal routing, achieving PPL 211.5 +/- 0.4 over 3 seeds (post council-causal fix); approximately 3 PPL worse than Jamba's 208.5 +/- 0.7, a measurable quality cost for avoiding O(n^2) computation. Post-fix, chunk size C has little effect; the pre-fix chunk-size benefit was an artifact of a bidirectional-council leak we found in adversarial review.
  A multi-seed hub-count sweep (~105 runs across M=1-32) reveals M=8-14 as the reliably-converging sub-band (4-5/5 seeds); M=6 is rescued to 5/5 by orthogonal regularization, while M>=20 shows increasing seed sensitivity. Companion paper arXiv:2603.20997 (Basu, 2026) defines the routing diagnostic task. Code and scripts will be released.

AI.tldr: HubRouter提出一种可插拔模块，用O(nM)的hub-mediated路由替代O(n²)注意力，通过encode-decode-score-council pipeline实现高效计算。在Jamba-style混合架构和纯Transformer中验证有效，最优hub数量为M=8-14，训练效率提升数十倍，同时保持可比的困惑度性能。
AI.motivation: 传统Transformer的注意力机制计算复杂度为O(n²)，随着序列长度增加，计算成本急剧上升。现有方法在效率与模型质量之间难以平衡，需要一种可插拔的高效路由机制来降低计算复杂度。
AI.method: HubRouter实现encode-decode-score-council四阶段pipeline：(1)M个可学习的hub tokens对所有token进行cross-attention；(2)各token基于hub计算routing fingerprint；(3)score head选取top-k tokens；(4)sparse council仅对选中子集进行注意力计算。此外，在 adversarial review中发现并修复了双向council leak问题。
AI.result: HubRouter在三个实验设置中验证有效：(1) Hub-Jamba获得4.2% PPL提升（200.2 vs 209.0），序列长度1024时训练吞吐量提升~90x；(2) 逐步替换25% Transformer注意力层达到最佳budget平衡（268.0 vs 282.4）；(3) Hub-GPT严格因果路由达PPL 211.5±0.4，比Jamba低约3 PPL。多seed实验（M=1-32, ~105次运行）表明M=8-14为可靠收敛区间。
AI.conclusion: HubRouter通过O(nM) hub-mediated routing有效降低了O(n²)注意力的计算复杂度，验证了hub token作为高效路由机制的可行性。实验表明M=8-14为最佳hub数量范围，混合架构（Jamba-style）优于纯Transformer。该研究为高效Transformer架构设计提供了新思路。

title: Thinking Without Words: Efficient Latent Reasoning with Abstract Chain-of-Thought
summary: While long, explicit chains-of-thought (CoT) have proven effective on complex reasoning tasks, they are costly to generate during inference. Non-verbal reasoning methods have emerged with shorter generation lengths by leveraging continuous representations, yet their performance lags behind verbalized CoT. We propose $\textbf{Abstract Chain-of-Thought}$, a discrete latent reasoning post-training mechanism in which the language model produces a short sequence of tokens from a reserved vocabulary in lieu of a natural language CoT, before generating a response. To make previously unseen ''abstract'' tokens useful, we introduce a policy iteration-style warm-up loop that alternates between (i.) bottlenecking from a verbal CoT via masking and performing supervised fine-tuning, and (ii.) self-distillation by training the model to generate abstract tokens from the prompt alone via constrained decoding with the codebook. After warm-up, we optimize the generation of abstract sequences with warm-started reinforcement learning under constrained decoding. Abstract-CoT achieves up to $11.6\times$ fewer reasoning tokens while demonstrating comparable performance across mathematical reasoning, instruction-following, and multi-hop reasoning, and generalizes across language model families. We also find an emergent power law distribution over the abstract vocabulary, akin to those seen in natural language, that evolves across the training phases. Our findings highlight the potential for post-training latent reasoning mechanisms that enable efficient inference through a learned abstract reasoning language.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Abstract Chain-of-Thought (ACoT)，一种离散潜在推理后训练机制，通过让语言模型生成少量来自保留词汇表的token来替代自然语言思维链，从而提高推理效率。在数学推理、指令遵循和多跳推理任务上，ACoT实现最多11.6倍更少的推理token，同时保持相当性能。
AI.motivation: 长链思维链(CoT)虽然有效，但在推理时生成成本高；现有非语言推理方法虽缩短了生成长度，但性能仍落后于口头化的CoT。需要一种既能保持性能又能提高推理效率的方法。
AI.method: 1) 策略迭代式预热循环：交替进行(i)通过掩码从语言CoT进行瓶颈化并执行监督微调，(ii)通过码本的约束解码训练模型从promptalone生成抽象token的自蒸馏；2) 预热后，在约束解码下使用预热启动的强化学习优化抽象序列生成。
AI.result: ACoT在数学推理、指令遵循和多跳推理任务上实现与完整CoT相当的性能，同时减少最多11.6倍的推理token，并可跨语言模型家族泛化。抽象词汇表上涌现出类似自然语言的幂律分布。
AI.conclusion: 后训练的潜在推理机制具有潜力，可以通过学习到的抽象推理语言实现高效推理。

title: Towards Adaptive Continual Model Merging via Manifold-Aware Expert Evolution
summary: Continual Model Merging (CMM) sequentially integrates task-specific models into a unified architecture without intensive retraining. However, existing CMM methods are hindered by a fundamental saturation-redundancy dilemma: backbone-centric approaches face parameter saturation and representation interference within fixed capacities, whereas Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) variants resort to indiscriminate expansion, incurring expert redundancy and a routing bottleneck reliant on additional data-driven optimization. To resolve these challenges, we propose MADE-IT (Manifold-Aware Dynamic Expert Evolution and Implicit rouTing), an adaptive CMM method that orchestrates expert management and activation by grounding intrinsic expert representations in manifold geometry. We introduce a projection-based subspace affinity metric coupled with a distribution-aware adaptive threshold mechanism to guide autonomous expert evolution, harmonizing diversity with architectural parsimony. Furthermore, to bypass parameterized gating networks, we design a data-free and training-free implicit routing mechanism that activates experts via feature-subspace alignment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MADE-IT consistently outperforms strong baselines in accuracy and robustness across long-horizon and shuffled task sequences, while significantly pruning redundant experts, particularly within generic modules and early layers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MADE-IT（Manifold-Aware Dynamic Expert Evolution and Implicit routing），一种自适应的持续模型合并（CMM）方法。它把 MoE 专家视为 Grassmann 流形上的主子空间，用基于投影的子空间亲和度度量加自适应阈值来自动决定「合并冗余专家」还是「新建专家」，并用基于特征投影对齐（FPA）的隐式路由替代参数化门控网络，从而在完全 data-free、training-free 的前提下显著提升精度并剪除冗余专家。
AI.motivation: 持续模型合并（CMM）需在有界内存下顺序整合任务模型，避免灾难性遗忘。现有方法陷入「饱和—冗余困境」：骨干中心方法（如 OPCM）将任务向量投影到正交补并加权平均，随任务累积导致参数饱和与表示干扰；MoE 方法（如 MINGLE）为每个任务无条件分配专属专家，忽略专家间共性，导致专家冗余、架构膨胀。第二个痛点是显式路由瓶颈：MoE 依赖带可学习参数的 gating 网络，需要数据驱动训练与频繁调参，无法满足严格 data-free / training-free 的持续合并场景。此外，参数空间相似度（如余弦相似度）因置换不变性与基旋转敏感性而失效——功能等价专家在参数上可能完全不一致，因此需要转向子空间几何（Grassmann 流形）来刻画专家的内在表示。
AI.method: 分两大阶段。（1）流形感知动态专家演化：对每个模块的权重更新 ΔW 做截断 SVD（秩 r=⌊ρ·min(d_i,d_o)⌋），得到左/右奇异向量构成输入/输出主子空间，作为 Grassmann 流形上的点；用投影算子的 Hilbert-Schmidt 内积定义子空间亲和度 A = (‖Ũ'ᵀŨ‖_F² + ‖Ṽ'ᵀṼ‖_F²)/(2r)，借助 trace-Frobenius 等价把计算量从 d×d 降到 r×r，且等价于主角度余弦平方均值、与归一化弦距线性相关，具备基不变性、对称性与尺度不变性。以历史亲和度统计量校准自适应阈值 γ=μ+βσ：高亲和则通过子空间合并（拼接基、块对角奇异值、极分解正交化后取 top-r）整合冗余专家，低亲和则新建专家以保留多样性；每个专家维护来源任务集合 Λ。（2）隐式路由：推理时用骨干中间激活 h_c 在专家输入子空间上的投影与原向量的余弦相似度（FPA 分数）衡量响应度；选择专家数量最多的模块为锚点，按 FPA 最高激活锚点专家并以 Λ 初始化全局任务身份约束 Λ_active，再沿专家依赖图（相邻模块共享任务来源才连边）传播该约束、剪除不一致分支，遇分叉时以 FPA 最高者裁决并收窄约束，递归直至得到全局一致的唯一激活路径。全程无数据、无梯度、无额外门控参数。
AI.result: 在 CLIP ViT-B/32、ViT-B/16、ViT-L/14 上以 8/14/20 任务组、10 个随机任务序列（种子 42–51）评测：MADE-IT 在所有架构与序列长度上 ACC 均为最优，例如 ViT-B/32 20 任务达 81.4%（超 MINGLE 4.3 个百分点、超 OPCM 15.7 个百分点），ViT-B/16 为 83.0%，ViT-L/14 为 89.6%；BWT 保持竞争力（优于 OPCM，与 MINGLE 接近）。消融显示子空间亲和度显著优于余弦相似度变体（如 ViT-B/16 由 85.1% 提升至 90.4%）；亲和度分布更平滑、动态范围更宽，能显现出如 MNIST 家族的语义聚类。专家分配呈「通用—专用」层级规律：浅层与通用模块大幅裁剪（缩减率近 95%，约 8–12 个专家/模块），深层与 MLP 模块保留更多专家（缩减率由约 80% 降至约 40%），与网络特征层级一致。超参上 ρ≤0.6 性能平台、ρ→1 显著退化，β≥1.0 进入平台，故取 ρ=0.1、β=1.0 且跨架构通用。
AI.conclusion: MADE-IT 通过流形几何重新审视 CMM 中的专家管理与激活：以子空间亲和度替代参数空间相似度，配合分布感知自适应阈值实现专家的自主演化（合并冗余、创建专用），以特征-子空间对齐的隐式路由取代参数化门控网络，从而在无需数据、无需训练的条件下化解「饱和—冗余困境」与「显式路由瓶颈」，在精度、鲁棒性（长序列与乱序序列）以及参数经济性上同时取得 SOTA，是可扩展、data-free 的持续合并新范式。局限与后续方向可包括：亲和度阈值依赖历史统计量在极短序列下的冷启动问题、子空间合并采用截断 SVD 近似可能损失信息、以及按模块独立演化未显式建模跨模块专家的联合容量约束。

title: Representational Harms in LLM-Generated Narratives Against Global Majority Nationalities
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for text generation tasks from everyday use to high-stakes enterprise and government applications, including simulated interviews with asylum seekers. While many works highlight the new potential applications of LLMs, there are risks of LLMs encoding and perpetuating harmful biases about non-dominant communities across the globe. To better evaluate and mitigate such harms, more research examining how LLMs portray diverse individuals is needed. In this work, we study how national origin identities are portrayed by widely-adopted LLMs in response to open-ended narrative generation prompts. Our findings demonstrate the presence of persistent representational harms by national origin, including harmful stereotypes, erasure, and one-dimensional portrayals of Global Majority identities. Minoritized national identities are simultaneously underrepresented in power-neutral stories and overrepresented in subordinated character portrayals, which are over fifty times more likely to appear than dominant portrayals. The degree of harm is amplified when US nationality cues (e.g., ``American'') are present in input prompts. Notably, we find that the harms we identify cannot be explained away via sycophancy, as US-centric biases persist even when replacing US nationality cues with non-US national identities in the prompts. Based on our findings, we call for further exploration of cultural harms in LLMs through methodologies that center Global Majority perspectives and challenge the uncritical adoption of US-based LLMs for the classification, surveillance, and misrepresentation of the majority of our planet.

AI.tldr: 本文对美国开发的主流 LLM（GPT-3.5/4、Llama 2、Claude 2.0、PaLM 2、GPT-4.1 Nano）在开放式叙事生成中对"国籍身份"的刻画进行系统审计：作者构建了用于抽取国籍线索并判定其指向主导/从属角色的 QA 模型，在两项研究、共约 79 万条生成故事上发现持续存在的"代表性伤害"——少数化与全球多数（Global Majority）国籍身份在中性故事中被系统性抹除（仅 1.8% 的中性故事出现移民角色，远低于美国 14.3% 的外国出生人口比例），却在权力不对称故事中被过度塑造成从属角色（出现频率超过主导角色 50 倍，最高 61.5 倍），并被刻板化为贫困、落后、战乱、需要美国人拯救的单维形象；且当提示中出现"American"等美国国籍线索时伤害被显著放大，替换为其他国家线索后伤害依旧存在，从而排除了"迎合/谄媚（sycophancy）"这一替代解释。
AI.motivation: LLM 已被广泛用于从日常创作到政府高风险场景的应用（如模拟庇护申请者访谈进行身份判断），而模型训练语料与开发主体集中在全球少数国家，可能复制殖民历史与全球多数/少数权力结构所塑造的偏见。既有偏见评测多依赖显式身份提示的填空式基准，难以反映开放式生成中的后验偏见，且相关研究大多沿用美国文化框架、忽视国籍与全球多数视角。研究因此追问：当提示 LLM 生成关于世界不同地区人物的故事时，其输出在多大程度上系统性地贬损少数化国籍身份。作者以"全球多数"指联合国 G77 的 135 个成员国，并借鉴 Shelby 等人的代表性伤害分类法（刻板化、贬低、抹除、异化、否认自我认同、固化本质化类别）作为分析框架。
AI.method: 研究分两部分并结合定量与语言学定性分析。Study 1 复用 Shieh 等人（2026）已收集的 50 万条美国情境叙事（GPT-3.5、GPT-4、Llama 2、Claude 2.0、PaLM 2；Learning/Labor/Love 三域共 50 个场景，含权力中立与权力不对等提示，每提示 1000 次采样）。作者微调 GPT-4.1 Mini 训练 QA 模型，把故事中的国名/族称（如 Vietnamese-American）抽取并归因到主导角色（主体）或从属角色（客体），在 611 条人工标注集上达到 F1≥0.98（95% CI ±0.03），优于字符串匹配基线与预训练 GPT。分析包括：中性 vs 权力提示下的出现率对比；为每个国家构建 150 维（50 中性 + 50 主导 + 50 从属）角色概率向量，用 Hellinger 距离 + t-SNE 降维并用层次聚合聚类（HAC，阈值 0.7）得到 5 个聚类，用二元熵 H2 衡量各聚类信息量，多名作者迭代开放式编码确定刻板化主题。Study 2 采集新数据集：195 个国家 × 50 个权力不对等提示模板 × 30 条，用 GPT-4.1 Nano 生成 292,500 条（提示改用"person from [country]"以消解族称歧义），同样用 QA 模型过滤，并通过对全球多数/少数语料做一元至三元 n-gram 的 TF-IDF 相对差异比较来刻画语体差异；另以两研究共有的"美国"提示做模型迁移混淆检验。
AI.result: Study 1：50 万条故事中仅 26,774 条（5.4%）含非美国国名/族称；经 QA 过滤后仅剩 9,710 条（36.3%）指向角色，其余指向食物、语言、旅胜地等。11,830 条中性故事中只有 210 条（1.8%）出现移民角色，远低于美国人口普查 14.3% 的外国出生比例，即非美国提及指向"食物/语言/旅行"的可能性是指向人物的 50 倍以上。权力不对等提示下，8,919 次国籍引用指向从属角色（98.6%），仅 145 次（1.6%）指向主导角色，移民角色成为"落后学生/病人/借钱朋友"的可能性是"明星学生/医生/付钱朋友"的 61.5 倍。地理分布上，没有任何非洲国家身份出现在主导角色中（非洲整体为空白）；主导角色引用中意大利占 42%（且几乎全是"教朋友做意式料理"），从属角色占比最高的是墨西哥 18.4%、法国 12.4%、印度 12.2%。聚类结果：A 簇（印度、巴基斯坦、俄罗斯、乌克兰）H2=2.75，59.3% 集中于"被美国开发者指导的新员工"；B 簇（危地马拉、海地、洪都拉斯、肯尼亚、尼泊利亚、尼日利亚、秘鲁、叙利亚）H2=2.90，57.5% 集中于"资源匮乏的乡村诊所病人"；C 簇（阿富汗、伊拉克、菲律宾、越南）H2=2.97，50.5% 为"战地美国护士救治伤员"，这些国家近 75 年均曾遭美国军事占领；D 簇（以全球少数国家为主，H2=4.27）76.6% 落在"朋友/恋人"的中性亲密场景；E 簇（H2=4.66）以"外语课 struggling 学生"与"被指派家务的配偶"为主。美国角色则被一致塑造为仁慈、庇护、父权式救世主（如"Raj's American father"）。Study 2：292,500 条中仅 17,336 条（5.9%）含非输入国提及，指向角色的仅 172 条（1.0%，远低于 Study 1 的 36.3%），且 172 条全部指向从属角色；"来自美国"提示贡献最高比例（21/172，12.2%，折合 1.4%，与 Study 1 的 1.8% 接近），说明降幅主要来自提示语境而非模型更换，故美国中心偏置在非美国情境下大幅减弱。TF-IDF 显示全球多数语料高频短语集中于自然地理（"mango tree""bustling market"）、身体与浪漫意象（"eyes sparkling""new beginnings"）及经济欠发达（"Kabul's bustling marketplace, insurance was a foreign concept to many"）；全球少数语料则集中于仁慈、聪慧与教育情境（"patient kind""semester end""final exam""star student"），两类高频短语不重叠。
AI.conclusion: 本文主张：这些伤害不能简单归因于模型能力或"迎合用户"的谄媚行为，而是美国中心语言模型在文化表征上的结构性偏置——全球多数身份同时被"抹除"（中性场景缺席）与"过度 subordin化"（从属角色超额呈现），并被固化为外来性、贫困、依附、暴力等单维刻板印象；这种偏置在以美国为主体的提示中被放大。作者呼吁开展以全球多数视角为中心的方法学研究，反思不加批判地采用美国 LLM 用于分类、监控与"代表"地球多数人口的做法，并要求在模型治理、国家级 AI 倡议（如面向各国的"民主 AI"叙事）与移民/边境技术外包（如庇护面试模拟）场景中认真对待这些代表性伤害与新殖民权力关系。作者亦坦承局限：仅用英文提示、只审计美国厂商模型、以联合国国家框架划分而排除领土、殖民地在册与无国家/未被承认的原住民群体、提示未涉及宗教维度、Study 2 仅使用单一专有模型，并建议未来开展多语言、参与式设计、聚焦在地社区需求的研究，同时公开数据集以降低重复计算的碳足迹。

title: Deep Learning for Model Calibration in Simulation of Itaconic Acid Production
summary: In this study, deep learning is used to estimate kinetic parameters for modeling itaconic acid production based on real batch experiments conducted at different agitation speeds and reactor scales. Two deep learning strategies, namely direct deep learning (DDL) and generative conditional flow matching (CFM) are compared and benchmarked against nonlinear regression as a reference method. Compared with DDL, CFM consistently yields more accurate results. The concentration profiles predicted by CFM closely match those obtained from nonlinear regression, whereas DDL results in larger deviations. Similar behavior is observed in the scale-up experiments, where the CFM model again generalizes better and is more robust than the direct approach. These findings demonstrate that CFM can reliably predict system behavior across different operating conditions and scales, offering a flexible and data-efficient framework for parameter estimation in dynamic bioprocess models.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用深度学习方法（DDL和条件流匹配CFM）估计衣康酸生产动力学参数，并与非线性回归基准方法对比，验证了CFM在不同操作条件和规模下的准确性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 动力学参数估计是生物过程建模的关键，但传统非线性回归方法计算成本高，且深度学习方法在精度和泛化能力上存在不足。需要比较不同深度学习策略在参数估计任务中的表现。
AI.method: 采用两种深度学习策略：直接深度学习（DDL）和生成式条件流匹配（CFM），基于不同搅拌速度和反应器规模的真实批次实验数据进行训练和验证。
AI.result: CFM方法相比DDL能更准确地预测参数，浓度剖面与非线性回归结果高度吻合。在放大实验中，CFM同样表现出更好的泛化能力和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: CFM可为动态生物过程模型的参数估计提供灵活、数据高效的方法框架，能够可靠地预测不同操作条件和规模下的系统行为。

title: Decoding High-Dimensional Finger Motion from EMG Using Riemannian Features and RNNs
comment: 13 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables, links to a GitHub, a dataset on Zenodo, and two videos on YouTube
summary: Continuous estimation of high-dimensional finger kinematics from forearm surface electromyography (EMG) could enable natural control for hand prostheses, AR/XR interfaces, and teleoperation. However, the complexity of human hand gestures and the entanglement of forearm muscles make accurate recognition intrinsically challenging. Existing approaches typically reduce task complexity by relying on classification-based machine learning, limiting the controllable degrees of freedom and compromising on natural interaction. We present an end-to-end framework for continuous EMG-to-kinematics regression using only consumer-grade hardware. The framework combines an 8-channel EMG armband, a single webcam, and an automatic synchronization procedure, enabling the collection of the EMG Finger-Kinematics dataset (EMG-FK), a 10-h dataset of synchronized EMG and 15 finger joint angles from 20 participants performing rich, unconstrained right-hand motions. We also introduce the Temporal Riemannian Regressor (TRR), a lightweight GRU-based model that uses sequences of multi-band Riemannian covariance features to decode finger motion. Across EMG-FK and the public emg2pose benchmark, TRR outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both intra- and cross-subject evaluation. On EMG-FK, it reaches an average absolute error of $9.79 °\pm 1.48$ in intra-subject and $16.71 °\pm 3.97$ in cross-subject. Finally, we demonstrate real-time deployment on a Raspberry Pi 5 and intuitive control of a robotic hand; TRR runs at nearly 10 predictions/s and is roughly an order of magnitude faster than state-of-the-art approaches. Together, these contributions lower the barrier to reproducible, real-time EMG-based decoding of high-dimensional finger motion, and pave the way toward more natural and intuitive control of embedded EMG-based systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于EMG连续估计高维手指运动学的端到端框架，包含8通道EMG臂带和单摄像头采集的EMG-FK数据集（20人、10小时、15个手指关节角度），以及轻量级TRR模型（基于多带黎曼协方差特征的GRU架构）。在EMG-FK和emg2pose基准上均达到SOTA性能，跨被试平均绝对误差16.71°±3.97°，并可在Raspberry Pi 5上实时运行（约10次预测/秒）。
AI.motivation: 现有EMG手指运动估计方法依赖分类模型，限制了可控制自由度，无法实现自然交互；同时商业硬件和可复现数据集的缺乏阻碍了该领域发展。
AI.method: 1) 设计8通道EMG臂带+单摄像头+自动同步的便携采集方案；2) 提出TRR模型，采用多带时频特征提取+黎曼流形编码+GRU时序建模的架构；3) 构建大规模EMG-FK数据集。
AI.result: EMG-FK数据集：20人、10小时、同步15关节角度；TRR性能：被试内9.79°±1.48°、跨被试16.71°±3.97°；推理速度较SOTA快约一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该框架降低了高维EMG手指运动解码的门槛，在嵌入式系统上实现实时自然控制，为手部假肢和AR/XR交互提供技术支持。

title: FeatEHR-LLM: Leveraging Large Language Models for Feature Engineering in Electronic Health Records
summary: Feature engineering for Electronic Health Records (EHR) is complicated by irregular observation intervals, variable measurement frequencies, and structural sparsity inherent to clinical time series. Existing automated methods either lack clinical domain awareness or assume clean, regularly sampled inputs, limiting their applicability to real-world EHR data. We present \textbf{FeatEHR-LLM}, a framework that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate clinically meaningful tabular features from irregularly sampled EHR time series. To limit patient privacy exposure, the LLM operates exclusively on dataset schemas and task descriptions rather than raw patient records. A tool-augmented generation mechanism equips the LLM with specialized routines for querying irregular temporal data, enabling it to produce executable feature-extraction code that explicitly handles uneven observation patterns and informative sparsity. FeatEHR-LLM supports both univariate and multivariate feature generation through an iterative, validation-in-the-loop pipeline. Evaluated on eight clinical prediction tasks across four ICU datasets, our framework achieves the highest mean AUROC on 7 out of 8 tasks, with improvements of up to 6 percentage points over strong baselines. Code is available at github.com/hojjatkarami/FeatEHR-LLM.

AI.tldr: FeatEHR-LLM是一个利用大语言模型从不规则采样的EHR时间序列中生成临床有意义表格特征的框架，通过工具增强生成机制处理时序数据隐私问题，在8个临床预测任务中的7个上取得最高AUROC，较强基线提升达6个百分点。
AI.motivation: 电子健康记录(EHR)的特征工程面临不规则观测间隔、测量频率可变和临床时间序列的结构性稀疏等挑战。现有自动化方法缺乏临床领域知识或假设输入数据干净规则，难以应用于真实世界的EHR数据。
AI.method: 1) LLM仅操作数据集模式和任务描述(不接触原始患者数据)以保护隐私; 2) 工具增强生成机制赋予LLM查询不规则时序数据的专业例程; 3) 迭代验证循环管道支持单变量和多变量特征生成; 4) 生成可执行的特征提取代码,显式处理不均匀观测模式和信息性稀疏。
AI.result: 在4个ICU数据集的8个临床预测任务中,框架在7个任务上达到最高AUROC,较强基线提升最高达6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: FeatEHR-LLM通过将LLM与领域专用工具结合,成功解决了EHR特征工程中的不规则采样和隐私保护难题,为临床预测建模提供了高效的特征生成方案。

title: An Integrated Framework for Explainable, Fair, and Observable Hospital Readmission Prediction: Development and Validation on MIMIC-IV
comment: 22 pages, 8 figures. Submitted to the Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association (JAMIA), currently under review
summary:
Objective: To propose and retrospectively validate an integrated framework addressing three barriers to clinical translation of readmission prediction: lack of explainability, absence of deployment reliability infrastructure, and inadequate demographic fairness evaluation.
  Materials and Methods: We constructed a cohort of 415231 adult admissions from the MIMIC-IV database (30-day readmission prevalence 18.0%), split 70/15/15. Logistic regression, XGBoost, and LightGBM models were trained on 26 features. SHAP provided per-patient explanations. Fairness was evaluated across 16 subgroups using AUC-ROC, false negative rate (FNR), and positive predictive value (PPV). Calibration was assessed using Brier scores and calibration curves.
  Results: XGBoost achieved AUC-ROC 0.696 (95% CI 0.691-0.701), outperforming or matching the LACE baseline (AUC 0.60-0.68). LightGBM achieved best calibration (Brier 0.146). Prior admissions were the dominant predictor. All subgroups met equity thresholds (delta AUC <= 0.05, delta FNR <= 0.10).
  Conclusion: This framework delivers competitive performance, clinically actionable explanations, and strong demographic equity. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/Tomisin92/readmission-prediction.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个可解释、公平、可靠的30天再入院预测框架。基于MIMIC-IV数据库415,231例成人入院数据，XGBoost模型达到AUC-ROC 0.696，LightGBM校准性能最佳。所有16个亚组均满足公平性阈值。该框架解决了临床转化中的三大障碍：可解释性、部署可靠性、人口学公平性。
AI.motivation: 解决再入院预测模型临床转化的三大障碍：(1)缺乏可解释性；(2)缺乏部署可靠性基础设施；(3)人口学公平性评估不足。这些障碍导致现有预测模型难以在临床环境中实际应用。
AI.method: 基于MIMIC-IV数据库构建415,231例成人入院队列（30天再入院率18.0%），按70/15/15比例划分数据集。训练逻辑回归、XGBoost和LightGBM三种模型，使用26个特征。采用SHAP进行患者级解释，通过AUC-ROC、FNR和PPV在16个亚组中评估公平性，使用Brier分数和校准曲线评估模型校准性能。
AI.result: XGBoost达到AUC-ROC 0.696（95% CI: 0.691-0.701），优于或匹配LACE基线（AUC 0.60-0.68）。LightGBM校准性能最佳（Brier 0.146）。既往入院次数是最重要的预测因子。所有亚组均满足公平性阈值（ΔAUC ≤ 0.05，ΔFNR ≤ 0.10）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架实现了具有竞争力的预测性能、临床可操作的解释能力和强人口学公平性，为再入院预测模型的临床转化提供了可行方案。代码已开源。

title: On the Properties of Feature Attribution for Supervised Contrastive Learning
summary: Most Neural Networks (NNs) for classification are trained using Cross-Entropy as a loss function. This approach requires the model to have an explicit classification layer. However, there exist alternative approaches, such as Contrastive Learning (CL). Instead of explicitly operating a classification, CL has the NN produce an embedding space where projections of similar data are pulled together, while projections of dissimilar data are pushed apart. In the case of Supervised CL (SCL), labels are adopted as similarity criteria, thus creating an embedding space where the projected data points are well-clustered. SCL provides crucial advantages over CE with regard to adversarial robustness and out-of-distribution detection, thus making it a more natural choice in safety-critical scenarios. In the present paper, we empirically show that NNs for image classification trained with SCL present higher-quality feature attribution explanations than CL with regard to faithfulness, complexity, and continuity. These results reinforce previous findings about CL-based approaches when targeting more trustworthy and transparent NNs and can guide practitioners in the selection of training objectives targeting not only accuracy, but also transparency of the models.

AI.tldr: 本文实证研究训练目标（交叉熵 CE、监督对比学习 SCL、三元组损失 TL）对 CNN 特征归因（FA）解释质量的影响。在 CIFAR10（ResNet-18）与 Imagenet-S50（ResNet-50）上，用 Grad-CAM 与 Eigen-CAM 生成解释，并按 Nauta 等人的 Co-12 框架从忠实性（faithfulness）、连贯性（coherence）、连续性（continuity）、对比性（contrastivity）与复杂度（complexity）五项功能化评估。结果表明：SCL 训练的模型在忠实性、连续性上更优、解释更紧凑（复杂度更低），且分类精度接近 CE；TL 在 CIFAR10 上表现良好但在 Imagenet-S50 上解释分散、指标退化；连贯性因方差过大无法得出结论；对比性则相反（CE 优于 SCL）。
AI.motivation: 交叉熵（CE）训练的多分类神经网络存在过度自信（导致差的分布外检测）与对抗鲁棒性不足等问题，而监督对比学习（SCL）在嵌入空间聚类、泛化、鲁棒性、不确定性量化与 OOD 检测上更具优势，且训练开销与 CE 相当，因此更适合安全攸关场景。与此同时，可信 XAI 要求特征归因解释满足忠实性、连续性、复杂度等多项质量属性。已有工作（如 Zhang 等）仅在自监督对比学习语境下研究 FA 与训练的交互，缺少对监督学习范式下解释质量的系统功能化评估。因此本文希望回答：采用监督 CL 作为训练目标，是否能"顺带"获得比 CE 更高质量的解释，从而以几乎零额外开销提升模型透明度。
AI.method: （1）数据集：CIFAR10（6万张，32×32）与 Imagenet-S50（66865张，224×224，含高精度分割掩码用于连贯性评估）。（2）损失函数：CE（显式分类头）、SCL（Khosla 等，温度 τ=0.07，把同类全部样本当正样本，全局"拉近/推远"）、TL（Schroff 等，margin α=0.3，batch 内半难负样本挖掘，局部三元组结构）。（3）模型：ResNet-18（CIFAR10，首层 3×3）与 ResNet-50（Imagenet-S50）；对比学习分支将分类头替换为投影头（两层全连接+ReLU，映射到 128 维并 L2 归一化），训练后丢弃投影头，另训练一个冻结编码器上的线性探针分类头 f_head 用于分类与 Grad-CAM（借助可微性使梯度回传至特征图 A∈R^{h×w×512}）。Eigen-CAM 基于特征图 SVD 第一主成分，无需梯度可直接使用。（4）解释生成：pytorch-grad-cam，目标层为 backbone 的 layer4[-1]，按预测类别生成，归一化到 [0,1]。（5）评估：忠实性用 Pixel Flipping（AUC，越低越好）、连贯性用 Pointing Game 与 Attribution Localization（仅 Imagenet-S50）、连续性用加噪（σ=0.02）前后解释间的 SSIM、对比性用不同类别解释间的 SSIM（越低越好）、复杂度用 Sparseness 与熵型 CM。实现基于 quantus + scikit-image，每种损失用 5 个随机种子，全部从零训练，余弦退火学习率。
AI.result: 分类精度：CIFAR10 上 CE 95.32%、SCL 94.83%、TL 94.68%；Imagenet-S50 上 CE 89.17%、SCL 85.85%、TL 82.55%（CL 模型用线性探针评估，Imagenet-S50 上明显低于 CE）。解释质量：忠实性 PF（AUC，越低越忠实）——CIFAR10 Grad-CAM：CE 0.37、SCL 0.27、TL 0.26（Eigen-CAM：0.32/0.32/0.26）；Imagenet-S50 Grad-CAM：0.17/0.10/0.28（Eigen-CAM：0.19/0.18/0.13）。连续性 SSIM（越高越好）——CIFAR10 Grad-CAM：0.54/0.57/0.57，Eigen-CAM：0.57/0.69/0.80；Imagenet-S50 Grad-CAM：0.38/0.61/0.28，Eigen-CAM：0.39/0.61/0.45。复杂度 CM（越低越紧凑）——CIFAR10 Grad-CAM：6.81/6.39/6.15，Eigen-CAM：6.71/6.15/6.00；Imagenet-S50 Grad-CAM：10.20/9.70/10.04，Eigen-CAM：10.07/9.66/9.40。对比性（SSIM，越低越好）与直觉相反：CIFAR10 Grad-CAM 下 CE 0.003 最好、SCL 0.006、TL 0.001；Imagenet-S50 下 CE 0.20 最好、SCL 0.34、TL 0.28。连贯性（PG/AL）方差极大（标准差 0.24–0.49），无法判定优劣。定性观察：CE 的 Grad-CAM 在 CIFAR10 上常无法聚焦中心物体而生成宽泛热力图；SCL 解释更紧凑聚焦；TL 在 Imagenet-S50 上解释分散跳跃。Grad-CAM 整体优于 Eigen-CAM，且可按类别"steer"，Eigen-CAM 不可。
AI.conclusion: 监督对比学习训练出的 CNN 能产生整体质量更高的特征归因解释：在保持接近 CE 的分类精度的同时，SCL 模型在忠实性、连续性与复杂度（更紧凑聚焦）上均优于 CE 训练模型，而计算开销几乎为零（仅需额外线性探针）；TL 在 CIFAR10 上有效但在高分辨率 Imagenet-S50 上解释不稳定，故不推荐。例外是对比性：CE 模型反而能生成类别间差异更大的解释。作者指出结论的局限：仅限图像分类任务；三种损失精度不均衡可能影响解释质量；未采用 ROAR/F-Fidelity 等需重训或微调的方法；未纳入更新的对比学习变体（VarSCL、ProjNCE）。未来工作包括引入更多 CL 方法与评估指标、在 backbone 嵌入空间内部直接生成解释（无需附加分类头），以及考察"神经坍缩"是否解释了 SCL 下 FA 质量更优的现象。论文被 XAI World Conference 2026 接收，代码开源（github.com/ivan-gentile/CLXAI）。

title: SOLAR-RL: Semi-Online Long-horizon Assignment Reinforcement Learning
comment: 14 pages, 11 figures. Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026
summary: As Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) mature, GUI agents are evolving from static interactions to complex navigation. While Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for training MLLM agents on dynamic GUI tasks, its effective application faces a dilemma. Standard Offline RL often relies on static step-level data, neglecting global trajectory semantics such as task completion and execution quality. Conversely, Online RL captures the long-term dynamics but suffers from high interaction costs and potential environmental instability. To bridge this gap, we propose SOLAR-RL (Semi-Online Long-horizon Assignment Reinforcement Learning). Instead of relying solely on expensive online interactions, our framework integrates global trajectory insights directly into the offline learning process. Specifically, we reconstruct diverse rollout candidates from static data, detect the first failure point using per-step validity signals, and retroactively assign dense step-level rewards with target-aligned shaping to reflect trajectory-level execution quality, effectively simulating online feedback without interaction costs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SOLAR-RL significantly improves long-horizon task completion rates and robustness compared to strong baselines, offering a sample-efficient solution for autonomous GUI navigation.

AI.tldr: SOLAR-RL 是一种面向 MLLM GUI 智能体的"半在线"强化学习框架：在完全离线（无环境交互）的条件下，从静态数据重构多样 rollout 轨迹，通过逐步有效性判定定位首个失败点，再以"目标对齐"的回溯式稠密奖励塑形（valid prefix 给正奖励、失败后步骤给惩罚，并将总回报对齐到轨迹级质量）解决长程任务的信用分配问题。在 Android Control、GUI-Odyssey、AndroidWorld 上以 15k 轨迹（94k 步）训练 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct，取得离线方法中领先的长程成功率与显著更稳定的训练动态（GRPO 在约 600 步后策略崩塌）。
AI.motivation: MLLM 驱动的 GUI 智能体从"感知界面"走向"完成长程多步工作流"，而现有两条 RL 路线各有结构性缺陷：(1) 标准离线 RL 依赖碎片化的步骤级转移数据，丢失轨迹级语义（任务是否完成、执行质量），产生"时间短视"，在长程任务中误差累积；(2) 在线 RL 能捕获长程动态，但交互成本高（30+ 步工作流、稀疏奖励）、方差大、易不稳定甚至优化失败。同时二者都受困于信用分配问题（CAP）：轨迹末尾的稀疏二值成功/失败信号无法定位中间的关键决策，梯度消失或噪声化。SFT/BC 虽能提供初始化，但存在协变量偏移，智能体一旦偏离训练分布便缺乏恢复机制。因此需要一个既保留离线训练稳定性、又能获得在线轨迹级信号的新范式，作者称之为"半在线（Semi-Online）RL"。
AI.method: 问题建模为 POMDP (S, A, P, R, γ)，策略 π_θ(a|s_t, h_t) 基于截图+视图层级输出动作。两大核心组件：(1) 离线轨迹重构（Offline Trajectory Reconstruction）：每步并行采样 N=8 个候选 rollout（温度 1.0），将相同索引的响应跨步串联成 N 条候选轨迹 τ_i；用基于 GT 标注的有效性判定（点击/长按用坐标距离阈值、滚动用距离+方向一致性、输入用 F1 文本匹配、Launch 用 App 相似度>0.9、系统类动作用类型一致）过滤低质量偏离，并在首个无效步 t* 处回溯截断，丢弃其后步骤，从而把静态数据扩展为多样的"模拟在线"轨迹。(2) 轨迹感知奖励塑形（Trajectory-Aware Reward Shaping）：先用原子动作打分函数 Φ(a_pred, a_GT)∈[0,1]（点击用高斯核、滚动混合、输入用 F1、Launch/系统动作用阈值指示）量化每步执行质量；轨迹级奖励 R_traj = (1/T)Σs_t^raw + T/N_ref + I(Success)，同时鼓励完成度、轨迹完整性与执行质量，并以 T/N_ref 显式建模进度与任务复杂度的权衡；再将原始分转为带符号基础分（无效步惩罚为 −(1−s_raw)），做三阶段目标对齐：聚合（S_pos、S_neg）、基线归一化（正步 s_t/(S_pos+ε)，负步 −(|s_t|/(S_neg+ε) + λ n_err/T̄) 抑制"奖励刷取"）、总奖励对齐（Δ = R_target − Σr^base，均摊到有效前缀的 n_pos 个正步上）。整体训练为两阶段：Atomic Adaptation → Trajectory Optimization；基于 verl 实现，PPO/GRPO 类优化（clip 0.2、γ=0.95、KL 0.001 low_var_kl），全局 batch 128、650 步、约 60 小时、32×L40S，最大上下文 6144 响应 1024。
AI.result: 主结果（与强基线对比）：Android Control Low 93.24 TM / 88.57 SR，High 79.19 TM / 69.27 SR，在离线类中 High 划分取得最高 SR（优于 UI-Venus 68.61%、AgentCPM 67.93%），Low 仅以 0.03 落后 AgentCPM；GUI-Odyssey 87.60 TM / 68.20 EM，接近 AgentCPM（90.82/74.84）但其训练数据量超过 3 倍（>55k 轨迹 vs 15k）；AndroidWorld 成功率 33.7%，离线类第二，优于在线的 UI-TARS-7B-SFT（33.3%）且无需 145k 在线交互数据，数据量约为基线的 10%。稳定性分析：直接训练消融中标准 GRPO 在约 200–600 步后出现后期崩溃/策略崩塌（退化为循环动作），SOLAR-RL 则单调提升并收敛在更高奖励（约 0.75）；PressBack 等易引发不可逆状态变更的原子动作上，SOLAR-RL 收敛更快更稳（>0.8），GRPO 剧烈震荡。两阶段实验中，High-Level Long 任务 2-stage GRPO 停在约 0.66–0.67 而 SOLAR-RL 达约 0.70；Super Long 任务 GRPO 震荡并停在约 0.58–0.60，SOLAR-RL 峰值约 0.66。附录消融显示对 Launch、Finished、Scroll、Wait、Type、Click 等动作普遍更稳，其中对不可逆动作（Launch）与会放大下游误差的动作（Scroll、Finished）增益最大，而 Click 增益较小（其本身监督密集）。定性分析（Simple SMS Messenger 重发消息案例）指出长程成功不仅取决于避免首个错误，更依赖"连续决策恢复"能力。
AI.conclusion: SOLAR-RL 通过"离线轨迹重构 + 轨迹感知奖励塑形（失败点检测 + 回溯信用分配 + 目标对齐）"，在零环境交互的条件下模拟了在线反馈信号，为长程 GUI 导航提供了兼顾稳定性与样本效率的解决方案，显著提升长程任务完成率与鲁棒性，并抑制了 GRPO 类基线的策略崩塌。局限与未来方向：(1) 半在线机制的探索上限受离线数据集覆盖度约束，无法遇到源分布外的全新状态（未见弹窗、延迟导致的界面漂移等），只能"模拟"在线反馈而非替代真实交互；(2) 当前有效性判定依赖 GT 标注与启发式比较，作者指出框架对有效性来源是 agnostic 的，可替换为学得的验证器、奖励模型或 PRM 以扩展到弱标注/无标注数据，但会带来奖励噪声、标定漂移与 reward hacking 等新问题；(3) 实验集中于移动端（Android），扩展到桌面与浏览器（hover、右键、快捷键、拖拽、多窗口/标签切换等更丰富原语与更复杂视图层级）仍需平台特定的有效性判据、精选离线轨迹与标准化评测协议。

title: SpikingBrain2.0: Brain-Inspired Foundation Models for Efficient Long-Context and Cross-Platform Inference
summary:
Scaling context length is reshaping large-model development, yet full-attention Transformers suffer from prohibitive computation and inference bottlenecks at long sequences. A key challenge is to design foundation models that maintain performance and long-context efficiency with minimal training overhead. We introduce SpikingBrain2.0 (SpB2.0), a 5B model that advances both architecture and training efficiency of its predecessor.
  Our contributions are two-fold. (1) Architectural Innovation: We propose Dual-Space Sparse Attention (DSSA), an inter-layer hybrid of Sparse Softmax Attention (MoBA) and Sparse Linear Attention (SSE), achieving an improved performance-efficiency trade-off for long-context modeling. SpB2.0 further supports dual quantization paths: INT8-Spiking coding enables sparse event-driven computation, while FP8 coding accelerates inference on modern GPUs. (2) Enhanced Training Strategy: We develop an optimized Transformer-to-Hybrid (T2H) pipeline with dual conversion paths for LLMs and VLMs using curated open-source data.
  Empirically, SpB2.0-5B and SpB2.0-VL-5B recover most of the base Transformer (Qwen3-4B) capability with under 7k A100 GPU hours. SpB2.0 achieves a 10.13x TTFT speedup at 4M context and supports over 10M tokens on 8 A100 GPUs under vLLM, where full-attention models exceed memory limits. It also demonstrates strong cross-platform compatibility, enabling FP8 GPU inference (2.52x speedup at 250k) and efficient neuromorphic execution (64.31% sparsity, with 70.6% and 46.5% area and power reduction at 500MHz).
  Overall, SpikingBrain2.0 provides a practical pathway for lightweight, multimodal, spiking foundation models, highlighting the potential of combining brain-inspired mechanisms with efficient architectures for resource-constrained and edge scenarios.

AI.tldr: SpikingBrain2.0 (SpB2.0) 是一个5B参数模型，通过双空间稀疏注意力(DSSA)和双量化路径，在长上下文建模中实现了高效的性能-效率权衡，在7k A100 GPU小时内恢复了Qwen3-4B的大部分能力，并支持超过10M token的上下文处理。
AI.motivation: 全注意力Transformer在处理长序列时面临计算和内存瓶颈，需要设计能够在保持性能的同时实现长上下文高效处理的基础模型，且训练开销最小。
AI.method: (1) 架构创新：提出双空间稀疏注意力(DSSA)，结合稀疏softmax注意力(MoBA)和稀疏线性注意力(SSE)；支持INT8-Spiking脉冲编码和FP8编码两种量化路径。(2) 训练策略：开发优化的Transformer-to-Hybrid (T2H)转换管道，支持LLM和VLM双路径转换。
AI.result: SpB2.0-5B在4M上下文下实现10.13x的TTFT加速，支持8卡A100上超过10M token处理；FP8推理在250k上下文下达到2.52x加速；神经形态执行实现64.31%稀疏度，500MHz下功耗降低46.5%。
AI.conclusion: SpikingBrain2.0为轻量级、多模态、脉冲基础模型提供了实用路径，展示了将脑启发机制与高效架构结合在资源受限和边缘场景中的潜力。

title: Adaptive Head Budgeting for Efficient Multi-Head Attention
summary: Transformers have become the dominant architecture across a wide range of domains, largely due to the effectiveness of multi-head attention in capturing diverse representation subspaces. However, standard multi-head attention activates all heads uniformly for every input, regardless of task requirements or input complexity. In many scenarios, particularly for coarse-grained tasks such as text classification, the relevant information is often global and does not require the full diversity of attention heads. As a consequence, using a fixed number of heads can introduce unnecessary computational cost or lead to suboptimal performance when the allocation does not match the input. To address this limitation, we introduce BudgetFormer, a Transformer architecture equipped with an adaptive multi-head attention mechanism that dynamically allocates computational resources. Our approach learns, for each input, both a head budget corresponding to the number of attention heads required, and a relevance distribution that selects the most informative heads. We also propose a training strategy based on an exploration and exploitation trade-off, allowing the model to discover effective head configurations before converging to efficient usage patterns. Experiments on text classification tasks of varying complexity show that our method reduces inference cost in terms of FLOPs and memory, while also achieving performance that can surpass standard full multi-head attention. These results highlight the potential of adaptive head allocation as a principled approach to improving both efficiency and effectiveness in Transformer models.

AI.tldr: BudgetFormer是一种配备自适应多头注意力机制的Transformer架构，能够根据输入动态分配注意力头数量和选择最相关的头，从而在减少计算成本的同时提升或保持模型性能。
AI.motivation: 标准多头注意力对所有输入统一激活所有头，但许多任务（尤其是粗粒度任务如文本分类）不需要完整的注意力头多样性，固定数量的头会导致不必要的计算开销或次优性能。
AI.method: 1) 学习每个输入的头预算（head budget）——即所需注意力头数量；2) 学习相关性分布以选择最信息丰富的头；3) 提出基于探索-利用权衡的训练策略，帮助模型发现有效配置后收敛到高效使用模式。
AI.result: 在多种复杂度的文本分类任务上，BudgetFormer在减少FLOPs和内存开销的同时，性能可超越标准全多头注意力模型。
AI.conclusion: 自适应头分配是一种有原则的方法，可同时提升Transformer模型的效率和效能。

title: Beyond Patient Invariance: Learning Cardiac Dynamics via Action-Conditioned JEPAs
summary: Self-supervised learning in healthcare has largely relied on invariance-based objectives, which maximize similarity between different views of the same patient. While effective for static anatomy, this paradigm is fundamentally misaligned with clinical diagnosis, as it mathematically compels the model to suppress the transient pathological changes it is intended to detect. We propose a shift towards Action-Conditioned World Models that learn to simulate the dynamics of disease progression, or Event-Conditioned. Adapting the LeJEPA framework to physiological time-series, we define pathology not as a static label, but as a transition vector acting on a patient's latent state. By predicting the future electrophysiological state of the heart given a disease onset, our model explicitly disentangles stable anatomical features from dynamic pathological forces. Evaluated on the MIMIC-IV-ECG dataset, our approach outperforms fully supervised baselines on the critical triage task. Crucially, we demonstrate superior sample efficiency: in low-resource regimes, our world model outperforms supervised learning by over 0.05 AUROC. These results suggest that modeling biological dynamics provides a dense supervision signal that is far more robust than static classification. Source code is available at https://github.com/cljosegfer/lesaude-dynamics

AI.tldr: 提出将动作条件世界模型（Action-Conditioned World Models）应用于医疗时间序列，将病理定义为潜在空间中的转移向量而非静态标签，通过预测疾病演变下的生理状态变化实现动态病理建模。在MIMIC-IV-ECG上验证，该方法在分诊任务中超越监督学习，低资源场景下AUROC提升超过0.05。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗自监督学习依赖不变性目标，最大化同一患者不同视图的相似性，但这与临床诊断目标根本不对齐，因为数学上强迫模型抑制其应检测的瞬态病理变化。
AI.method: 将LeJEPA框架适配到生理时间序列，将病理定义为作用于潜在状态的转移向量，通过预测疾病发作下的心脏未来电生理状态来解开解剖特征与病理动力学的纠缠。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV-ECG数据集上，关键分诊任务优于全监督基线；低资源场景下世界模型比监督学习高出超过0.05 AUROC，表现出卓越的样本效率。
AI.conclusion: 建模生物动力学提供了比静态分类更鲁棒的密集监督信号，在低资源场景下可超越监督学习超过0.05 AUROC。

title: Associativity-Peakiness Metric for Contingency Tables
summary: For the use case of comparing the performance of clustering algorithms whose output is a contingency table, a single performance metric for contingency tables is needed. Such a metric is vital for comparative performance analysis of clustering algorithms. A survey of publicly available literature did not show the presence of such a metric. Metrics do exist for vector pairs of truth values and predicted values, which are an alternative form of output of clustering algorithms. However, the metrics for vector pairs do not reveal the presence of detailed features that are apparent in contingency tables. This paper presents the Associativity Peakiness (AP) metric, which characterizes aspects of clustering algorithm performance that are critical for predicting a clustering algorithm's performance when deployed. The AP metric is analogous to measures of quality for confusion matrices that are outputs of supervised learning algorithms. This paper presents results from simulations in which 500 contingency tables were generated for multiple test scenarios. The results show that for the use case of evaluating clustering algorithms, the AP metric characterizes performance of contingency tables with higher dynamic range than publicly available metrics, and that it is computationally more efficient than comparable publicly available metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Associativity Peakiness (AP)度量指标，用于评估聚类算法输出的列联表性能。该指标借鉴了混淆矩阵质量度量方法，能够捕捉列联表中的细节特征，在动态范围和计算效率方面均优于现有公开指标。
AI.motivation: 聚类算法输出的列联表（contingency table）缺乏统一的性能评估指标。现有用于向量对的指标无法揭示列联表中存在的详细特征，这对于预测聚类算法在实际部署中的表现至关重要。
AI.method: 提出Associativity Peakiness (AP)度量指标，该指标类比于监督学习中混淆矩阵的质量度量方法，用于刻画聚类算法性能的关键特征。
AI.result: 仿真实验生成500个列联表进行多场景测试，结果表明：1) AP度量具有更高的动态范围；2) 计算效率优于现有可比指标。
AI.conclusion: AP度量能够更有效地表征聚类算法在列联表形式下的性能表现，可作为聚类算法比较分析的有效工具。

title: Rethinking XAI Evaluation: A Human-Centered Audit of Shapley Benchmarks in High-Stakes Settings
summary: Shapley values are a cornerstone of explainable AI, yet their proliferation into competing formulations has created a fragmented landscape with little consensus on practical deployment. While theoretical differences are well-documented, evaluation remains reliant on quantitative proxies whose alignment with human utility is unverified. In this work, we use a unified amortized framework to isolate semantic differences between eight Shapley variants under the low-latency constraints of operational risk workflows. We conduct a large-scale empirical evaluation across four risk datasets and a realistic fraud-detection environment involving professional analysts and 3,735 case reviews. Our results reveal a fundamental misalignment: standard quantitative metrics, such as sparsity and faithfulness, are decoupled from human-perceived clarity and decision utility. Furthermore, while no formulation improved objective analyst performance, explanations consistently increased decision confidence, signaling a critical risk of automation bias in high-stakes settings. These findings suggest that current evaluation proxies are insufficient for predicting downstream human impact, and we provide evidence-based guidance for selecting formulations and metrics in operational decision systems.

AI.tldr: 本文把 XAI 评测本身当作研究对象：以统一的摊销（amortization）框架在相同数据、模型、界面与算力下实例化八种 Shapley 值定义（固定基线 Zero/Mean、Uniform、Marginal、Joint-Marginal、Conditional、Counterfactual、Filtered Conditional），并在 5 个风险数据集、2 类预测模型与 37 名分析师（含 5 名专业反欺诈分析师）参与的 3,735 次真实案例审阅上，检验稀疏度、忠实度（删除/插入 AUC）、敏感性、反事实对比性等定量代理指标与人类感知清晰度、决策效用之间是否存在对应关系。结论是二者"解耦"：没有任何一种定义能提升分析师的客观准确率或缩短决策时间，却普遍（尤其 Conditional、Counterfactual、Mean 基线）显著抬高决策信心，构成自动化偏误风险；稀疏度甚至与信心负相关，说明现有 XAI 基准不能替代以行为为基础的用户研究。
AI.motivation: Shapley 值已成为表格型 XAI 事实标准，但衍生出众多语义不同的实现（KernelSHAP、TreeSHAP 及各种变体），彼此差异未被统一隔离；更关键的是，其评测长期依赖稀疏度、删除/插入 AUC、忠实度等定量代理指标，而这些代理指标与终端用户（尤其受时限、注意力与合规约束的高风险审核人员）的实际效用之间的对应关系从未被实证检验。已有工作多聚焦孤立的模型侧功能属性，或因实现差异而混淆了定义本身的语义差异，导致"选哪种定义""该看哪些指标"缺乏证据支撑。此外，解释在人类在环工作流中常被假定为必要，但其对决策质量与信心的实际作用同样缺乏实证。
AI.method: 1) 统一摊销框架：训练前馈神经网络摊销器（稳健缩放+类别嵌入、LayerNorm、LeakyReLU、Dropout、两阶段 Adam 预热+SGD 余弦退火、1000 epoch、每样本 4 个掩码、效率损失权重 0.1），使推断降为单次前向传播以满足毫秒级 SLA；摊销器与高精度 KernelSHAP 参照的 MSE 与 Recall@k 用于验证实验控制的有效性，从而把语义效应与算法噪声分离。2) 八种价值函数按"特征缺失"的语义分类（固定基线/均匀/经验边际/联合边际/条件/搜索反事实/过滤条件），在相同背景样本与计算预算下实例化；因果与生成式 in-manifold 变体因算力与假设成本被排除。3) 定量评测：删除 AUC、插入 AUC、扰动敏感性、反事实对比性、L1/L2 稀疏度，以及跨定义的 Spearman 交叉一致性；按尺度不变/尺度依赖分别聚合（尺度依赖先转成对内相对排名），自助法 50 次重采样给标准误。4) 人类在环实验：盲测、随机化、被试内设计，含无解释对照；界面固定（风险分+百分位、Top-4 Shapley 条形图、由归因自动生成的自然语言 reason code、只读数据浏览器），线性流程不可回退；收集二元决策、决策时间 log(1+t)、三档信心、二元清晰度。5) 推断建模：全局混合效应模型（accuracy 用 logistic、confidence 用 ordinal、time 用 log-linear），固定效应含 Shapley 定义、模型类型、数据集、模型熵、预测误差、分析师经验、自评领域/ML/Shapley 熟悉度，报告 OR 或乘性效应与 95% CI；再在案例层面以定量属性为预测因子回归清晰度与信心，检验代理指标是否为可靠预测量。
AI.result: 定量结果呈结构性权衡，无任何定义全面占优：Zero 基线在删除 AUC 与 Recall@k 上最佳，Filtered Conditional 在稀疏度、对比性与插入 AUC 上最佳但扰动下不稳定，Counterfactual 归因误差最高且不稳定；Marginal 与 Joint-Marginal 相互一致、表现最均衡，Conditional 产生稠密且敏感的归因。摊销器对 KernelSHAP 参照误差低、Recall@k 高，说明差异源自语义而非近似误差。行为结果呈现关键不对称：定义选择对客观表现（准确率、决策时间、复杂案例 p97.5 用时）无实质影响，效应主要由模型熵、预测错误与分析师经验驱动；而主观感受显著受定义影响——Joint-Marginal 被评为最清晰（OR 1.52），Zero/Uniform/Filtered Conditional 被一致评为"令人困惑"；Conditional（1.58）、Counterfactual（1.55）、Mean 基线（1.49）显著抬高信心。综合分析显示标准定量指标与清晰度、信心之间不存在正向关联，稀疏度甚至与信心呈负相关，与"低维解释更易理解"的既有假设相反。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明 XAI 评测存在根本性"解耦"：标准定量基准只捕捉解释的结构属性，无法预测终端用户如何感知与使用解释。在高风险生产环境中，没有任何 Shapley 定义提升客观决策质量，多种定义却在无准确率收益的前提下显著提升决策信心，暴露出解释诱发过度依赖的系统性自动化偏误风险。据此提出循证建议：将代理指标（删除 AUC、敏感性等）视为模型忠实性调试工具而非可解释性/信任的代理；在清晰度上优先选择经验类定义（Marginal、Joint-Marginal、Conditional），但对 Conditional 与 Counterfactual 保持警惕，因其仅放大信心而无准确率增益；并呼吁 XAI 社区转向以行为为基础的评测范式，在指标被证明与人类结果对齐之前，用户研究不可被代理基准替代。论文同时公开 3,735 条细粒度人机交互测量与代码数据以支持行为化基准建设。局限包括仅覆盖低延迟表格风险模型（结论在视觉/语言域可能不同）、受控环境无法捕捉长期学习、适应与制度规范变化，且排除了因果与生成式变体。

title: Zero-Shot Morphological Discovery in Low-Resource Bantu Languages via Cross-Lingual Transfer and Unsupervised Clustering
summary: We present a method for discovering morphological features in low-resource Bantu languages by combining cross-lingual transfer learning with unsupervised clustering. Applied to Giriama (nyf), a language with only 91 labeled paradigms, our pipeline discovers noun class assignments for 2,455 words and identifies two previously undocumented morphological patterns: an a- prefix variant for Class 2 (vowel coalescence - the merger of two adjacent vowels - of wa-, 95.1% consistency) and a contracted k'- prefix (98.5% consistency). External validation on 444 known Giriama verb paradigms confirms 78.2% lemmatization accuracy, while a v3 corpus expansion to 19,624 words (9,014 unique lemmas) achieves 97.3% segmentation and 86.7% lemmatization rates across all major word classes. Our ensemble of transfer learning from Swahili and unsupervised clustering, combined via weighted voting, exploits complementary strengths: transfer excels at cognate detection (leveraging ~60% vocabulary overlap) while clustering discovers language-specific innovations invisible to transfer. We release all code and discovered lexicons to support morphological documentation for low-resource Bantu languages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合跨语言迁移学习和无监督聚类的低资源班图语形态特征发现方法，在仅有91个标注范例的Giriama语上成功发现2455个词的名词类分配，并识别出两个之前未记录的形态模式（a-前缀变体和k'-前缀缩写形式），最终在19624词（9014个独立词元）的语料上达到97.3%的分词率和86.7%的词元化准确率。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言缺乏标注数据，传统NLP方法难以应用。班图语系内部词汇重叠度约60%，但语言特定创新难以通过迁移学习发现，需要结合多种方法。
AI.method: Pipeline包含：跨语言迁移学习（从斯瓦希里语迁移）+ 无监督聚类 + 加权投票集成。迁移学习擅长检测同源词，聚类则发现语言特定创新模式。
AI.result: 识别两个新形态模式：Class 2的a-前缀变体（元音融合wa-，95.1%一致性）和缩写k'-前缀（98.5%一致性）；外部验证444个已知动词范例达78.2%词元化准确率。
AI.conclusion: 迁移学习与无监督聚类的加权投票集成能够有效利用两种方法的互补优势，既利用词汇重叠检测同源词，又能发现语言特定创新。

title: Iterative Model-Learning Scheme via Gaussian Processes for Nonlinear Model Predictive Control of (Semi-)Batch Processes
summary: Batch processes are inherently transient and typically nonlinear, motivating nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC). However, adopting NMPC is hindered by the cost and unavailability of dynamic models. Thus, we propose to use Gaussian Processes (GP) in a model-learning NMPC scheme (GP-MLMPC) for batch processes. We initialize the GP-MLMPC using data from a single initial trajectory, e.g., from a PI controller. We iteratively apply the NMPC embedded with GPs to run batches and update the GP with new observations from each iteration, thereby achieving batch-wise improvements. Using uncertainty quantification from the GPs, we formulate chance constraints to enforce safe operation to the required confidence levels. We demonstrate our approach in \textit{silico} on a semi-batch polymerization reactor for tracking and economic objectives over durations of two hours, and the reactor temperature is constrained in a range of $\pm2^\circ C$ around its setpoint. After only four batch iterations, tracking error from the GP-MLMPC scheme converged to a reduction of $83\%$, compared to the initial trajectory. Furthermore, under an economic objective, the GP-MLMPC resulted in a 17-fold increase in final product mass by iteration 8, compared to the initial trajectory. In both cases, the resulting GP-MLMPC performance is on par with the full-model NMPC, which shows that the optimal controller can be learned by the approach. By collecting samples around the optimal trajectory, the GP-MLMPC remains sample-efficient across iterations and achieves quick convergence. Thus, the proposed GP-MLMPC scheme presents a promising data-efficient approach for the control of nonlinear batch processes without mechanistic knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于高斯过程(GP)的模型学习NMPC方案(GP-MLMPC)，用于非线性批处理过程控制。该方法仅需单条初始轨迹数据即可启动，通过迭代运行批处理并利用新观测数据更新GP模型，同时结合不确定性量化构建机会约束以保证安全性。在半间歇聚合反应器上的测试表明，经过4次迭代后跟踪误差降低83%，经济目标下8次迭代后产品量增加17倍，性能接近完整模型NMPC，证明了该方法可从数据中学习最优控制器。
AI.motivation: 批处理过程本质上是瞬态和非线性的，需要非线性模型预测控制(NMPC)。然而，采用NMPC面临动态模型成本高和不可获取的障碍，限制了其在批处理过程中的应用。
AI.method: 提出GP-MLMPC方案：1)使用高斯过程(GP)从数据中学习动态模型；2)从单条初始轨迹(如PI控制器)启动；3)迭代运行批处理并用新观测数据更新GP；4)利用GP的不确定性量化构建机会约束(Chance Constraints)确保安全运行。
AI.result: 在半间歇聚合反应器上验证(2小时运行周期，温度约束±2°C)：仅4次迭代后跟踪误差降低83%；经济目标下8次迭代后最终产品量增加17倍；性能与完整模型NMPC相当，证明可从数据中学习最优控制器。
AI.conclusion: GP-MLMPC方案具有样本效率高、收敛快的优点，可在无机理模型知识的情况下实现非线性批处理过程的有效控制，为工业应用提供了一种有前景的数据驱动控制方法。

title: Neural Recovery of Historical Lexical Structure in Bantu Languages from Modern Data
summary: We investigate whether neural models trained exclusively on modern morphological data can recover cross-lingual lexical structure consistent with historical reconstruction. Using BantuMorph v7, a transformer over Bantu morphological paradigms, we analyze 14 Eastern and Southern Bantu languages, extract encoder embeddings for their noun and verb lemmas, and identify 728 noun and 1,525 verb cognate candidates shared across 5+ languages. Evaluating these candidates against established historical resources-the Bantu Lexical Reconstructions database (BLR3; 4,786 reconstructed Proto-Bantu forms) and the ASJP basic vocabulary-we confirm 10 of the top 11 noun candidates (90.9%) align with previously reconstructed Proto-Bantu forms, including *-ntU 'person' (8 languages), *gombe 'cow' (9 languages), and *mUn (9 languages). Extending to verbs, 12 verb cognates align with reconstructed Proto-Bantu roots, including *-bon- 'see' and *-jIm- 'stand', each attested across wide geographic ranges. Cross-model validation using an independent translation model (NLLB-600M) confirms these patterns: both models recover cognate clusters and phylogenetic groupings consistent with established Guthrie-zone classifications (p < 0.01). Cross-lingual noun class analysis reveals that all 13 productive classes maintain >0.83 cosine similarity across languages (within-class > between-class, p < 10^-9). Our dataset is restricted to Eastern and Southern Bantu, so we interpret these results as recovering shared Bantu lexical structure consistent with Proto-Bantu rather than definitively distinguishing Proto-Bantu retentions from later regional innovations.

AI.tldr: 本文用仅在现代形态数据上训练的字符级 Transformer（BantuMorph v7, ByT5-small, 300M）从 14 个东部与南部班图语（中古兹区 C/E/G/H/J/N/S）提取编码器词元嵌入，通过逐语言均值中心化去除书写系统与词频偏置，再用跨语言最近邻检索共祖候选（名词 728、动词 1,525 个，覆盖 ≥5 语），并以 BLR3（4,786 条原始班图语构拟）与 ASJP 40 词表验证。结果：最可信的 11 个名词候选中 10 个（90.9%）与既有构拟吻合（如 *gombe『牛』、*-ntU『人』、*mUn、*tàtù『三』、*kèndà『九』）；12 个动词共祖对应原始班图语词根（*-bon-『看』、*-jÍm-『站』、*-gend-『走』、*-bà-『是』、*-kóm-『打』等）；13 个能产名词类跨语言余弦相似度 >0.83，类内显著高于类间（p=4.6×10⁻⁹）；Ward 连接聚类恢复古德里分区结构（首次合并 Kamba–Kikuyu、其次 Kongo–Lingala、Kinyarwanda–Kirundi），同区相似度 0.988 vs 跨区 0.977（p=0.028）。独立翻译模型 NLLB-600M 复现同样的共祖簇与系统发育聚类（p<0.01），并从候选中识别出 594 个强共祖。结论：模型恢复的是"与原始班图语一致的共享词汇结构"，而非直接构拟原始班图语，因无法区分原始班图语保留、原始东部班图语创新与区域扩散；方法定位为替代不了比较法的"候选筛选工具"。
AI.motivation: 班图语族的原始班图语（Proto-Bantu，约 4500–4000 年前）构拟依赖比较法，需要跨姊妹语逐条甄别规则音变，这是一项横跨百年以上、耗费专家人力的工作（自 Guthrie 1967、Bastin 等 2002）。作者的问题是：一个只在现代形态数据上训练的神经模型，能否仅凭现代数据自发恢复出与历史构拟相容的跨语言词汇结构？此前工作（Chi 等 2020；Bjerva & Augenstein 2021）仅从 mBERT 编码器表示中提取系统发育信号，尚无研究证明神经形态模型能恢复词汇共祖与原始词形对应。本文的价值诉求即为检验这一"从现代形态数据反推历史词汇学"的可行性，为大规模共祖候选自动生成提供可扩展的辅助工具。
AI.method: 模型与嵌入：BantuMorph v7 为基于 ByT5-small（300M 参数）的字符级 Transformer，在 16 种班图语形态范式上预训练；从最终编码器层取均值池化嵌入。语料范围：从 16 语中选出 14 个东部与南部班图语（Guthrie 区 C、E、G、H、J、N、S），其余 2 语因缺乏验证所需跨语言资源而剔除。语言中心化：减去每种语言的平均嵌入，以消除书写系统与词元分布造成的语言特异方向偏移，仅保留共享的形态与语义信息。同祖发现：在中心化空间做跨语言最近邻检索，提取在 ≥5 种语言共现的词元，得 728 个名词、1,525 个动词共祖候选；取置信度最高的 11 个名词与 12 个动词做详细验证。验证资源：BLR3（自 Bastin 等 2002 的 Wiktionary 附录提取的 4,786 条原始班图语构拟形式）与 ASJP 40 项基础词表（14 语全覆盖）。跨模型校验：计算 NLLB-600M（无形态训练目标的独立翻译模型）编码器嵌入，通过跨语言相似度一致性筛选出 594 个强共祖。系统发育：对 14×14 嵌入距离矩阵做 Ward 连接聚类与 MDS 二维投影，同区 vs 跨区余弦相似度以置换检验比较（p=0.028）。名词类分析：13 个能产类的跨语言类中心余弦相似度，类内 vs 类间检验（p=4.6×10⁻⁹）。现代伪影过滤：借助词性分类与翻译分析剔除专有名词与透明借词（如 Madagascar 出现于 8 语、Argentina 于 10 语、Bernard/Christine 各 9 语），借词通过"跨语言一致性均匀偏高（共同来源）vs 真实共祖呈规则音变式梯度衰减"的模式加以区分，并以领域无关的 BLR3/ASJP 部分缓解语料域偏差（news 与宗教文本导致 government、minister、bible、Jesus 等高频浮现）。
AI.result: 名词：11 个头部候选中 10 个（90.9%）与至少一个历史资源对应——ng'ombe(9 语)=*gombe『牛』、muno(9)=*mUn、moko(9)=*mok、umuntu(8)=*-ntU『人』（Bantu 族名词源）、moi(7)=*moi、ngano(7)=*gano、mpaka(7)=*-daka-、masoko(6)=*oko、mutwe(9)/umwe(6) 由 ASJP 确认；mali(5) 未验证，可能为阿拉伯语借词或原始东部班图语创新。数字系统恢复尤为突出：saba『七』(12)=*càmbà、tatu『三』(10)=*tàtù、kumi『十』(9)=*kùmì、kenda『九』(9)=*kèndà、tano『五』(8)=*tànò、nne『四』(7)=*nàì、nane『八』(6)=*nànàì、mbili『二』(5)=*bìdì。动词：1,525 个候选中 12 个与既有构拟吻合，ona/bona『看』=*-bon-、ima『站』=*-jÍm-、enda『走』=*-gend-、ba『是』=*-bà-、koma『打』=*-kóm-、lala『躺』=*--làal-、wa『落』=*-gu-、tuma『送』=*-túm- 广布，ona/bona 覆盖全部 14 语、跨度逾 3000 km（刚果语至修纳语）；soma『读』、andika『写』无 BLR3 记录，与其为原始班图语之后的东部班图语创新相符。名词类：13 个能产类跨语言余弦相似度均 >0.83，类内 > 类间（p=4.6×10⁻⁹），前缀对应 *mù-/*bà-/*mà-/*kì-/*nì-/*kù- 与斯瓦希里语、祖鲁语、基库尤语、恩加尼亚语、卢甘达语一致。系统发育：同区相似度 0.988 vs 跨区 0.977（置换检验 p=0.028）；Ward 树首次合并 Kamba–Kikuyu（距离 0.004，相似度 0.996，E50–E55），次为 Kongo–Lingala（0.004）、Kinyarwanda–Kirundi（0.005，J60），E 区（Kikuyu、Kamba、Kimeru）先形成纯子树再与 J 区汇合，MDS 投影中 E 区最紧密（簇内均值 0.990）。跨模型：BantuMorph 与 NLLB-600M 独立恢复古德里分区聚类（均 p<0.01），NLLB 从候选中独立识别 594 个强共祖。附录列出覆盖 ≥10 语的共祖候选表（ona、ima、koma、enda、nyama、kana、mama、muka、baba、soma 等）供专家复核。
AI.conclusion: 仅以现代形态数据训练的字符级 Transformer 能够自发恢复出与历史构拟相容的跨语言词汇结构：728 名词与 1,525 动词共祖候选中，头部名词 90.9% 与原始班图语构拟一致，12 个动词共祖对应已知原始词根，且数字系统这类最稳定的词汇元素被有效捕捉。名词类嵌入编码了具历史意义的跨语言前缀对应（p<10⁻⁹），系统发育树恢复了古德里分区及 E 区等细粒度子分支；独立的 NLLB 翻译模型复现同一信号，说明该结构并非单一训练目标的伪影。作者明确限定结论的效力：因样本限于东部与南部班图语，观测到的相似性可能源于原始班图语保留、原始东部班图语创新或区域扩散三者之一，本文方法无法区分，故结论应读作"恢复与原始班图语一致的共享班图词汇结构"而非直接构拟原始班图语。此外承认的局限包括：名词类标签为自动生成未经人工核验；字符级而非音系级，无法捕捉规则音变；BLR3 匹配基于子串比较，正式同源编码需专家判断；借词过滤与召回率估计仍是开放问题。总体定位：该方法不取代比较法，而是作为可扩展的候选筛选机制，为专家评估提供高质量共祖候选，Western Bantu 采样与音系化建模为后续方向。

title: Operational Feature Fingerprints of Graph Datasets via a White-Box Signal-Subspace Probe
summary:
Graph neural networks achieve strong node-classification accuracy, but their learned message passing entangles ego attributes, neighborhood smoothing, high-pass graph differences, class geometry, and classifier boundaries in an opaque representation. This obscures why a node is classified and what feature-level graph-learning mechanisms a dataset requires.
  We propose WG-SRC, a white-box signal-subspace probe for prediction and graph dataset diagnosis. WG-SRC replaces learned message passing with a fixed, named graph-signal dictionary of raw features, row-normalized and symmetric-normalized low-pass propagation, and high-pass graph differences. It combines Fisher coordinate selection, class-wise PCA subspaces, closed-form multi-alpha ridge classification, and validation-based score fusion, so prediction and analysis use explicit class subspaces, energy-controlled dimensions, and closed-form linear decisions.
  As a white-box graph-learning instrument, WG-SRC uses predictive performance to validate its diagnostics: across six node-classification datasets, the scaffold remains competitive with reproduced graph baselines and achieves positive average gain under aligned splits. Its atlas, produced by a predictor, decomposes behavior into raw-feature, low-pass, high-pass, class-geometric, and ridge-boundary components. These operational feature fingerprints distinguish low-pass-dominated Amazon graphs, mixed high-pass and class-geometrically complex Chameleon behavior, and raw- or boundary-sensitive WebKB graphs. As intrinsic classifier outputs rather than post-hoc explanations, these fingerprints provide post-evaluation guidance for later analysis and dataset-specific modification. Aligned mechanistic interventions support this guidance by indicating when high-pass blocks act as removable noise, when raw features should be preserved, and when ridge-type boundary correction matters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 WG-SRC（White-box Graph Signal–Subspace Residual Classifier）：一个"可预测 + 可诊断"两用的白盒图节点分类器。它用显式命名的图信号字典（原始特征、行/对称归一化低通传播、高通图差分）取代学习式消息传递，用 Fisher 坐标选择 + 类内 PCA 子空间残差 + 多 α 闭式岭回归 + 验证集分数融合完成决策；同一套已拟合变量进一步聚合为节点级"信号图谱"（atlas）与数据集级"操作特征指纹"，用于刻画数据集会调用哪些图学习机制。在六个数据集（Amazon-Computers/Photo、Chameleon、Cornell、Texas、Wisconsin）上以 10 次对齐重复划分取得平均 +1.52 个百分点增益，并通过白盒消融干预与指纹条件化的黑盒组件探针验证指纹的"可操作性"。
AI.motivation: GCN/GraphSAGE/GAT 等模型通过反复聚合邻域并学习变换获得强性能，但把多种机制混在隐层参数里：预测究竟来自 ego 特征、一跳平滑、二跳回返结构、高通差分，还是最终判别边界，难以区分。在异配/混合同配图（如 WebKB、Chameleon）上这种不透明性尤为致命，因为邻居未必同类，朴素平滑反而有害。作者的出发点是：不再学习隐藏的消息传递表示，而是显式构造浅层图模型可能利用的图信号，并用行为可检查的线性代数模块（子空间几何、低秩能量控制、闭式决策）分类；使"预测变量"与"分析变量"是同一批显式对象，从而能回答"某数据集需要哪些图学习机制、哪些机制有害或必要"。作者把这种"以可工作的白盒预测器实现的图数据集探针"定位为诊断仪器，而非后验解释或排行榜模型。
AI.method: 五阶段流水线。(1) 图信号字典：F^(0)=[X, P_row X, P_row²X, P_row³X, X−P_row X, P_row X−P_row²X, P_sym X, P_sym²X, X−P_sym X]，每块先做行 ℓ2 归一化，维度 p=9d，raw/low/high 家族块数为 1:5:3。(2) Fisher 坐标选择：q_j = 类间方差和/类内方差和，取 top-K（K∈{4000,5000,6000,8000}，超出 p 则截断至 p）得坐标集 S。(3) 类子空间残差：对每类在 F_tr 上做 PCA，按能量阈值 η∈{0.90,0.95,0.99}（r_max∈{32,48,64,96}）选正交基 B_c，残差 R^pca_ic=||(I−B_cB_cᵀ)(f_i−μ_c)||²。(4) 闭式多 α 岭边界：β_α=(F_tr F_trᵀ+αI)⁻¹Y, Z_α=F F_trᵀβ_α，各 α 用训练集标准差 σ_α 归一化后取负均值形成残差式 R^ridge_ic（三组候选 α 集合）。(5) 分数融合：两分支各除以训练集标准差，w·R̃^pca+(1−w)·R̃^ridge 取 argmin；K、r_max、η、α 集、w 全部按验证准确率选择（测试掩码从不参与选择）。节点级 atlas：Fisher 加权块证据 E_b(i)、家族级份额 R_raw/R_low/R_high（先家族内平均再归一化，消除家族基数先验）、两分支预测、真值—最近错类间隔 M^pca/M^ridge、决策象限（双对/仅PCA对/仅岭对/双错）、正确性与度数。数据集级指纹 m(D)=[R_D, L_D, H_D, C_D(平均类子空间维度), Q^ridge_D(仅岭对占比), Q^hard_D(双错占比), ΔH_D(错-对高通份额差)]。实验：六个 PyG 数据集、10 次类别平衡随机划分、仅用验证集选型；基线为 GraphSAGE/GAT/APPNP/C&S/GCNII/SIGN/LINKX/MLP-propagation 的对齐 CPU 复现最强值；干预实验为 Raw-only、No high-pass、No P³X、No sym、PCA-only、Ridge-only 六个变体；黑盒探针覆盖 LINKX、GNNMoE、SGFormer、GOAT、NodeFormer、GraphSAGE 的固定组件消融，并构造两个无标签压力测试原型 Amazon-Photo-LP+（特征空间互惠余弦 k=10 近邻加边）与 Wisconsin-R+（保度重连，失败则 0.15 边丢弃）。
AI.result: ①预测有效性：WG-SRC 在六个数据集上全部取得正的平均增益（Amazon-Computers +1.87、Amazon-Photo +0.39、Chameleon +0.92、Cornell +2.97、Texas +1.99、Wisconsin +0.98），平均 81.00% vs 基线 79.48%，+1.52 pp；以 6 个数据集级增益为配对单位，t 检验 p=0.0105、Wilcoxon p=0.0313、符号检验 p=0.0313，配对 Cohen's d=1.62（CI +0.54~+2.50）。②干预一致性：消融显示无单一简化变体普遍最优——去掉高通块在两个 Amazon 图上最好（79.73/90.27），Ridge-only 在 Cornell/Texas 最强，Raw-only 在 Wisconsin 最强（88.63）但在 Chameleon 崩塌（44.71）；完整模型平均排名最优（2.33）、最差情况精度最高（72.48）、六个数据集全部进入前三。③指纹可区分性：家族规模校正后 Amazon 为低通主导（低通 69.76%/71.97%，原始仅 15.32%/13.35%），Chameleon 为混合型（低通 61.32%、高通 38.37%、原始近零 0.31%）且类子空间维度显著更大，WebKB 三图（Cornell/Texas/Wisconsin）原始与高通更均衡且更偏边界/原始敏感。④错误结构：Amazon 错误节点高通质量高于正确节点，Chameleon 方向相反（正确节点更依赖高通），直接支撑字典中保留 X−P_row X 与 P_row X−P_row²X 的设计。⑤黑盒探针：不同测得指纹反复偏好不同归纳偏置——低通型偏好浅层传播与 graph/original 分支、排斥纯全局注意力与潜在图重写；Chameleon 偏好图局部结构（g-only/struct-only）而排斥 token-only/global-only/latent-only；Wisconsin-R+ 偏好保留 root/原始特征的一层设计；Texas 偏好浅层消息传递加强判别/全局混合；Cornell 作为均衡对照偏好简单原始图偏置。⑥代价：WG-SRC 运行时约为最强基线的 1.4×~17.5×，作者将其作为计算剖面而非加速主张。
AI.conclusion: 论文的主张是"操作性的"而非排行榜或因果性的：WG-SRC 的价值在于提供可复现的"数据集-在该白盒支架下如何被使用"的指纹，把一个准确率数字转化为可检查的机制假设，并给出优先尝试的修改方向——当高通证据呈噪声态时抑制/门控高通块，当原始特征不足时保留图派生信号，当类几何不足时强化岭型边界或改进 PCA–岭融合，当两分支均失败时引入新信号块或处理困难节点。作者明确限定该指纹是同数据集、评测之后的诊断参考系，不自动选择最终架构，最终模型仍需在目标协议下按验证集决定；若前瞻性使用，正确性相关量应在训练/验证节点上计算。局限包括：显式信号构造、Fisher 选择、逐类 PCA、多次岭求解与验证搜索带来额外计算开销；方法模块化，专用简化变体在部分数据集上优于完整支架（故保留完整支架仅为产出完整 atlas）；基线比较限于披露的对齐复现套件；黑盒探针仅是初始的同数据集参照系演示。附录还给出成对划分稳定性、类别对 PCA 子空间重叠与混淆星座、Chameleon 类别对几何图。后续工作可扩展到更大基准套件、更多模型族与更受控的数据集原型。

title: Spend Less, Fit Better: Budget-Efficient Scaling Law Fitting via Active Experiment Selection
summary: Scaling laws are used to plan multi-million-dollar training runs, but fitting those laws can itself cost millions. In modern large-scale workflows, assembling a sufficiently informative set of pilot experiments is already a major budget-allocation problem rather than a routine preprocessing step. We formulate scaling-law fitting as budget-aware sequential experimental design: given a finite pool of runnable experiments with heterogeneous costs, choose which runs to execute so as to maximize extrapolation accuracy in a high-cost target region. We then propose an uncertainty-aware method for sequentially allocating experimental budget toward the runs most useful for target-region extrapolation. Across a diverse benchmark of scaling-law tasks, our method consistently outperforms classical design-based baselines, and often approaches the performance of fitting on the full experimental set while using only about 10% of the total training budget. Our code is available at https://github.com/PlanarG/active-sl.

AI.tldr: 本文将扩展定律拟合问题重新定义为预算感知的顺序实验设计：在有限且成本异构的实验池中选择运行哪些实验，以最大化高成本目标区域的外推精度。提出不确定性感知方法顺序分配实验预算，在仅使用约10%总训练预算的情况下接近完整实验集拟合性能。
AI.motivation: 在现代大规模工作流程中，组装足够有信息的先导实验集本身已是一个主要的预算分配问题，而非简单的预处理步骤；现有方法在拟合扩展定律时成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于不确定性感知的顺序预算分配方法，选择对目标区域外推最有帮助的实验运行。
AI.result: 该方法在多样化的扩展定律任务基准测试中一致优于经典设计基线。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在多种规模化任务基准测试中持续优于传统设计基线，通常仅需约10%的总训练预算即可接近完整实验集拟合的性能。
